jobs.title: Senior Manager, SEO & GEO
jobs.excerpt: Senior Manager, SEO & GEOSearch Engine Optimization & Generative Engine Optimization | Parallels Push the boundaries of discovery.
jobs.description:
Senior Manager, SEO & GEO

Search Engine Optimization & Generative Engine Optimization | Parallels

Push the boundaries of discovery. In your sweatpants.

We are looking for an experienced Senior Manager of SEO & GEO to lead the next evolution of organic discovery at Parallels.

This role will own our strategy across both traditional search engines and emerging AI-powered discovery platforms. SEO remains a critical growth engine for Parallels - driving visibility, qualified traffic, customer acquisition, and category authority. At the same time, discovery is rapidly expanding into generative AI experiences, where customers increasingly ask tools like ChatGPT, Google AI Overviews, Gemini, Perplexity, Claude, and Copilot what to buy, how to solve problems, and which products to trust.

The Senior Manager of SEO & GEO will ensure Parallels continues to win in search today while building a leadership position in the AI-driven discovery channels of tomorrow.

This is a strategic, hands-on leadership role for someone who has deep SEO expertise and is excited to define the emerging GEO playbook. You will strengthen our technical SEO foundation, scale our content and authority strategy, and lead the company approach to improving how Parallels is surfaced, summarized, cited, compared, and recommended by AI-powered platforms.

You will partner closely with Product, Engineering, Product Marketing, Sales, Analytics, Communications, and Channel teams to make Parallels more discoverable across the full customer journey - from traditional search queries to AI-generated recommendations.

Your team is global and works across multiple time zones, so comfort with remote work and asynchronous collaboration is critical. Understanding the virtualization space, developer ecosystem, Apple ecosystem, enterprise productivity landscape, and partner routes-to-market will be a strong advantage.

Why This Role Matters

Search is not going away. It remains one of the most important ways customers discover, compare, and choose technology products.

But search is changing.

Customers are increasingly moving from keyword searches to AI-assisted recommendations, conversational answers, and generated product comparisons. That makes SEO more important, not less - because strong technical foundations, authoritative content, structured knowledge, and trusted third-party signals are also what help AI systems understand and recommend a brand.

This role exists to help Parallels win across both dimensions: the proven SEO channels that drive growth today and the emerging GEO channels that will shape customer discovery tomorrow.

What You Will Do

Lead the Integrated SEO & GEO Strategy

  • Own Parallels global organic discovery strategy across traditional search engines and AI-powered discovery platforms.
  • Set the roadmap for SEO and GEO initiatives tied to measurable business outcomes, including qualified traffic, conversion, pipeline influence, brand authority, and AI search visibility.
  • Balance near-term SEO performance with long-term GEO leadership as discovery behavior evolves.
  • Establish Parallels operating model for how SEO, GEO, Product Marketing, Content, Engineering, PR, Channel, and Analytics work together.
  • Lead prioritization, planning, reporting, and executive communication for SEO and GEO initiatives.

Build Parallels GEO Leadership

  • Define and operationalize Parallels Generative Engine Optimization strategy.
  • Improve how Parallels products are surfaced, summarized, cited, compared, and recommended in AI-powered discovery experiences.
  • Monitor Parallels presence across ChatGPT, Google AI Overviews, Gemini, Perplexity, Claude, Copilot, and emerging AI assistants.
  • Build strategies around entity authority, semantic relevance, structured knowledge, citation visibility, AI retrievability, and recommendation share-of-voice.
  • Partner with Product Marketing and Communications to increase high-quality third-party mentions, citations, and category authority.
  • Develop practical measurement frameworks for GEO where attribution is still evolving.
  • Identify how AI-driven discovery is changing customer journeys, competitive positioning, and purchase consideration.

Strengthen SEO as a Core Growth Engine

  • Lead technical SEO across crawlability, indexing, rendering, site architecture, Core Web Vitals, internal linking, structured data, and international SEO.
  • Partner with Product and Engineering to ensure SEO requirements are embedded into product launches, site changes, and platform decisions.
  • Drive content SEO strategy across priority audiences including prosumers, developers, power users, gamers, small and mid-size businesses, enterprise buyers, and channel partners.
  • Improve organic acquisition through better intent mapping, content quality, conversion pathways, and authority building.
  • Ensure Parallels continues to perform strongly in traditional search while preparing for the future of AI-mediated discovery.
  • Diagnose and resolve SEO performance issues across large-scale web properties.

Drive Content, Authority & Discoverability

  • Partner with Product Marketing to translate product capabilities, launches, roadmap themes, and use cases into discoverable narratives.
  • Build topic authority across virtualization, Windows on Mac, Apple enterprise adoption, developer workflows, gaming, productivity, managed devices, and cross-platform work.
  • Create content and information architecture that serves both human buyers and AI retrieval systems.
  • Support digital PR and partner/channel content strategies that increase trusted references to Parallels across the web.
  • Use AI tools responsibly to accelerate research, content optimization, competitive analysis, and workflow efficiency.
  • Help simplify complex technical messages into clear, compelling stories for customers, partners, and search/discovery platforms.

Lead Measurement, Experimentation & Executive Communication

  • Define clear KPIs for both SEO and GEO, including traffic, rankings, conversions, technical health, content performance, brand visibility, AI citations, and recommendation presence.
  • Build test-and-learn frameworks for GEO experiments.
  • Translate complex changes in search and AI discovery into clear business implications for executives.
  • Use data to prioritize investments and communicate progress, risks, and opportunities.
  • Manage SEO/GEO tools, vendors, agencies, and reporting systems as needed.

What You Bring

Required

  • 6+ years leading SEO, organic growth, search strategy, or discoverability programs.
  • Deep technical SEO expertise with a proven record of improving organic growth at scale.
  • Strong understanding of content strategy, authority building, information architecture, and search intent.
  • Demonstrated curiosity and practical experience with AI-driven discovery, GEO, LLM-powered search, or emerging search experiences.
  • Ability to define a new discipline while continuing to operate and improve a mature SEO function.
  • Experience influencing Product, Engineering, Product Marketing, Content, Analytics, Communications, and executive stakeholders.
  • Strong analytical skills and comfort building reporting frameworks where measurement is imperfect.
  • Excellent communication skills with both technical and non-technical audiences.
  • Hands-on familiarity with enterprise SEO and analytics tools such as Google Search Console, GA4, Looker/Tableau, Ahrefs, Semrush, Screaming Frog, Botify, Conductor, BrightEdge, Similarweb, or comparable platforms.
  • Strong project management skills and ability to manage multiple initiatives across teams and time zones.

Strongly Preferred

  • Experience in SaaS, developer tools, virtualization, enterprise productivity, managed devices, or infrastructure technology.
  • Understanding of Apple, Windows, Mac, developer, SMB, enterprise, and partner/channel ecosystems.
  • Familiarity with semantic search, entity optimization, structured data, knowledge graphs, retrieval systems, and AI citation behavior.
  • Experience working with GEO tools that monitor AI search visibility, brand mentions, citations, and recommendation share-of-voice across platforms such as ChatGPT, Google AI Overviews, Perplexity, Gemini, Claude, and Copilot.
  • Experience using modern AI tools for research, content analysis, workflow automation, and experimentation.
  • Experience managing agencies, vendors, or distributed teams.
  • Comfort working in a global, remote-first environment with asynchronous collaboration.

What Success Looks Like

Within the first 12 months, this leader will:

  • Maintain and improve SEO performance as a major organic acquisition channel.
  • Establish a clear GEO strategy, measurement model, and operating rhythm.
  • Improve Parallels visibility and recommendation presence across AI-powered discovery platforms.
  • Strengthen technical SEO foundations and content authority across priority product and audience segments.
  • Build durable collaboration between SEO, GEO, Product Marketing, Engineering, Content, Communications, Channel, and Analytics.
  • Create a repeatable experimentation framework for AI-driven discovery.
  • Position Parallels to win as traditional search and AI-driven discovery continue to converge.

About Parallels

Parallels is a global leader in cross-platform solutions, enabling businesses and individuals to access and use the applications, files, and workflows they need on any device or operating system.

Parallels helps customers get the best out of the technology they choose - whether that is Windows, Linux, macOS, ChromeOS, iOS, Android, or the cloud. Our products serve individuals, developers, power users, small and mid-size businesses, enterprises, public sector organizations, and educators who need simple, reliable, and cost-effective ways to work across platforms.

Parallels is best known for making complex technology feel simple. We solve deep engineering and user-experience challenges so customers can run the applications they need, where and how they need them - from Windows on Mac to managed enterprise environments and flexible hybrid work setups.

We have millions of users globally and decades of innovation behind us. Today, Parallels is focused on helping customers stay productive in a world where work happens across devices, operating systems, clouds, and increasingly AI-powered workflows.

We offer a fully remote workspace and flexible hours because we believe great work can happen anywhere. Our team is global, collaborative, and built around motivated people who care about solving meaningful customer problems.

Equal Opportunity Statement

Parallels is committed to building an inclusive, barrier-free recruitment and selection process and work environment. We offer equal employment opportunities to all qualified applicants and employees without regard to race, color, age, religion, national origin, sex, political affiliation, sexual orientation, marital status, disability, veteran status, genetics, or any other protected characteristic.

If you are contacted for a job opportunity, please advise us of any accommodations required during the recruitment process. About Us

Simprints is a nonprofit tech company with a mission to radically increase transparency and effectiveness in global development. We build ethical, inclusive digital ID powered by biometrics to verify that health, aid, and services truly reach people. Simprints partners with organizations like Gavi to boost immunization rates in developing countries, Ministries of Health like Ghana on pandemic response, and NGOs like BRAC to deliver maternal healthcare. Studies have shown Simprints increases impact through real-time, precision data, for example increasing maternal health visits by 38% in Bangladesh or accurate HIV tracing by 62% in Malawi. Today we’ve worked in over 17 countries helping deliver health, aid, and finance to >3M people. Our goal is to transform the way the world fights poverty, ensuring that every vaccine, every dollar, and every public good reaches the people who need them most.

Department Overview

Primary Function: The Product and Engineering department at Simprints is focused on developing innovative biometric solutions to help solve the problems of our users. We take a product-centric approach, ensuring our technology drives social impact through close collaboration and user-focused design.

Key Goals:

  • Enhance Biometric Solutions: Continuously improve our biometric products to ensure they are adaptable, reliable, and meet the diverse needs of our users.
  • Drive Cross-Company Product Development: Promote collaboration across the entire company to accelerate the delivery of impactful, user-focused features.
  • Ensure User Success: Go above and beyond to ensure our users benefit from our technology by providing ongoing support, troubleshooting, and guidance, while actively participating in decision-making and project implementation.

Join Our Product & Engineering Talent Pool at Simprints

Are you passionate about building technology that drives real-world impact? At Simprints, we’re always looking for talented product and engineering professionals to join our mission of transforming global development through cutting-edge technology. Whether you specialise in software engineering, product management, UX/UI design, or data science, we want to hear from you!

What We Do in Product & Engineering

Our team is responsible for designing and building scalable, user-centered solutions that work reliably in some of the world's most challenging environments. We work on projects that integrate biometrics, mobile applications, and cloud services to help NGOs, governments, and social enterprises deliver aid more efficiently and equitably.

Who We’re Looking For

We know that these are uncertain times for many professionals in the international development space, and we truly appreciate your interest in joining Simprints.

While we may not have an immediate role that aligns with your experience, we are always looking to connect with talented individuals who are passionate about using technology for social impact. By submitting your CV, you allow us to keep your details on file, and should a relevant opportunity arise, we will reach out to explore a potential fit. Thank you for considering Simprints, we appreciate the important work you do, and we hope to stay in touch.

We welcome professionals at all levels with experience in:
✔ Software Engineering (Front-end, Back-end, Full-stack, DevOps, Mobile)
✔ Product Management (Technical or Non-Technical)
✔ UX/UI & Human-Centered Design

✔ Data Science & AI/ML for Social Impact

Experience in international development, social impact tech, or working with NGOs is a huge plus! If you're excited about using technology to solve global challenges, submit your CV today—we’d love to explore how you can be part of the Simprints journey. 🚀

Requirements

What You Could Work On

  • Scalable Tech Solutions: Design and implement robust, scalable systems that support projects across multiple countries.
  • Collaboration & Development: Work alongside engineers, data scientists, and product managers to develop reliable, maintainable, and high-performing software.
  • User-Centered Innovation: Translate complex user needs from the field into intuitive, impactful product solutions.
  • Cross-Functional Projects: Collaborate with field teams, partners, and researchers to ensure our technology aligns with real-world challenges.
  • Reliability in Tough Environments: Build and optimise systems that function effectively in areas with unreliable internet and limited infrastructure.

Benefits

5 Reasons to Join Simprints

Life is short. We believe work should be inspirational, meaningful and fun. At Simprints, we’re taking on global development’s biggest challenges, powered by an amazing culture and incredible people. Work with us, and you will grow faster, learn more, and take on great responsibilities with the potential to make lasting change.

1. Genuine Impact. Work directly with our partners and users to deliver technology that has the potential to impact millions of lives across the globe. At Simprints, you’ll be part of a team that is passionate about driving real change.

2. An incredible, diverse team. Our work is at the intersection of technology and global development, and we’ve managed to build an amazing team drawn from all over the world. But don’t take our word for it—we’re an externally recognized Great Place to Work, part of the Flexa Top 100 Most Flexible Companies and a 2022 Best Workplace for Women.

3. Mutual Flex. We champion a work culture where autonomy and trust are paramount, steering clear of mere face-time metrics. Whether it's managing life's essentials like healthcare appointments or adapting work hours to match your peak productivity times, we've got you covered. In return, we count on your reciprocal flexibility when mission-critical moments arise, like stepping up for a crucial client discussion on a Friday or tackling unexpected technical glitches beyond regular hours.

4. Ultimate work-life balance.

    1. We offer a 4-day workweek, meaning everybody has the option to have Fridays off.
    2. We also offer unlimited annual leave, which allows you to prioritize your well-being

As long as you're driving results and fostering teamwork, we encourage you to strike that perfect balance between your professional and personal life. Our commitment to this model's success is solidified through semi-annual productivity assessments with our board, ensuring that our high standards of performance are consistently met.

5. Professional development. We promote continual learning and put our money where our mouth is with development plans and access to global experts through the GLG network

We also have a generous professional development budget for each colleague – “Eduprints”. Is there some training you’d like, or maybe you could benefit from professional coaching? Simply provide a business case that shares your aspirations and the resources you need, and we'll do our best to support you.

We care about both your development in Simprints and your holistic long-term career goals. Simprints Alumni have gone on to work for Google, USAID, Gavi the vaccine alliance, Save the Children, and other top players.

jobs.description:
Responsibilities

SafeGuard Services (SGS), a subsidiary of Peraton, performs data analysis, investigation, and medical review to detect, prevent, deter, reduce, and make referrals to recover fraud, waste, and abuse.

We are looking to add a Fraud Investigator to our SGS team of talented professionals.

What you'll do:

The position is expected to perform high level complex investigations of medical professional service providers and develop cases for future action, including referral to law enforcement, education, over payment recovery and other administrative actions. Will work with internal resources and external agencies to develop cases and corrective actions as well as respond to requests for data and support.

  • An investigator uses good judgment and may work independently with minimum supervision and direction.
  • The investigator also may work as part of a team as there may be times when the investigator needs to work with state and/or federal investigators and other personnel.
  • An investigator handles multiple caseload assignments concurrently; organizes and analyzes complex evidentiary patterns; interviews and obtains statements from witnesses and others.
  • Investigators may also be required to complete complex investigative reports that apply regulations or rules to the program(s) affected by the behavior being investigated. There may also be times when the investigator will need to apply federal or state laws.
  • Investigators are expected to research and understand the relevant offenses being investigated; conduct efficient and effective investigations concerning those alleged offenses and detect or verify suspected violations; obtain information and evidence by observation, record examination, and interview.
  • Investigators then analyze the results of the investigation to ascertain if the allegations have been corroborated and work with others to determine the appropriate steps that need to be taken to address the issues.
  • As part of an investigation, the investigator will need to prepare correspondence; be objective and accurate and communicate with others with tact.
  • There may be times when investigators need to react to unplanned situations, be flexible in planning their activities and adopt effective courses of action.
  • As investigators will be working with health privacy information, they also must maintain confidentiality and understand all the laws, rules and regulations concerning health privacy.
  • Telework available from: Georgia

Essential Functions:

  • This position may require the incumbent to appear in court to testify about work findings.
  • Ability to perform research and draw conclusions
  • Ability to present issues of concern, citing regulatory violations, alleging schemes or scams to defraud the Government
  • Ability to organize a case file, accurately and thoroughly document all steps taken
  • Ability to compose correspondence, reports and referral summary letters
  • Ability to educate providers, provider associations, law enforcement, other contractors and beneficiary advocacy groups on program safeguard matters
  • Ability to communicate effectively, internally and externally
  • Ability to interpret laws and regulations
  • Ability to handle confidential material.
  • Ability to report work activity on a timely basis.
  • Ability to work independently and as a member of a team to deliver high quality work
  • Ability to attend meetings, training, and conferences, overnight travel required

Qualifications

Basic Qualifications:

  • 5 years with a Bachelors or 9 Years with a HS Diploma/equivalent
  • Investigative experience
  • Strong investigative skills
  • Strong communication and organization skills
  • Strong PC knowledge and skills
  • U.S. citizenship required

Desirable Qualifications:

  • Strong background in investigations.
  • Experience in reviewing claims for technical requirements, performing medical review, and/or developing fraud cases
  • Knowledge of investigative practices regarding healthcare providers.
  • Knowledge of Medicare and/or Medicaid programs and the rules, regulations, policies and procedures
  • Background in evaluating, reviewing and analyzing medical claims and records
  • Ability to learn and operate a variety of data systems, equipment and tools used in investigations.

Peraton Overview

Peraton is a next-generation national security company that drives missions of consequence spanning the globe and extending to the farthest reaches of the galaxy. As the world’s leading mission capability integrator and transformative enterprise IT provider, we deliver trusted, highly differentiated solutions and technologies to protect our nation and allies. Peraton operates at the critical nexus between traditional and nontraditional threats across all domains: land, sea, space, air, and cyberspace. The company serves as a valued partner to essential government agencies and supports every branch of the U.S. armed forces. Each day, our employees do the can’t be done by solving the most daunting challenges facing our customers. Visit peraton.com to learn how we’re keeping people around the world safe and secure.

Target Salary Range

$66,000 - $106,000. This represents the typical salary range for this position. Salary is determined by various factors, including but not limited to, the scope and responsibilities of the position, the individual’s experience, education, knowledge, skills, and competencies, as well as geographic location and business and contract considerations. Depending on the position, employees may be eligible for overtime, shift differential, and a discretionary bonus in addition to base pay.

About Wealth Enhancement


Wealth Enhancement is an independent wealth management firm with an endless passion for enriching the lives of our clients. We continually seek to perfect our craft of personalized financial planning with our team-based Roundtable and UniFi processes that go far beyond the standard approach. We proudly provide unique financial plans and investment management services to over 90,000 households from our over 175 offices - and growing - nationwide.


Since 1997, Wealth Enhancement has tirelessly raised the standard of wealth management with specialized knowledge and more attentive service that helps every client craft their future. For more information, please visit .


We have an exciting opportunity for aMarketing Specialist! The Marketing Specialist supports the FocusPoint Solutions team by coordinating, developing, and producing advisor-facing and B2B marketing materials that are clear, brand-aligned, compliant-ready, and easy to use. This role helps translate marketing strategy into practical content, creative assets, campaign resources, and program materials that support advisor growth, business development, onboarding, events, digital marketing, and sales enablement in a fast-moving, regulated financial services environment.

This is aRemoteposition.

In the spirit of pay transparency, we are excited to share the base salary range for this position is$80,000 to $90,000, exclusive of bonuses and benefits. We encourage you to apply and provide us with your compensation expectations when you do. We're big on open conversations, so, let's have one.

Primary Job Functions

Marketing Content Development and Production

  • Create, edit, and update advisor-facing and B2B marketing materials, including flyers, one-sheets, worksheets, checklists, campaign kits, presentations, social posts, email copy, website content, and sales enablement resources.

  • Translate marketing strategy, campaign direction, and stakeholder input into clear, practical materials that support advisor growth, business development, onboarding, events, webinars, and lead generation.

  • Draft and refine content for advisor bios, firm stories, value propositions, launch communications, landing pages, resource descriptions, calls to action, and follow-up communications.

  • Review materials for clarity, tone, grammar, formatting, brand alignment, content completeness, and audience relevance before stakeholder or compliance review.

  • Maintain consistency across FocusPoint Solutions messaging, Wealth Enhancement brand standards, advisor-specific branding, and approved language.

  • Partner with design and digital marketing resources to ensure content is accurate, design-ready, properly formatted, and aligned with the intended use of each deliverable.

  • Repurpose approved content into scalable templates, toolkits, copy blocks, campaign assets, and reusable resources.

Creative Asset and Digital Marketing Support

  • Develop and update templated creative assets, including social graphics, email graphics, event and webinar visuals, simple web graphics, PDFs, presentation materials, and advisor-facing digital resources.

  • Resize, adapt, format, and version creative assets across FocusPoint Solutions, Wealth Enhancement, and advisor-specific brands using approved templates and brand standards.

  • Format PowerPoint presentations, advisor decks, webinar slides, and sales materials for readability, consistency, and polished delivery.

  • Support basic website and CMS updates, including text edits, image replacement, downloadable resource updates, metadata direction, page QA, and web-ready content formatting.

  • Prepare proofs, PDFs, image exports, working drafts, and compliance-ready layouts for review and approval.

  • Check final materials for visual consistency, formatting accuracy, image quality, broken links, typographical errors, disclosures, and file references.

  • Maintain organized working files, final assets, source files, templates, and reusable creative resources according to team standards.

Project Coordination, Collaboration, and Compliance Support

  • Coordinate marketing projects from intake through final delivery by organizing source materials, confirming deliverables, tracking timelines, managing revisions, and supporting follow-through.

  • Collaborate with the Marketing Manager, Digital Marketing Designer, sales, business development, product, operations, compliance, digital enablement, SEO, CRM/automation, advisors, vendors, and other internal stakeholders.

  • Clarify project needs by gathering missing inputs, documenting open questions, identifying dependencies, and communicating next steps.

  • Facilitate review cycles by consolidating comments, identifying conflicting feedback, tracking changes, and helping move materials toward approval.

  • Prepare content and supporting materials for compliance review, including intended use, audience details, disclosures, substantiation notes, and clean review-ready drafts.

  • Incorporate stakeholder, leadership, and compliance feedback accurately while preserving messaging clarity, brand consistency, and approved language.

  • Provide visibility into project status, blockers, review timing, content needs, and items requiring Marketing Manager review.

Program Scalability, Reporting, and Continuous Improvement

  • Help build and maintain scalable libraries of Advisor Marketing Program resources, B2B marketing materials, campaign content, sales enablement tools, approved messaging, templates, and copy frameworks.

  • Turn recurring marketing requests into standardized resources, repeatable processes, and reusable content assets that improve efficiency and consistency.

  • Maintain content calendars, campaign timelines, project trackers, resource libraries, approved copy blocks, and project documentation.

  • Support marketing performance tracking by gathering and organizing information related to campaign activity, content usage, advisor engagement, event participation, email performance, and program adoption.

  • Assist with campaign recaps, content performance summaries, advisor resource usage reports, event follow-up summaries, and marketing updates for leadership or internal stakeholders.

  • Use stakeholder feedback, advisor questions, campaign results, and recurring requests to recommend improvements to content, resources, and workflows.

  • Support a team culture focused on quality, organization, responsiveness, scalability, and a strong advisor experience.

Education/Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent, demonstrated through one or a combination of the following: work experience, training, military experience, education.

  • 2-4 years of experience in marketing, content development, design production, creative services, or a related role.

  • Experience in financial services, wealth management, professional services, or another compliance-sensitive industry preferred.

  • Strong writing, editing, proofreading, and content development skills, with the ability to translate strategy, stakeholder input, and rough concepts into polished advisor-facing and B2B marketing materials.

  • Experience creating or supporting emails, landing pages, websites, social media content, collateral, presentations, event/webinar materials, and sales enablement resources.

  • Strong design production skills, including layout, formatting, basic typography, image sizing, file exports, visual consistency, and brand alignment.

  • Excellent attention to detail, including accuracy of names, titles, credentials, dates, links, disclosures, formatting, and approved language.

  • Ability to organize source materials, manage feedback, prepare content for review, incorporate stakeholder and compliance edits, and support projects through completion.

  • Strong collaboration and communication skills with the ability to work effectively across marketing, design, web, sales, product, operations, compliance, digital enablement, advisors, and vendors.

  • Working knowledge of brand voice, messaging consistency, audience-specific communication, content calendars, project files, templates, and resource libraries.

  • Familiarity with Microsoft Office, PowerPoint, SharePoint, Wrike, Canva, WordPress or other CMS platforms, Salesforce, Account Engagement, email marketing platforms, and basic SEO preferred.

  • Proficiency in Adobe Creative Suite, including InDesign, Photoshop, and Illustrator, or similar asset creation software.

jobs.description:
Pridruži se našem timu kao neovisni prodajni agent:

Jesi li proaktivna osoba koja voli pričati s ljudima i provoditi puno vremena na terenu? Imaš odlične komunikacijske vještine i voliš se baviti prodajom? Imaš široku mrežu kontakata u ugostiteljstvu, maloprodaji i beauty industriji ili si jednostavno osoba koja u imeniku ima čovjeka za što god zatreba?

Teya je u kontinuiranoj potrazi za većim brojem Freelance Prodajnih Agenata koji će predstavljati i prodavati naše usluge za obradu plaćanja malim i srednje velikim tvrtkama.
Zadatak je jednostavan: pronađi klijenta, pošalji mu ponudu, unesi ga kao korisnika i komisija ubrzo sjeda na tvoj račun.

Imaš li svoju firmu ili obrt? Odlično! Za tebe imamo spreman ugovor o trgovinskom zastupanju!

Nemaš firmu niti obrt? Također nema problema, isplatit ćemo te putem ugovora o djelu!

O Teyi:
Teya postoji kako bi osigurala da svaka mala i rastuća tvrtka u Europi ima priliku uspjeti. Naš cilj je postati najtraženije softversko rješenje za ove tvrtke u Europi, pojednostavljujući im svakodnevne aktivnosti i pomažući im da lakše upravljaju svojim poslovanjem. Teya je osnovana 2019. godine i danas ima preko 1000 zaposlenika i 300,000 klijenata diljem Europe. Naši lime-zeleni POS terminali su osmišljeni da olakšaju život vlasnicima poslovanja i predstavljaju jedne od najmodernijih i najefikasnijih platnih terminala na tržištu. Ako često plaćate karticom, velika je vjerojatnost da ste već došli u doticaj s nekim od naših terminala!

Prednosti rada s nama:

  • Fleksibilnost: Radi po svojim uvjetima, upravljaj svojim rasporedom i određuj svoje prioritete

  • Neograničen potencijal zarade: Sustav provizije s visokim nagradama temeljen na učinku i s neograničenim potencijalom zarade

  • Neovisnost: Sloboda vođenja vlastitog posla uz korištenje naše podrške i resursa

  • Vrhunska rješenja: Rad s vrhunskom tehnologijom prihvata kartica i POS uređajima koji su jedni od najkvalitetnijih na tržištu

  • Obuka i podrška: Organiziriamo detaljnu obuku kako bismo te što bolje upoznali s našim uslugama te osiguravamo kontinuiranu podršku za sva dodatna pitanja koja se mogu pojaviti u bilo kojem trenutku tijekom tvog rada

Što tražimo od tebe:

  • Izvrsne komunikacijske i prezentacijske vještine

  • Sposobnost samostalnog rada i učinkovitog upravljanja vremenom

  • Ambicioznost, motiviranost i ugodnost u interakciji s drugim ljudima

  • Sposobnost generiranja potencijalnih klijenata, predstavljanje te uspješna prodaja naših proizvoda i usluga

  • Prednost imaju kandidati s iskustvom u terenskoj ili face-to-face prodaji te kandidati sa širokom mrežom kontakata unutar maloprodaje, ugostiteljstva i srodnih sektora

Ako ti ove informacije zvuče zanimljivo i želiš raditi po svojim uvjetima uz neograničenu mogućnost zarade, bit će nam drago da nam se pridružiš!

jobs.description:
A Snapshot of Curvion Blue

Curvion Blue is a high-performance RevOps & sales augmentation agency that installs and deploys enterprise-grade, AI-driven revenue engines and selling systems for growing companies.

Think of a lead generation-based marketing agency... but focused on sales. 🤪

Our clients bring us in when they need to build, optimize, or scale their revenue engine without having to build the entire infrastructure themselves. We architect end-to-end sales solutions by designing custom sales motions, implementing GTM strategies, configuring CRM and sales infrastructure, deploying AI-enabled tools, and providing highly trained sales talent to execute the system.

Our approach combines technology, strategy, systems, and people. We use battle-tested playbooks and proprietary processes to help our clients generate revenue faster, more efficiently, and with greater consistency, visibility, and control.

Our experience spans the alternative education space, including business consulting, real estate investing, mergers and acquisitions, sales training, and other transformative programs, as well as the SaaS industry, where we help innovative technology companies bring their products to market.

In short, we build and deploy revenue engines.

And CRM is a major part of that engine.

Position Overview: CRM Operations Lead

The CRM Operations Lead is a critical role responsible for strengthening and scaling the CRM infrastructure that powers Curvion Blue's sales delivery.

This role is laser-focused on HubSpot configuration, data integrity, system optimization, and operational enablement. You'll help ensure that the CRM environments supporting our sales organizations are clean, reliable, scalable, and built to support high-performance selling.

You'll play a key role across the CRM lifecycle, from system design and documentation to new account deployment, ongoing optimization, auditing, and maintenance.

You'll work closely with RevOps, sales leadership, data, and other operational stakeholders to improve the systems and processes behind pipeline management, reporting accuracy, sales productivity, and revenue visibility.

But this isn't a "keep the CRM running" role.

We're looking for someone who naturally sees the next level of the system.

Where are we creating unnecessary friction?

Where is data breaking down?

What should be automated?

Where are teams working around the CRM instead of through it?
What needs to be standardized before we scale it?

You'll help identify those opportunities and turn them into better systems, cleaner data, stronger processes, and more scalable revenue operations.

This role is ideal for a hands-on CRM operator who enjoys working inside complex systems, improving what already exists, and building infrastructure that allows sales teams to move faster without sacrificing visibility or control.

You SHOULD apply to this role if:

  • You've designed, configured, optimized, or administered HubSpot or another CRM at a meaningful level

  • You've worked with CRM environments supporting multiple teams, business units, or organizations

  • You enjoy improving and scaling existing systems, not just building from scratch

  • You've supported CRM deployments, migrations, or implementations, including integrations with dialers, schedulers, reporting tools, or other sales technology

  • You naturally look for ways to automate repetitive processes and eliminate operational friction

  • You care deeply about data integrity, reporting accuracy, and system governance

  • You're comfortable auditing CRM environments and identifying gaps in structure, usage, configuration, or performance

  • You can translate business requirements into practical CRM solutions

  • You can balance strategic thinking with hands-on execution

  • You enjoy creating documentation, SOPs, playbooks, and processes that make systems easier to use and scale

  • You enjoy working cross-functionally with RevOps, sales, data, and leadership

  • You're energized by scalability, standardization, and continuous improvement

You SHOULD NOT apply to this role if:

  • You've primarily used a CRM but haven't configured, optimized, or managed one

  • You prefer simply completing tickets over identifying and solving systemic problems

  • You'd rather build something new than improve a system that's already in motion

  • Auditing data, workflows, and system architecture sounds painfully boring

  • You avoid documentation, process standardization, or governance

  • You need complete ownership before you're comfortable making an impact

  • You're uncomfortable working across multiple teams and stakeholders

  • You rely primarily on certifications or theory without meaningful hands-on CRM experience

  • You're looking for a role where the system stays the same once you've built it

  • You aren't interested in thinking about how the CRM can make the sales organization better

Core Outcomes

Success in this role means:

  • HubSpot workflows, pipelines, automations, and configurations are continuously improved for scalability, reliability, and performance

  • CRM data is clean, accurate, structured, and trustworthy

  • Reporting and data pipelines receive the information they need to function properly

  • CRM inefficiencies and system gaps are identified and addressed proactively

  • New client accounts can be onboarded with consistent, scalable CRM infrastructure

  • Integrations between HubSpot and the broader sales technology stack function reliably

  • CRM documentation, SOPs, and playbooks remain current, actionable, and easy to follow

  • CRM standards and governance are consistently applied across teams

  • Sales teams have the systems and infrastructure they need to operate effectively

  • CRM initiatives move from idea → implementation without getting stuck in operational limbo

Responsibilities

CRM Configuration & Optimization

  • Configure, maintain, and continuously optimize HubSpot workflows, pipelines, properties, automations, views, and other CRM functionality

  • Audit existing CRM environments and identify opportunities to improve structure, usability, efficiency, and performance

  • Troubleshoot CRM issues and identify root causes rather than relying on temporary fixes

  • Evaluate existing processes and recommend opportunities for automation and system improvement

Client & Account Deployment

  • Support CRM setup and deployment for new Curvion Blue client accounts

  • Help configure CRM environments to support each client's sales motion and operational requirements

  • Coordinate CRM integrations with dialers, scheduling platforms, reporting tools, and other sales technology

  • Ensure new environments follow established configuration and data standards

Data Integrity & Governance

  • Maintain strong CRM data integrity and establish standards for accurate, consistent data entry

  • Audit CRM data and system usage to identify gaps, inconsistencies, and process breakdowns

  • Partner with the data team to ensure CRM configuration supports reporting, analytics, and downstream data pipelines

  • Help establish and maintain CRM governance standards as the organization scales

Documentation & Enablement

  • Create and maintain CRM documentation, SOPs, workflows, playbooks, and process guides

  • Help translate complex CRM processes into clear, usable resources for sales and operations teams

  • Support onboarding for new sales hires and account teams to ensure CRM adoption and process alignment

  • Provide guidance on CRM best practices and help teams troubleshoot system challenges

Revenue Operations

  • Partner with RevOps and sales leadership on forecasting, reporting, pipeline management, and operational initiatives

  • Identify CRM-related bottlenecks that impact sales productivity or revenue visibility

  • Support CRM projects tied to quarterly priorities and broader company initiatives

  • Contribute ideas and recommendations that improve the scalability and effectiveness of Curvion Blue's revenue infrastructure

OTE: $72,000 - $100,000 annually
Additional Compensation: Bonus opportunities
Schedule: Monday-Friday, 9:00 AM-6:00 PM
Location: Remote

Compensation Range: $72K - $100K

jobs.title: VP Product - Sidetrade Pay
jobs.excerpt: Are you a product leader who has turned payments into a revenue engine inside B2B software?
jobs.description:
Are you a product leader who has turned payments into a revenue engine inside B2B software? Sidetrade is looking for a VP Product, to build and lead the development of our global payments business.

Reporting to the CPO, this is a newly created product leadership role at the centre of one of Sidetrade's biggest strategic bets. Hundreds of billions of dollars of B2B invoice value flow through Sidetrade platforms every year, and only a very small percentage is monetised through payment acceptance today. Your mandate is to change that: to take Sidetrade Pay from programme to product, and from product to a thriving payments business spanning our enterprise base on the Sidetrade platform and our SMB and mid-market base under the ezyCollect brand, across North America, the UK, Europe, and Australia and New Zealand.

About Sidetrade:

Sidetrade (Euronext Growth: ALBFR.PA) is an AI-native company dedicated to Order-to-Cash (O2C). Its platform combines O2C applications, autonomous AI agents, and Aimie IQ, an intelligent natural-language interface that helps multinationals accelerate their cash generation, all built on SAFE, the Sidetrade Agentic Framework for Enterprise. Sidetrade operates the world's largest proprietary O2C Data Lake, built on $9 trillion in B2B transactions and millions of buying companies. We use this data to train specialized AI models that monitor, analyze, decide, and act autonomously throughout the O2C cycle. Sidetrade supports companies in 85 countries with 450 employees across Europe, North America, and Asia-Pacific.

We’re proud of our 38 nationalities, and these diverse perspectives drive our innovation, one-team culture, and customer-first mindset. Sidetrade has been positioned as a Gartner® Magic Quadrant™ Leader since 2022. We value passion over perfection. So, if you’re eager to learn and bring great energy, we want to hear from you. Be you. Grow with us.

Curious about Sidetrade? Catch Aimie in motion: Aimie Video

Requirements

What you will do:

  • Own Sidetrade Pay end to end: Define the vision, strategy, roadmap, and commercial model for embedded payments across both business lines globally, and be accountable for payments revenue as a distinct line of business.
  • Payment monetisation: Design the pricing and packaging architecture across card acquiring, direct debits, and account-to-account rails, balancing merchant value, buyer experience, and Sidetrade margin, and evolving it as adoption scales.
  • Payment partner leadership: Own the relationship with our payment service provider partner(s): commercial terms, joint roadmap, performance against SLAs, and the decision framework for a future multi-provider architecture.
  • Adoption and activation: Build the engine that converts our installed base into paying merchants: ICP segmentation, activation playbooks with Sales and Customer Success, buyer-facing checkout experiences, and the levers that shift payment mix toward monetisable rails.
  • Embedded product experience: Ensure payments are woven natively into Sidetrade's Order-to-Cash workflows and ezyCollect's collection journeys, embedded, not bolted on.
  • Embedded finance roadmap: Sequence the expansion beyond acceptance into virtual cards, working capital, business accounts, and emerging agent-initiated payments, in step with partner capabilities and market readiness.
  • Risk, compliance, and trust: Partner with Legal, Security, and Finance on scheme rules, regulatory change across our four regions, chargeback and insolvency exposure, and the controls that let the business scale safely.
  • Team building: Hire and develop the payments product team, product managers, payments operations, and commercial analysts, and set the standard for product craft.
  • Executive alignment: Report progress and economics to the payments steering group and executive committee, with clear metrics on penetration, payment mix, take rate, and net revenue.
  • Market intelligence: Track the embedded payments and B2B payments landscape, PSPs, orchestrators, schemes, and regulation, and feed it into strategy and differentiation.

What you will bring:

  • Payments monetisation, proven: You have built or scaled an embedded payments business inside a B2B SaaS company and can speak first-hand to take rates, attach rates, payment mix, and the P&L mechanics of payfac, reseller, and referral models.
  • B2B payments depth: Fluency in card acquiring economics (interchange++, scheme fees, Level 2/3 data) and, critically, bank rails: ACH, SEPA, BACS, and real-time payments, because B2B invoices are won on more than cards.
  • PSP partnership experience: You have negotiated with and managed acquirers or payment service providers, and know how to hold them to commercial and roadmap commitments.
  • Commercial ownership: Experience carrying a revenue number or P&L for a payments or fintech product line, with the analytical habits to model penetration, mix, and margin credibly.
  • Enterprise and SMB range: You have shipped payment experiences for large enterprise merchants and high-volume SMB bases, and understand how the two motions differ.
  • Multi-region awareness: Working knowledge of the regulatory landscape across North America, the UK, the EEA, and ideally Australia (PSD2/SCA, surcharging rules, money transmission, safeguarding).
  • Cross-functional leadership: Proven ability to align Engineering, Design, Sales, Customer Success, Legal, and Finance behind a payments vision, without owning them all.
  • Strong communication and influence: Exceptional storytelling for executive stakeholders, partners, and customers, with comfort presenting at board and C-suite level.
  • Team builder: Experience hiring and developing product managers, with a coaching mindset and high standards.
  • O2C or AR domain knowledge: Familiarity with Order-to-Cash, accounts receivable, or collections workflows is highly advantageous.

Benefits

  • Full remote – work from home.
  • Health & wellness – medical coverage, life insurance, 401k matching and other wellness programs.
  • Time off – competitive paid holidays plus public holidays.
  • Career growth & compensation – competitive salary, equal opportunities, learning & mentorship programs, and advancement support.

Because when you thrive, we all succeed!

We’re committed to providing a welcoming and inclusive experience for every candidate.

If you need any accommodation during the hiring process, just let us know.

Agencies

Higharc is seeking an accomplished UX Designer to join our growing Product org. In this role, you'll define and craft end-to-end experiences that simplify the complex—and make home design and construction more accessible, efficient, and human.

What You'll Do

You’ll work alongside a multidisciplinary team of engineers, architects, and 3D visualization experts to design tools that serve builders, buyers, and everyone involved in bringing homes to life. Your work will have a lasting, real-world impact and play a critical role in shaping the future of the homebuilding industry. Expect to:

  • Design End-to-End Experiences: Lead the UX and UI design of web-based tools across Higharc’s platform.

  • Simplify the Complex: Translate detailed workflows into clear, human-centered experiences.

  • Collaborate Cross-Functionally: Work closely with product managers and engineers to ensure cohesive product thinking. Partner closely with homebuilders, suppliers, contractors, and buyers to understand their needs and pain points.

  • Own Design Process: Develop user flows, journey maps, wireframes, prototypes, and high-fidelity visuals to articulate design intent.

  • Influence Product Strategy: Bring a strong, user-focused design perspective to product decisions.

  • Validate with Data: Leverage both qualitative and quantitative user insights to inform and iterate on designs.

  • Champion Design Systems:Contribute to and evolve our design system to ensure consistency and scalability.

About You

You’re a product-minded designer who thrives on solving complex problems and crafting user-centered solutions. You’re passionate about improving how people design and live in their homes—and energized by the opportunity to make a meaningful dent in an outdated industry.

You have:

  • 7+ years of experience designing web-based software

  • A track record of shipping high-quality, thoughtful product experiences in complex domains

  • A strong portfolio that showcases your process, thinking, and ability to simplify complexity

  • Deep user empathy and a clear, confident communication style—especially when working with cross-functional teams

  • A systems-thinking mindset with the ability to balance detail with big-picture product vision

  • Experience in defining and delivering net-new experiences, not just iterating on existing patterns

  • Comfort articulating trade-offs, managing ambiguity, and driving toward clarity in fast-moving environments

A major plus if you also bring:

  • A background or passion in architecture, construction tech, or home design

  • Familiarity with 3D tools or environments (e.g., Revit, Rhino, SketchUp, Unity, Three.js)

  • Experience contributing to or evolving a design system

Working at Higharc

Remote work and travel: Our company is entirely remote, and has been since we were founded in 2018. Remote work means more time with family, less time commuting, and the flexibility to blend work and life. We value in-person collaboration and asynchronous deep-work time, which is why we schedule regular team meet-ups in our hubs across the US and, depending on the role, prioritize hiring in those hubs. If your role requires frequent travel beyond pre-scheduled team meet ups, we will represent that to the best of our ability as early as possible in the interview process.

We provide comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage, with flexible PTO, and meaningful maternity/paternity leave to all U.S based employees that are full-time. jobs.description:
About Abridge

Abridge was founded in 2018 with the mission of powering deeper understanding in healthcare. Our AI-powered platform was purpose-built for medical conversations, improving clinical documentation efficiencies while enabling clinicians to focus on what matters most—their patients.

Our enterprise-grade technology transforms patient-clinician conversations into structured clinical notes in real-time, with deep EMR integrations. Powered by Linked Evidence and our purpose-built, auditable AI, we are the only company that maps AI-generated summaries to ground truth, helping providers quickly trust and verify the output. As pioneers in generative AI for healthcare, we are setting the industry standards for the responsible deployment of AI across health systems.

We are a growing team of practicing MDs, AI scientists, PhDs, creatives, technologists, and engineers working together to empower people and make care make more sense. We have offices located in the Mission District in San Francisco, the SoHo neighborhood of New York, and East Liberty in Pittsburgh.

The Role

Today, Abridge captures the clinical conversation across 300+ health systems and helps clinicians document in real time. Clinical Decision Support (CDS) is the next step: a chat-based assistant clinicians can turn to before, during, and after the visit — to prepare for their day, get evidence-based answers during the visit, and wrap up tasks afterward. It draws on the patient's chart, the medical literature, and the conversation itself, surfacing guidance without interrupting care.

We're hiring a Product Lead to own CDS end to end: strategy, the in-workflow experience, and the content and partnership strategy behind what we surface and when. You'll take CDS from early access to broad adoption across web, mobile, and EHR-embedded surfaces, while driving new capabilities and expansion opportunities. Doing this in a way that earns clinician trust means guidance that's genuinely useful and safe, without adding alert fatigue. You'll work across clinical science, ML, engineering, design, and commercial teams.

What You'll Do

  • Own CDS strategy and roadmap. Define the vision, sequencing, and success metrics for CDS — from answering clinicians' questions on demand to proactively surfacing the right evidence. Decide what we build, license, or partner for.

  • Own the content and evidence strategy. Partner with Clinical Science on evidence quality and clinical validity, and decide what we surface — across guidelines, journals, and reference sources — and what we won't ship until the quality bar is met.

  • Go deep with clinicians. Conduct hands-on user research: shadowing clinicians in exam rooms, observing them interact with our products, understanding the friction they face across specialties and care settings. Turn those insights into product conviction.

  • Ship high-quality in-workflow experiences. Partner with engineering, design, and ML to surface guidance that's timely, trustworthy, and easy to act on. Sweat the details of when and how it appears.

  • Integrate deeply with EHR environments. Work across Epic and other EHR surfaces so CDS fits seamlessly into existing clinical routines, using chart context (labs, meds, prior notes) to make guidance relevant. Understand the constraints and opportunities of embedded vs. standalone experiences.

  • Define metrics and drive outcomes. Establish clear KPIs across adoption, engagement, and clinical quality and safety, and use data to evaluate what's working. Build a culture of measurement and iteration on your team.

  • Navigate ambiguity and move fast. Create structure and clarity in areas where the right answer isn't obvious. Form hypotheses, test them quickly, and update your approach when the data says you're wrong.

What You Bring

  • 7+ years of product management, with significant ownership of complex, high-stakes, or AI products. This is a senior IC role.

  • Track record of shipping 0 to 1 products and taking them to real adoption and revenue.

  • Strong product taste and user empathy. You build for real user workflows — you know the difference between an answer that's technically correct and one a clinician actually trusts and acts on.

  • Comfort working with clinical, scientific, or evidence-based content, and a high bar for accuracy in domains where being wrong has real consequences.

  • Strong technical fluency. You can hold your own with engineering and ML on tradeoffs like quality, latency, reliability, and what's feasible.

  • Ability to make build vs. buy vs. partner decisions and defend them.

  • Clear communication. You explain complex tradeoffs simply and get clinical, engineering, and business partners aligned on a decision.

Bonus Points If…

  • You have clinical, healthcare, or medical informatics experience, or have shipped EHR-integrated clinical workflow products.

  • You've built agentic or assistant-style products — systems that reason, retrieve, and act across tools.

  • You've worked with medical content, knowledge bases, or evidence retrieval and grounding systems (e.g., RAG).

  • You've worked in regulated environments with a high compliance bar.

Why Work at Abridge?

At Abridge, we’re transforming healthcare delivery experiences with generative AI, enabling clinicians and patients to connect in deeper, more meaningful ways. Our mission is clear: to power deeper understanding in healthcare. We’re driving real, lasting change, with millions of medical conversations processed each month.

Joining Abridge means stepping into a fast-paced, high-growth startup where your contributions truly make a difference. Our culture requires extreme ownership—every employee has the ability to (and is expected to) make an impact on our customers and our business.

Beyond individual impact, you will have the opportunity to work alongside a team of curious, high-achieving people in a supportive environment where success is shared, growth is constant, and feedback fuels progress. At Abridge, it’s not just what we do—it’s how we do it. Every decision is rooted in empathy, always prioritizing the needs of clinicians and patients.

We’re committed to supporting your growth, both professionally and personally. Whether it's flexible work hours, an inclusive culture, or ongoing learning opportunities, we are here to help you thrive and do the best work of your life.

If you are ready to make a meaningful impact alongside passionate people who care deeply about what they do, Abridge is the place for you.

How we take care of Abridgers:

  • Generous Time Off: 14 paid holidays, flexible PTO for salaried employees, and accrued time off for hourly employees

  • Comprehensive Health Plans: Medical, Dental, and Vision coverage for all full-time employees and their families.

  • Generous HSA Contribution: If you choose a High Deductible Health Plan, Abridge makes monthly contributions to your HSA.

  • Paid Parental Leave: Generous paid parental leave for all full-time employees.

  • Family Forming Benefits: Resources and financial support to help you build your family.

  • 401(k) Matching: Contribution matching to help invest in your future.

  • Personal Device Allowance: Tax free funds for personal device usage.

  • Pre-tax Benefits: Access to Flexible Spending Accounts (FSA) and Commuter Benefits.

  • Lifestyle Wallet: Monthly contributions for fitness, professional development, coworking, and more.

  • Mental Health Support: Dedicated access to therapy and coaching to help you reach your goals.

  • Sabbatical Leave: Paid Sabbatical Leave after 5 years of employment.

  • Compensation and Equity: Competitive compensation and equity grants for full time employees.

  • ... and much more!

Abridge is an equal opportunity employer and considers all qualified applicants equally without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran status, or disability.

Proof is the world's first identity-assured transaction management platform and we are on a mission to digitize trust for all of life’s most critical transactions. Developed by the same market leaders and experts who brought notarization online with Notarize℠, Proof offers trust in a digital world by verifying identities and securing transactions to protect businesses and their customers. Since 2015, we’ve completed many of the world’s first digital commerce transactions, including the first online real estate closing, online mortgage closing, online auto sale, and online will and we're still just getting started!

Proof's IT function is evolving from a reactive, ticket-driven help desk into a modern IT Engineering team, applying an engineering mindset to managing the corporate systems our employees rely on every day.

We're already a forward-thinking team: initiatives like passwordless authentication and Zero Trust Network Access (ZTNA) have measurably lowered our ticket volume.

We're now hiring a Director to lead the next phase: building durable engineering practices, mentoring the team, and setting a multi-year strategy for how Proof manages its corporate technology stack with rigor. That means leaning into infrastructure-as-code, CI/CD, automation-first workflows, and agentic/AI-driven operations.

This is a hands-on leadership role. You'll set strategy, mentor, and represent IT to the rest of the business, while staying close to the work.

As our Director of IT Engineering, you will:

  • Lead and grow the IT Engineering team as a hands-on player-coach — pairing, reviewing work, and unblocking the team, not just directing from above
  • Mentor and level up the team as they move from a traditional IT/sysadmin skill set toward an engineering-first operating model, coaching on infrastructure-as-code, automation, and CI/CD practices
  • Own the strategy and roadmap for Proof's corporate technology: identity and access management, productivity tools, endpoint management, SaaS/vendor management, and IT procurement and budgeting
  • Champion the adoption of AI and agentic tooling to further reduce manual toil and ticket volume
  • Partner closely with InfoSec leadership on identity, access, and compliance
  • Bring a root-cause, data-driven approach to support — tracking ticket trends and metrics to prioritize the highest-leverage fixes rather than just closing tickets faster

As our Director of IT Engineering, you should have:

  • 10–15 years of experience across IT, systems administration, DevOps, or corporate/business technology engineering
  • Deep, hands-on experience with Okta (required), across all aspects of its configuration
  • Google Workspace experience strongly preferred
  • Experience building "IT as code" practices: Terraform or similar IaC, CI/CD, and GitOps workflows applied to corporate SaaS systems
  • A track record of reducing ticket volume and manual toil through automation and root-cause fixes, not just faster triage
  • Experience mentoring or providing technical leadership to mid-level IT analysts
  • Comfort operating as a hands-on IC on a small team while also setting strategy — this is a working leadership role, not a purely managerial one
  • Familiarity with security and compliance fundamentals, and genuine enthusiasm for close partnership with InfoSec
  • Curiosity about and early adoption of AI/agentic tools for operational efficiency
  • A strong communicator who can translate between technical execution and the needs of stakeholders across the business

Our Proof Pillars:

  • Pave the Way: When obstacles arise, we break through barriers with passion and perseverance. We lead with creativity and forward-thinking. We aim to set new standards and shape the future in a repeatable, scalable way so the path to success is easier for our team to follow.
  • Own It: We embrace the responsibility that comes with supporting life's most important transactions. When a problem arises we relentlessly pursue the solution with a 'Yes before no' attitude. Because every problem and every transaction is treated like it's our own.
  • Act with Integrity: We are in the business of building trust and it is at the core of everything we do. We are honest and transparent with our customers, each other and ourselves. If we make a mistake, we own up to it right away and do what it takes to make it right. Our dedication to security and compliance is key to earning trust, fighting fraud and ultimately, our success.

jobs.excerpt: About ImmunefiABOUT IMMUNEFIImmunefi is the world’s leading crowdsourced security platform for the digital economy.
jobs.description:
About Immunefi

ABOUT IMMUNEFI

Immunefi is the world’s leading crowdsourced security platform for the digital economy. We protect over $180 billion in onchain assets by connecting the most skilled ethical hackers on the planet with the protocols that need them. Our products — Bug Bounty Programs, Managed Triage, and Audit Competitions — are the de facto security infrastructure for serious blockchain protocols worldwide.

We are the dominant player in Web3 security, and we’re now extending into the broader enterprise market — financial services, fintech, and large regulated businesses — where the security problems are as acute and our capabilities directly applicable. This hire owns our commercial engine and helps open that next chapter.

The Opportunity

This is a rare role for someone who has scaled a marketing function from zero to one at a startup, who understands how to build trust and demand with deeply technical, skeptical audiences, and who is ready to step into a leadership position where they can build something of their own.

You'll architect the "Immunefi Engine": the AI-leveraged systems, category narrative, and product GTM that turn Immunefi's credibility into compounding demand. You'll report to the VP of Delivery, with a dotted line to the CEO on brand narrative and token strategy. You'll set the strategy, build the systems, and execute directly, using AI-powered workflows to compress what would take a large team into what one exceptional person can drive.

We're not looking for someone who will figure it out on the job. We're looking for someone who already knows how to scale marketing from 0 to 1 in a lean, high-ownership environment, who has genuine intuition for marketing to technical buyers, and who uses AI tools and agent networks as a natural extension of how they work.

What You Will Champion

Zero-to-One Marketing Ownership

You'll own the marketing function end-to-end, the way a founder would. That means being comfortable operating without a large budget or team from day one: you are the budget. You'll build the operations, systems, and strategy from the ground up rather than inheriting an existing playbook, and you'll do it with the resourcefulness of someone who has done it before and knows it can be done alone.

Marketing Systems & Infrastructure

Build the AI-powered operating layer that makes one person capable of running what would traditionally require a team. This means designing and deploying agent-based workflows, automation systems, and reporting infrastructure that compound output over time. You're not just a user of AI tools, you're the architect of the systems.

GTM and Product Marketing

Own go-to-market strategy across our core products: Bug Bounty Subscriptions, Managed Triage, and Audit Competitions, as the distinct buying motions they are, plus GTM for emerging products as we launch them. This includes defining ICPs, building messaging architecture, and translating complex technical security value into language that resonates with founders, protocol teams, and enterprise buyers to drive top-of-funnel demand, qualified pipeline, and MQLs for Sales.

Category Narrative & Brand

Own how Immunefi shows up in the market: a consistent identity and differentiated story as the trust layer of Web3 security. High-stakes public brand and voice changes are made in partnership with the CEO; you'll own the day-to-day execution and evolution of the brand within that.

Content, PR, Events & Social

Set the quality bar and build the systems that turn researcher expertise, security events, and product news into authoritative, organic-first content and thought leadership.

Researcher-Community Activation

Own the programs that turn our security-researcher community into a marketing asset: activation, crowdsourcing, and advocacy at the community level (elite researcher relationship management sits with our RM team).

Token Marketing & Ecosystem Activation (from ~3-6 months in)

Once the core engine is running, you'll take on positioning and ecosystem activation for our token narrative, working closely with the CEO. Deep token marketing experience isn't a prerequisite for this role, it's a skill we expect you to build quickly once the fundamentals above are in place, but comfort with Web3 community dynamics (Discord, Telegram, X) is a plus from day one.

Success Profile (Who You Are)

  • A Zero-to-One Builder: You have real experience scaling a marketing function from nothing, with no dedicated team or corporate-scale budget behind you. You've operated as the budget and the team, and you're energized by that constraint rather than limited by it.
  • Native Intuition for Technical Audiences: You've marketed to developers, engineers, or a technical/security buyer before or you have a comparable technical background yourself and you understand viscerally why proof, credibility, and organic reach outperform paid advertising with this audience.
  • A Hands-On Systems Architect: As a hands-on builder of AI-powered marketing systems, you actively design and deploy AI-powered, agent-based workflows and automation pipelines. You're the architect of the system, not just an operator of tools.
  • Strong Product Marketing Fundamentals: You've defined ICPs, built messaging architectures, and shipped GTM programs with outsized, leveraged results in fast-moving, technical industries.
  • High Agency, Thorough, and Async-Strong: You operate independently, chain your work to measurable business outcomes, and hold yourself accountable to them. We run async-first, and much of our evaluation process reflects that. Your written thinking and takeaway work matter as much as how you present live.
  • Resilient & Direct: You flourish in high-stakes environments. You believe in Radical Truth and clarity. You view feedback as a gift that protects the team's time and focus.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Comfort with Web3 community platforms and token-based network effects (not required to start, but a plus)
  • Experience marketing to a technical, skeptical, or expert buyer where organic proof mattered more than paid promotion
  • Background in crypto audits, cybersecurity, blockchain infrastructure, or developer tools marketing or a technical/engineering background that transitioned into marketing
  • Established network in the Web3 ecosystem
  • Hands-on experience in content programs, PR execution, and event marketing

Operational Requirements

  • Fully remote; globally distributed team
  • Must maintain 4+ hours of daily overlap with US/EU business hours

Why Join Immunefi

  • Ownership: You'll own the roadmap and the results for a function you build from the ground up.
  • Purpose: We're on a mission to secure the next trillion dollars onchain. You're the person who makes the world believe it's possible.
  • Founding scope: You're not inheriting someone else's playbook. You're writing it, the systems, the narrative, the engine, with no limits on how creative you can be.
  • Lean, focused team: Elite team, high standards, zero bureaucracy. The kind of environment where your best work actually ships.

If you are a hands-on marketing leader who has built from zero, who knows how to earn trust with technical, skeptical audiences through proof rather than promotion, and who builds with AI as naturally as you think in campaigns - we want to hear from you.

Working at Immunefi

Immunefi is the foremost security platform in the crypto / Web3 space facilitating the protection of billions of user funds. We aim for excellence in all we do and want to build a world class team of highly skilled professionals who can help us to scale & develop our company. If you are successful in joining the team, you will be working in a highly collaborative, cross-functional environment where ideas, input & communication are prized. By necessity, the work pace here is rapid and we need people who are able to immerse themselves quickly. As a fully remote and geographically dispersed team, we require everyone to be capable of autonomous & self-driven work in addition to being able to manage communication across global timezones.

Our Core Values

At Immunefi, we operate by three principles:

  • Secure the Outcome. Our mission is to secure the next trillion dollars onchain, and every decision we make serves that goal. The job is done when the outcome is secured, not when the task is checked off.
  • Act with High Agency. We are builders and problem solvers operating at the frontier of Web3 security. We take full ownership of challenges, find solutions, and drive outcomes forward. Blocked is not a final status.
  • Constant Vigilance. The stakes in Web3 are real and the cost of failure is high. We think like owners, never trade safety for speed, and protect the trust that the onchain ecosystem places in us.

What We Offer

  • 100% remote-first work environment, flexible schedule
  • Autonomous work environment with trusting, smart, reliable team members
  • An opportunity to be building an early-stage company in a dynamically evolving market and industry
  • An opportunity to build your own path in the company as we continue to evolve and grow
  • A global market (it’s fun to meet people from all over the world every day!)
  • A chance to make impact and participate in building and securing the ecosystem for smart contracts and the future of money (we’re protecting over $100B in user funds)

Simpson Strong-Tie is a leader in engineered structural connectors, software, and solutions for the building industry. We maintain a reputation as a trusted manufacturer, partner, and corporate citizen committed to our customers and employees.

Our founder, Barc Simpson established 9 Principles of Business we live out as company values and have made Simpson Strong-Tie an inspiring place to work since 1956.
