YOU

You are a systems‑oriented thinker who thrives at the intersection of strategy, execution, and enablement. You see automation, AI, and modern marketing platforms not as isolated tools, but as connected systems that should work together to drive outcomes with less friction and manual effort.

In this role, you will reshape how Digital Marketing and eCommerce execution happens, redesigning workflows, integrating platforms, and embedding logic directly into systems so work scales beyond individual effort. You’ll focus on moving the organization away from coordination‑heavy processes and toward system‑driven, outcome‑oriented execution models, including autonomous and human‑in‑the‑loop designs.

You will also provide connective ownership across core marketing platforms and integrations — the foundational layer between transformation initiatives that keeps everything running reliably while enabling what comes next. By partnering closely with analytics, data, IT, and platform experts, you’ll help ensure the infrastructure, governance, and execution foundations are strong enough to support automation, AI‑enabled workflows, and long‑term scalability.

This is a role for someone who enjoys building the engine while improving it, balancing vision with pragmatism, and creating systems that allow teams to move faster, smarter, and with greater confidence.

WHAT YOU’LL BE DOING

Workflow & Systems Ownership (20%)

  • Collaborate with stakeholders across the Digital Marketing and eBusiness team to restructure end‑to‑end workflows, reducing manual effort and reliance on coordination‑based execution.
  • Translate business goals and operational needs into system‑driven execution models, including autonomous and human‑in‑the‑loop designs.
  • Own the full lifecycle of automated workflows, including creation, iteration, performance measurement, and retirement.

Automation & Platform Integration (20%)

  • Build and configure solutions, agents, and platform automations using existing IT‑approved tools and systems.
  • Act as the orchestration layer across marketing platforms by connecting data, actions, and decision logic to minimize manual handoffs.
  • Provide operational stewardship for critical platform connections, tagging frameworks, and measurement touchpoints that automation and agent‑driven workflows depend on.
  • Ensure automations are resilient, observable, and aligned with marketing objectives rather than one‑off task execution.

Integration Enablement & Execution Foundations (20%)

  • Provide connective enablement across core marketing platforms and integrations, ensuring the foundational systems between major initiatives remain reliable, governed, and aligned with automation-driven execution.
  • Partner closely with existing digital marketing data, analytics, IT, and platform experts to clarify ownership boundaries, handoffs, and escalation paths, without duplicating analytics, reporting, or insight-generation responsibilities.
  • Serve as the coordination point for cross-platform integration health, tagging governance, and measurement continuity, particularly where responsibilities span multiple teams or tools.
  • Establish shared standards, documentation, and system expectations that enable consistent execution while respecting existing subject-matter ownership.
  • Identify foundational gaps or risks that could undermine automation, agent-led workflows, or AI-enabled capabilities, and work with the appropriate owners to address them.

Ownership of Outcomes (15%)

  • Restructure traditional project and program management responsibilities for marketing execution by embedding planning, coordination, and tracking logic directly into systems and automations.
  • Own outcomes such as cycle‑time reduction, elimination of manual work, and adoption of automated workflows across the team.
  • Evaluate requests and initiatives and recommend when automation is not the right solution, prioritizing impact over activity.
  • Ensure the clarity, reliability, and continuity of foundational integrations and execution enablers that support automation-driven marketing workflows.

Agent & Automation Governance (10%)

  • Partner with Digital Marketing leadership to determine agent‑owned vs human‑owned responsibilities.
  • Define and document human‑in‑the‑loop expectations, escalation paths, and accountability for automated workflows.
  • Manage automation ownership models at the individual, team, or department level and retire solutions when they no longer provide value.

Change Management & Enablement (10%)

  • Lead adoption, rollout, and change management for newly restructured workflows and automation‑driven systems.
  • Partner with marketing managers to ensure new ways of working are understood, adopted, and sustained.
  • Challenge legacy processes and advocate for improved execution models grounded in system‑driven delivery.

Marketing AI Subject‑Matter Expertise (5%)

  • Serve as the primary advisor for Digital Marketing on effective use of AI‑enabled capabilities within existing IT approved platforms.
  • Establish best practices for responsible, effective automation and Copilot usage across the Digital Marketing and eBusiness team.

DESIRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE

Purpose of the role

The Legal and Compliance Operations Consultant supports the Chief Operating Officer on the legal and compliance needs of the organization. This is an execution-focused role: the person is assigned varied legal and compliance tasks connected to GFNE's work and carries each through to completion with precision and reliable follow-up. This role requires the ability to coordinate, organize, and execute across a global organization, and to work closely with external counsel where specialist input is required.

Scope of work

The central function of this role is to provide direct, ongoing support to the Chief Operating Officer across GFNE's legal and compliance needs. The work is varied and largely responsive: the Consultant takes on assigned tasks as they arise, prioritized by the COO, and carries each through to completion with careful, consistent follow-up.

These tasks fall across the areas below. The points under each are illustrative of the kind of work involved rather than an exhaustive list.

1. US and Swiss nonprofit compliance

  • Track and maintain GFNE's compliance obligations across entities, keeping a live view of filing dates, renewals, and regulatory deadlines.
  • Support adherence to US 501(c)(3) requirements, including the boundaries around political activity and lobbying, and coordinate the administration of related disclosures.
  • Coordinate statutory and regulatory filings across both jurisdictions, routing matters to counsel and finance where specialist input is needed.
  • Support the compliance and governance requirements of GFNE's entities.
  • Track compliance requirements early and coordinate the timely executions of various compliance needs.
  • Support GFNE's data protection and privacy obligations at a coordinating level, working with counsel on GDPR and equivalent requirements, with particular relevance for the European entity, and flag privacy considerations that surface in day-to-day operations.
  • Prepare and organize documentation for audits and regulatory information requests.

2. International grantmaking compliance

  • Support the compliance checks around GFNE's international grantmaking, coordinating grantee due diligence with counsel and finance, including sanctions and watchlist screening.
  • Help administer expenditure responsibility and equivalency determination processes where grants require them, maintaining the supporting records and tracking reporting deadlines.
  • Prepare and organize documentation for grant due diligence and funder information requests.

3. Board and governance support

  • Prepare board and committee materials, coordinate meeting logistics, and produce accurate minutes and resolutions.
  • Maintain the governance calendar, tracking meeting cadence, committee cycles, and statutory deadlines such as the Form 990 and Swiss or European equivalents.
  • Administer the conflict of interest and disclosure processes, including collecting, tracking, and safely maintaining declarations.
  • Act as custodian of GFNE's governing documents, keeping bylaws and board-approved policies current, version controlled, and properly filed.

4. Legal coordination and cross-functional support

  • Serve as the coordination point between GFNE and its external legal counsel in the US, Europe, and any other region where the organization operates.
  • Scope and brief legal questions clearly, gather the background counsel needs, and track matters through to resolution.
  • Help identify and engage counsel in new jurisdictions as GFNE's footprint grows.

Nature of the engagement

This is a consultancy of approximately 80 hours per month, structured as a blend of ongoing availability and defined monthly deliverables. Work is assigned and prioritized by the Chief Operating Officer. The role suits someone who is self-directed and highly organized, and who is comfortable moving across a varied set of tasks and shifting priorities within a remote, globally distributed team.

Required skills and experience

  • Around 7 or more years of relevant experience across a blend of nonprofit compliance, paralegal, and legal operations work.
  • A legal qualification is not required, but would be an added advantage.
  • Demonstrated experience in the nonprofit or philanthropy sector. (Essential.)
  • Comfort working within a remote, globally distributed team across multiple time zones. (Essential.)
  • Strong communication, coordination, and collaboration skills, with the ability to work smoothly across teams and regions. (Essential.)
  • A strong learning ethos and the acumen to navigate US and Swiss nonprofit and philanthropic environments. Direct familiarity with US 501(c)(3) and European nonprofit frameworks is an advantage, not a requirement.
  • Exceptional attention to detail, with a disciplined approach to follow-up and follow-through. This is an execution-heavy role, and dependability on the detail is central to it.
  • Self-directed and well organized, able to manage varied tasks with minimal oversight.
  • Comfort operating across cultures and time zones, and with the ambiguity that comes with a young, growing organization.
  • Sound judgment and discretion in handling sensitive and confidential legal and people matters.
  • Ability to translate complex legal and regulatory guidance into clear, practical language for colleagues without a legal background.

Equity and inclusion

GFNE is committed to building a diverse team and welcomes applicants from all backgrounds and locations. All qualified applicants will receive consideration regardless of nationality, background, age, beliefs, gender, sexual orientation, health, or disability. Applications from under-represented and marginalized groups are strongly encouraged.

Confidentiality

The role involves regular contact with sensitive organizational, legal, and personal information. The Consultant is expected to handle all such information with discretion and to maintain strict confidentiality throughout and after the engagement.

Job Description Summary:

Medical Coding Auditors are responsible for ensuring that coding performed on behalf of ModMed BOOST clients is in compliance with all published federal, state and payer-specific coding guidelines.

The Medical Coding Auditor conducts coding reviews and quality assurance audits to verify that all applicable guidelines associated with ICD-10 CM, HCPCS, CPT procedural coding, and modifier usage are followed by the BOOST coding team and the global coding teams. The Medical Coding Auditor also performs as a denial management coder, which reviews and analyzes coding denials and provides needed corrections of these claims when applicable, and performs quality assurance on global denial coding teams processes.

Medical Coding Auditors must maintain continuous contact with the BOOST internal and global coding teams to provide statistical and qualitative feedback on the coding quality and aid in education and guidance consistent with established coding and compliance guidelines. They will perform duties under the supervision of the Medical Coding and Auditing Manager.

Essential Functions of Medical Coding Auditor

  • Responsible for analyzing, reviewing and providing feedback when performing quality assurance activities and completing QA audits, including but not limited to:
    • Ensuring all federal and state coding guidelines and regulations are met as well as payer guidelines
    • Provide effective feedback to the global coding teams to aid in their successful coding of BOOST clients
    • Maintaining a communication log to show successful training of the global coding team when coding trends or issues are found
    • Report all coding trends and issues to department lead as they are identified
  • Review target cases per month based on the ModMed Quality Assurance SOP
  • Accurately document their daily audit results in the Daily Audit Log and communicate coding resolutions to the BOOST or global coding teams
    • This would include monthly assistance in maintaining QA audit logs summary pages which details the global coding teams monthly coding accuracy levels
  • Collaborate with the global coding teams on inquires, clarifications, QA rebuttals and training requests
  • Work alongside coding leadership in regard to global coding teams training of coding processes as well as attending remote coding sessions with the global coding teams
    • This would consist of coding, documentation, coding guideline training and overall QA findings resolutions
  • Help with other daily communications between the internal BOOST RCM teams and the Auditing team in regards to other coding inquiries or issues
    • This would include any sync calls pertaining to assigned clients or ModMed committee calls pertaining to assigned specialties
  • Perform BOOST special Quality Assurance audits on the global coding teams
    • Such as on their assignment accuracy, coding appeals accuracy and all other coding scopes
  • Perform BOOST or Compliance audits when requested by BOOST or other ModMed staff which help to determine coding compliance or client documentation issues
  • Support in the review, appeal and follow up of third party (RAC, CERT, etc.) audits
  • Assist in review and maintenance of coding guidelines, coding scrub edits and/or practice coding instructions and assist with continuous quality improvement by helping with the process of implementation and carry through of coding protocols and procedures
  • Collaborate with fellow coding/auditing team members to maintain department compliance and effectiveness
  • Responsible for obtaining continuing education units (CEU) for maintaining coding certification(s)

The interpreter processes information quickly, concisely and recognizes sensitive cultural differences. The interpreter is professional and courteous at all times and uses appropriate terminology and understands common industry procedures and practices. The video and audio interpreting sessions may involve simple or complex, technical or non-technical subjects.

This position does not involve written translation however translators and other skilled linguists are encouraged to apply. The interpreters translate verbally.

**This is a remote position. The Interpreter works from his/her home-office. It is essential to ensure a quiet & secure environment**

Essential Job Functions:

  • Respond to video and audio interpreting sessions promptly and conduct interpretation in a friendly and professional manner.

  • Speak clearly in both languages using proper pronunciation, enunciation and polite expressions.

  • Remain calm during video and audio interpreting sessions in the event that one of the primary speakers is incoherent or upset, especially in emergency situations such as 911 calls.
  • Maintain punctuality and availability during scheduled work hours.
  • Follow client instructions, in compliance with protocol to ensure client expectations are met with the Limited English-speaking Person (LEP), avoiding interaction with the LEP without client’s permission.
  • Understand protocol and terminology for various industries including, but not limited to, Medical, Insurance, Finance and Law.
  • Demonstrate commitment to cultural sensitivity and working in a diverse environment.

  • Excellent listening, retention and note-taking skills to maintain a high level of accuracy during interpretation.

jobs.description:
ROLE OVERVIEW

Wesper is seeking a detail-oriented, analytical, and process-driven Junior Data Analyst to support our healthcare improvement project aimed at closing the diagnosis gap for Obstructive Sleep Apnea.

This role is critical to the initiative’s success, acting as the bridge between raw clinical data and actionable insights. You will work closely with our Program & Implementation Lead and our administering partner (Health Management Associates) to collect, validate, and visualize data from participating primary care clinics. You will help us track our "Model for Improvement" (PDSA) cycles, ensuring our run charts and Statistical Process Control (SPC) charts are accurate and up-to-date.

This is a high-impact, hands-on role perfect for someone who thrives in a fast-paced environment and is passionate about using data to improve patient outcomes.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Data Collection & Validation: Gather patient-level screening and diagnostic data from partner primary care clinics, ensuring strict adherence to HIPAA and data-sharing agreements.
  • Performance Tracking: Assist in building and maintaining run charts and Statistical Process Control (SPC) charts to track screening rates, referral conversion, and diagnostic yield.
  • Reporting Support: Prepare monthly and quarterly data summaries for the project team, our administering partner (HMA), and our sponsor.
  • AI-Enhanced Workflow Optimization: Utilize AI tools and LLMs to automate data cleaning, synthesize qualitative feedback from clinical staff, and accelerate the generation of insights from screening trends.
  • Workflow Support: Partner with the clinical team to support PDSA (Plan-Do-Study-Act) cycles, helping to document and measure the effectiveness of screening process changes in real-time.
  • Data Integrity: Maintain rigorous standards for data accuracy, identifying and flagging anomalies in site-reported data.
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Serve as a point of contact for clinic staff to facilitate smooth data transmission and resolve reporting bottlenecks.

QUALIFICATIONS & REQUIREMENTS

  • Education: Bachelor’s degree in Data Analytics, Health Informatics, Business, Statistics, or a related field.
  • Experience: 1–3 years of experience in data analysis, reporting, or healthcare operations.
  • AI Proficiency: Demonstrated ability to leverage AI-powered analytics tools (e.g., ChatGPT, Claude, or domain-specific health AI) to streamline data interpretation, summarize findings, and enhance analytical productivity.
  • Technical Proficiency: Advanced proficiency in Excel or Google Sheets (Pivot tables, VLOOKUP, data visualization/charting).
  • Analytical Mindset: Ability to synthesize complex datasets into clear, understandable trends for non-technical stakeholders.
  • Attention to Detail: Exceptional accuracy in record-keeping; experience with clinical or sensitive data is highly preferred.
  • Communication: Strong interpersonal skills; comfortable communicating with clinic staff and internal project leads.
  • Agility: Comfortable working in a remote-first, startup environment where priorities can shift as we iterate on processes

OUR TEAM—Built for Good

We pride ourselves on transparent communication—open discussion is critical to our performance and growth. We focus on accountability, humility, and constant learning. We believe in finding a better way through data and attention to detail. We work toward making sleep medicine easy, and we do it for our users.

ABOUT WESPER

Mission-driven startup aiming to make accurate sleep testing more convenient, affordable, and accessible.

Sleep disorders are a hidden epidemic that reduce quality and length of life for more than 10% of the population. The difficulty in diagnosing and monitoring sleep conditions is a major obstacle to the health of 100Ms of people worldwide.

Wesper is transforming the sleep industry by shrinking an entire sleep lab to a single wearable patch, helping millions live better, longer lives. Our platform delivers consumer comfort with clinical performance by using cutting-edge sensor design, a cloud-native suite of state-of-the-art algorithms, and a sleek mobile app, creating a seamless experience for both patient and doctor.

Opportunity

We are seeking a highly organized and results-driven Project Manager to lead the execution and ongoing coordination of our new OSA Healthcare Improvement Initiative. This role is the central hub for the program, responsible for ensuring that our PDSA-driven (Plan-Do-Study-Act) screening workflow is successfully implemented across 8 primary care sites.

You will serve as the primary bridge between Wesper leadership, our healthcare-improvement partner, and the participating clinical sites, ensuring all milestones are met and program outcomes are successfully tracked and reported. This is a contract role scheduled for a 1 year project with the possibility of extension and conversion to full time if the project moves into additional initiatives.

This is a remote opportunity.

Essential Duties & Responsibilities

  • Program Coordination & Roadmap Execution: Own the program roadmap (Phases 1–5), ensuring the initiative stays on track from the initial setup and baseline data collection to final scale, sustainment, and readout.
  • Stakeholder Liaison: Act as the primary point of contact for clinical site improvement teams, internal leadership, and our administering partner, ensuring clear, consistent communication of progress, hurdles, and successes.
  • Quality Improvement Oversight: Partner with the administering partner to facilitate practice improvement coaching, support weekly PDSA huddles at pilot sites, and maintain alignment across the cross-site learning collaborative.
  • Measurement & Reporting: Coordinate the collection and verification of performance data. Oversee the maintenance of run charts and SPC dashboards to track progress against our aim statement and priority measures, ensuring timely and accurate quarterly reporting.
  • Deliverable Management: Organize and track program deliverables, including the playbook, training curricula, and patient/staff education materials.
  • Operational Readiness: Manage site onboarding documentation, partnership agreements, and HIPAA/data-sharing compliance processes to ensure all sites are prepared to launch screening workflows.

Experience & Skills

  • Project Management Expertise: 3+ years of experience managing complex, multi-site healthcare projects or quality improvement initiatives.
  • Clinical/Quality Improvement Knowledge: Familiarity with clinical environments, primary care workflows, and Quality Improvement (QI) methodologies (e.g., PDSA, RE-AIM, run charts).
  • Strong Communicator: Exceptional ability to synthesize complex clinical and technical information and translate it into actionable plans for both clinical and non-clinical audiences.
  • Accountability-Driven: Proven ability to work independently, manage competing priorities in a fast-paced startup environment, and meet rigorous milestone-based deadlines.
  • Software Proficiency: Proficient in project management tools (Jira, Asana, etc.) and Google Workspace.
  • Educational Background: A degree in healthcare administration, public health, project management, or a related field.

OUR TEAM—Built for Good

We pride ourselves on transparent communication—open discussion is critical to our performance and growth. We focus on accountability, humility, and constant learning. We believe in finding a better way through data and attention to detail. We work toward making sleep medicine easy, and we do it for our users.

ABOUT WESPER

Mission-driven startup aiming to make accurate sleep testing more convenient, affordable, and accessible.

Sleep disorders are a hidden epidemic that reduce quality and length of life for more than 10% of the population. The difficulty in diagnosing and monitoring sleep conditions is a major obstacle to the health of 100Ms of people worldwide.

Wesper is transforming the sleep industry by shrinking an entire sleep lab to a single wearable patch, helping millions live better, longer lives. Our platform delivers consumer comfort with clinical performance by using cutting-edge sensor design, a cloud-native suite of state-of-the-art algorithms, and a sleek mobile app, creating a seamless experience for both patient and doctor.

jobs.description:
Customer Success Manager – HVAC & Plumbing | Inbound Sales & Scheduling | Remote

Position Type: Full-Time, Remote
Working Hours: U.S. Business Hours

About the Role

At Pavago, one of our clients is hiring a Customer Success Manager with hands-on HVAC and/or plumbing industry experience to manage inbound customer calls, convert service inquiries into booked appointments, coordinate scheduling, and deliver an excellent customer experience.

This is not a passive customer support role. Your performance will directly impact appointment bookings, revenue, membership sales, and customer retention.

As the first point of contact for customers needing HVAC or plumbing services, you’ll quickly understand their needs, communicate appropriate options, create confidence and urgency when necessary, and get the right service scheduled.

If you understand the home services industry and know how to turn inbound calls into booked appointments without sacrificing customer experience, this role is a strong fit.

What You’ll Own

Inbound Calls & Appointment Booking

  • Handle high-volume inbound HVAC and plumbing service calls
  • Convert customer inquiries into confirmed service appointments
  • Assist customers with:
    • Emergency service requests
    • Repairs and maintenance
    • Scheduling inquiries
    • General service questions
  • Ask effective questions to understand customer needs and service urgency
  • Build appropriate urgency and confidence to maximize booking rates
  • Guide customers toward clear next steps
  • Maintain a professional, helpful, and solutions-focused experience on every call

Scheduling & Dispatch Coordination

  • Schedule service appointments accurately based on customer needs and technician availability
  • Coordinate with dispatch and field teams to maintain an efficient schedule
  • Categorize service requests correctly
  • Capture complete customer, property, and appointment information
  • Follow scheduling and dispatch procedures consistently
  • Help minimize scheduling conflicts and missed opportunities
  • Communicate schedule-related updates clearly to customers and internal teams

Membership Sales & Upselling

  • Introduce HVAC and plumbing maintenance memberships when appropriate
  • Recommend relevant additional services based on customer needs
  • Clearly explain membership features and benefits
  • Handle common sales objections professionally
  • Identify opportunities to increase customer value without being overly aggressive
  • Contribute toward membership, booking, and conversion targets

Customer Experience & Retention

  • Provide empathetic, solutions-focused customer service
  • Handle frustrated or concerned customers calmly and professionally
  • Ensure customers feel heard, informed, and supported
  • Resolve routine concerns while escalating more complex issues appropriately
  • Follow up on open customer requests when necessary
  • Help create an experience that encourages repeat business and long-term loyalty
  • Take ownership of customer interactions through resolution

CRM & Documentation

  • Maintain accurate records of:
    • Customer information
    • Service requests
    • Appointment details
    • Call notes
    • Follow-up requirements
  • Keep CRM and scheduling records complete and current
  • Follow established call scripts, workflows, and documentation standards
  • Ensure accurate information is available to dispatch, technicians, and operations teams

Requirements

  • Previous HVAC and/or plumbing customer service experience is required
  • Proven experience converting inbound calls into booked service appointments
  • Strong phone communication and active listening skills
  • Experience with CRM, scheduling, dispatch, or customer service systems
  • Strong appointment scheduling and coordination skills
  • Experience with upselling or membership/service-plan sales
  • Confident objection-handling ability
  • Strong attention to detail and documentation accuracy
  • Excellent written and verbal English communication skills
  • Comfortable handling high-volume inbound customer interactions
  • Ability to work independently in a remote environment
  • Ability to work reliably during U.S. business hours

Nice to Have

  • Experience working directly with a U.S.-based HVAC or plumbing company
  • Experience in broader home services environments
  • Familiarity with HVAC maintenance plans or service memberships
  • Experience coordinating with technicians and dispatch teams
  • Experience working in a KPI-driven call center or customer service environment
  • Experience tracking booking, conversion, and membership sales performance

Tools & Technology

CRM Systems | Scheduling Platforms | Dispatch Systems | Customer Service Software | VOIP/Phone Systems | Digital Communication Tools

What Makes You a Strong Fit

You’ll likely thrive in this role if you:

  • Understand how HVAC and plumbing service calls work
  • Are comfortable handling a high volume of inbound calls
  • Can confidently guide customers toward booking
  • Are persuasive without sounding scripted or pushy
  • Stay calm when customers have urgent service problems
  • Balance excellent customer service with sales and conversion goals
  • Are comfortable introducing memberships and additional services
  • Work quickly while maintaining accurate records
  • Follow up consistently and take ownership through resolution
  • Understand that every customer interaction can impact both retention and revenue

What a Typical Day Looks Like

Your day may begin by reviewing open customer requests, scheduled appointments, and any follow-ups requiring attention.

Throughout the day, you’ll answer inbound HVAC and plumbing calls, identify customer needs and urgency, convert inquiries into booked appointments, and coordinate technician availability with dispatch.

You’ll also introduce maintenance memberships and relevant services, handle customer objections or concerns, update CRM records, and coordinate with operations teams to keep service requests moving.

You may finish by reviewing outstanding requests and monitoring booking and conversion performance.

In short: you turn inbound service inquiries into booked appointments, satisfied customers, and recurring revenue.

Key Metrics for Success

  • Call-to-booking conversion rate
  • Total appointments booked
  • Membership sales and close rate
  • Customer satisfaction and call quality
  • Scheduling accuracy and efficiency
  • CRM documentation accuracy
  • Response and call-handling times
  • Customer retention and repeat-service opportunities
  • Follow-up completion rates

Why This Role Stands Out

  • Direct impact on both customer experience and company revenue
  • High-ownership role with clear, measurable performance goals
  • Opportunity to combine customer service, inbound sales, scheduling, and home services operations
  • Stable full-time remote position
  • Exposure to fast-paced U.S. HVAC and plumbing operations
  • Career growth opportunities into:
    • Customer Service Team Lead
    • Senior Customer Success Manager
    • Dispatch / Scheduling Lead
    • Home Services Operations Manager

Interview Process

  1. Initial Application
  2. Spark Hire One-Way Video Interview
  3. Interview with Pavago Recruiter
  4. Client Interview
  5. Offer & Onboarding

Spark Hire Video Interview – Required

As part of the application process, all candidates are required to complete a one-way video interview through Spark Hire.

After completing the first step of your application, you’ll receive a Spark Hire invitation by email with instructions to record and submit your video responses.

Completion of the Spark Hire video is required to be considered for the next stage. Please check your inbox as well as your spam or junk folder for the invitation.

Apply Now

If you have HVAC or plumbing customer service experience, know how to convert inbound calls into appointments, and enjoy balancing customer care with sales performance, we’d love to hear from you.

Apply today and take direct ownership of bookings, membership sales, customer experience, and revenue performance within a fast-paced U.S. home services environment.

Job Description:

Seize your opportunity to make a personal impact supporting the Case Management Modernization (CMM) Program. The CMM program is an initiative to support the Administrative Office of the US Courts (AO) in developing a modern cloud-based solution to support all 204+ federal courts across the United States.

GDIT is your place to make meaningful contributions to challenging projects and grow a rewarding career. The UI/UX Human Centered Design Specialist ensures dashboards, reporting tools, predictive analytics screens, and AI/ML interfaces are intuitive, accessible, and aligned with Judiciary user workflows, supporting the CMM Data Modernization and Governance team in delivering data-driven decision-support tools in alignment with strict federal compliance requirements.

This role supports the Reporting, Analytics, and Artificial Intelligence/Machine Learning (AI/ML) deliverables by shaping user-centered visual designs for the Reporting & Analytics Capability and the Measurement Definitions and Decision-Support Package. By applying human-centered design (HCD) best practices to visualizations, navigation patterns, and decision-support experiences, this role enhances adoption and interpretability while ensuring designs meet Section 508, WCAG 2.1 AA, and federal digital service standards for accessibility, performance, and security.

The UI/UX Human Centered Design Specialist will execute the following responsibilities:

Reporting & Analytics

  • Design intuitive, accessible dashboards, self-service reporting interfaces, and predictive analytics screens for the CMM Reporting & Analytics Capability, applying Human-Centered Design (HCD) and usability best practices.
  • Translate UX research, personas, and journey maps into high-fidelity prototypes, wireframes, and interface design specifications for development teams.
  • Partner with BI Architects, data engineers, product owners, and developers to align visual designs with data models, KPIs, and reporting requirements.
  • Conduct usability testing, including heuristic evaluations, card sorting, and A/B testing, on dashboards and visualizations, and apply findings to refine designs each sprint.
  • Define and maintain visualization, navigation, and interaction design standards to ensure reports and dashboards are consistent, interpretable, and support adoption.
  • Design the user experience for the Measurement Definitions and Decision-Support Package, ensuring metrics and KPIs are presented in a clear, decision-ready format.
  • Evaluate designs for Section 508 and WCAG 2.1 AA accessibility compliance across all reporting and analytics interfaces.
  • Support rapid prototyping and iterative validation of dashboard and reporting designs within Agile sprint cycles.
  • Drive user adoption of dashboards and reporting tools by aligning navigation patterns and visual hierarchy with Judiciary user workflows.
  • Contribute standardized UI components and templates to the shared CMM design system for reuse across reporting products.

AI/ML Capabilities

  • Design intuitive, explainable interfaces for AI/ML-driven predictive analytics and decision-support features, ensuring model outputs are interpretable to end users.
  • Apply HCD principles to the presentation of AI/ML model outputs, confidence indicators, and recommendations to support responsible AI adoption.
  • Collaborate with AI/ML and data science teams to translate model capabilities into user-facing workflows aligned with federal responsible-AI requirements for transparency, fairness, and risk mitigation.
  • Conduct usability evaluations of AI/ML interfaces and incorporate feedback into iterative design refinements.

QUALIFICATIONS

  • MA/MS degree, or Bachelor's/Master's degree in Human-Computer Interaction (HCI), Design, or a related field, with 10+ years of general experience in information systems and 8+ years of specialized experience in UI/UX design, including 5+ years in a Human-Centered Design (HCD) role supporting enterprise or government applications.
  • Experience may be considered in lieu of degree as follows: HS (16+ years), AA/AS (14+ years), BA/BS (12+ years), Doctorate Degree/Ph.D. (9+ years).
  • Expertise in usability testing methodologies, such as heuristic evaluations, card sorting, and A/B testing, and proficiency in design and prototyping tools (Figma, Sketch, Axure, Storybook, or similar).
  • Strong understanding of Agile/SAFe delivery, iterative design integration, and DesignOps/UX governance practices.
  • Familiarity with HTML5, CSS3, and responsive UI behavior to collaborate effectively with front-end developers.
  • Experience designing for federal systems, with practical knowledge of Section 508 and WCAG 2.1 AA compliance.

COMMUNICATION & ORGANIZATIONAL

  • Excellent presentation and communication (oral and written) skills.
  • Consultant mindset with the ability to work with high level customer stakeholders and build excellent customer relationships.
  • Experience identifying and applying industry tools, solutions, methods best practices, and emerging technologies.
  • Strong analytical skills and problem-solving skills with the ability to formulate and communicate recommendations for improvement.
  • Demonstrated ability to work effectively, independently, and as part of a team.

CERTIFICATIONS (Preferred)

  • Certified Usability Analyst (CUA) or Certified HCD Professional
  • SAFe Agile Practitioner (SPC or SSM)
  • Section 508 Trusted Tester Certification
  • UX Design or HCD Certification (NN/g, IDEO, or HFI)

Working closely with Product Managers and Engineers, you’ll transform user insights into elegant, production-ready designs while ensuring consistency across the entire product ecosystem.

UX Research & Product Discovery

    • Mixpanel
    • Amplitude

  • Basic front-end knowledge:

Tools & Technologies

  • Figma
  • Adobe XD
  • Sketch
  • Mixpanel
  • Amplitude
  • Zeplin
  • Product Analytics Platforms
  • Collaboration & Project Management Tools

What a Typical Day Looks Like

  • Conduct user research and analyze product insights.
  • Design wireframes, prototypes, and polished user interfaces.
  • Build and refine scalable design systems.
  • Collaborate with Product Managers and Engineers on new features.
  • Run usability tests and improve user journeys.
  • Deliver developer-ready assets and documentation.
  • Iterate designs using customer feedback and analytics.

In short: You’ll design intuitive, scalable product experiences that improve usability, engagement, and customer satisfaction while helping shape the future of the product.

Key Metrics for Success (KPIs)

  • Improved usability and customer satisfaction.
  • Increased user engagement and feature adoption.
  • Higher product retention.
  • Reduced UX friction across key workflows.
  • Consistent implementation of scalable design systems.
  • On-time delivery of high-quality design assets.

Why Join Us?

  • Own the end-to-end product design experience.

  • Fully remote work environment with flexibility.
  • Clear growth opportunities into:
    • Senior Product Designer

    • Design Manager
    • Head of Design

Interview Process

  1. Spark Hire Intro Video (3–5 minutes)
  2. Portfolio Review
  3. Client Interview
  4. Offer & Onboarding

What Happens After You Apply

After submitting your application, you’ll receive an email invitation from Spark Hire to record a short 3–5 minute Intro Video. This is the first step in our hiring process and can be completed whenever it’s convenient for you.

Rather than repeating your experience across multiple screening calls, you’ll have one opportunity to introduce yourself, discuss your UX/UI design background, walk through your product design process, highlight relevant SaaS projects, and explain how you’ve approached user research, design systems, and cross-functional collaboration. Your video will be reviewed by the hiring team before moving to the portfolio review and client interview.

You can record your video as many times as you’d like before submitting it—only your final version will be reviewed.

Please keep an eye on both your inbox and spam folder for your Spark Hire invitation after applying.

The Senior Principal, Private Equity Sales is a senior individual contributor responsible for accelerating revenue growth through strategic relationships with private equity sponsors and their portfolio companies. This role develops executive-level relationships across the private equity ecosystem, identifies acquisitions, carve-outs, buy-and-build, modernization, and other investment events that create opportunities for Epicor, and builds scalable pipeline across assigned firms and portfolios. The Senior Principal is the direct seller for designated carve-out opportunities and a strategic sales overlay for other portfolio-company opportunities, operating with a high degree of autonomy and accountability for individual revenue and pipeline objectives.

What you will be doing:

  • Develop and execute strategic account plans for assigned private equity firms using portfolio mapping, install-base analysis, vertical and buy-and-build priorities, whitespace identification, and relationship-development strategies to prioritize expansion, cloud-transition, and new-logo opportunities.

  • Build multi-threaded relationships with operating partners, heads of value creation, portfolio technology leaders, investment professionals, portfolio executives, and other decision-makers, positioning Epicor as a strategic technology partner across the investment lifecycle.

  • Translate sponsor value-creation priorities, including EBITDA improvement, working-capital release, standardized reporting, integration, carve-out execution, and exit readiness, into differentiated narratives for both the PE sponsor and the portfolio-company economic buyer.

  • Serve as a strategic sales overlay for non-carve-out portfolio opportunities, partnering with territory, account, channel, and solution teams to develop deal strategies, navigate sponsor relationships, and advance qualified portfolio-company pipeline.

  • Build a referral and influence network with technology-diligence advisors, value-creation partners, systems integrators, and other ecosystem participants; orchestrate cross-functional resources across Sales, Solutions, Channel, Marketing, Customer Success, Finance, Legal, and Services.

  • Develop portfolio-wide commercial approaches, including preferred-vendor or master-service-agreement frameworks, standardized statements of work, implementation models, and repeatable sales plays that support multiple portfolio companies.

  • Maintain disciplined CRM management and forecast accuracy while measuring PE-sourced and PE-influenced pipeline separately; share portfolio intelligence, competitive trends, benchmark insights, and results that improve sales effectiveness across the Revenue organization.

  • Establish and manage practical leading and outcome measures for the PE motion, including sponsor engagement, referral activity, assessments, portfolio agreements, qualified opportunities, sourced and influenced pipeline, and closed-won results.

What you will likely bring:

  • Strong understanding of private equity business models and transaction stages, including acquisitions, diligence, carve-outs, buy-and-build strategies, portfolio value creation, operating-partner relationships, hold-period economics, and exit readiness.

  • Advanced strategic account planning, portfolio analysis, pipeline generation, consultative selling, executive engagement, systems-readiness discovery, negotiation, and deal orchestration capabilities.

  • Strong commercial and financial acumen with the ability to connect technology investments to EBITDA, working capital, operational improvement, growth, profitability, integration, and investment outcomes.

  • Exceptional cross-functional influence, communication, and relationship-building skills, including the ability to establish referral partnerships, lead complex initiatives without direct authority, and operate independently as a senior individual contributor.

What will could you apart:

  • 10+ years progressive experience in enterprise software, SaaS, technology, or complex solution sales.

  • 4+ years of experience selling to or working with private equity sponsors, private equity-backed companies, strategic enterprise accounts, or similarly complex investment-driven customer environments.

  • Demonstrated history of achieving or exceeding individual sales targets, generating significant new-business pipeline, and converting strategic relationships or ecosystem referrals into measurable revenue outcomes.

We help businesses stay future-ready by connecting people, processes, and technology. From software engineers who command the latest AI technology to business development reps who help us seize new opportunities, the work we do matters. jobs.excerpt: About UsSince 1989, SHI International Corp.  has helped organizations change the world through technology.
jobs.description:
About Us

Since 1989, SHI International Corp. has helped organizations change the world through technology. We’ve grown every year since, and today we’re proud to be a $16 billion global provider of IT solutions and services.

Over 17,000 organizations worldwide rely on SHI’s concierge approach to help them solve what’s next. But the heartbeat of SHI is our employees – all 7,000 of them. If you join our team, you’ll enjoy:

  • Our commitment to diversity, as the largest minority- and woman-owned enterprise in the U.S.

  • Continuous professional growth and leadership opportunities.

  • Health, wellness, and financial benefits to offer peace of mind to you and your family.

  • World-class facilities and the technology you need to thrive – in our offices or yours.

Job Summary

The Senior Director, Digital Workplace is accountable for the success, growth, and strategic direction of SHI's Digital Workplace organization within Microsoft Services. This leadership role brings together Collaboration, Workplace Platform, and Change Management under a single leader to ensure workplace technology, user adoption, and business outcomes are designed, delivered, and measured as one connected experience rather than as separate service lines.

This role leads the organization as a business, with ownership of service maturity, solution development, headcount planning, utilization, delivery quality, capacity, pipeline support, and measurable client outcomes across collaboration platforms, workplace modernization, identity and endpoint services, migrations, adoption, and organizational change. The Senior Director manages a team of managers and practice leaders responsible for Collaboration, Workplace Platform, and Change Management and remains accountable for their effectiveness, development, and delivery performance.

Aligned to Microsoft's Work IQ investments, this role connects how employees communicate, collaborate, access information, use workplace technology, and adopt new ways of working. The Senior Director ensures SHI helps clients deploy, secure, adopt, and realize value from Microsoft 365, Copilot, collaboration, identity, and endpoint capabilities across the full digital employee lifecycle.

This role sits at the center of SHI's Microsoft Services growth plan, turning Work IQ alignment into a working operating model that builds stronger solutions, improves delivery execution, develops talent, increases adoption, and creates repeatable paths for growth.

This is a remote position with a Home Office setup based in New York City, Charlotte, Chicago, Atlanta, Austin, Denver, Los Angeles, San Francisco, or Seattle.

Role Description

Strategic Leadership and Practice Development

  • Set and execute a unified direction for Digital Workplace, connecting Collaboration, Workplace Platform, and Change Management through one operating model.

  • Translate Microsoft's Work IQ, Microsoft 365, Copilot, identity, endpoint, and employee experience investments into a clear SHI services roadmap, capability plan, and investment agenda.

  • Establish clear ownership, decision rights, handoffs, delivery standards, and quality expectations across the organization.

  • Build modular, repeatable offerings that connect workplace technology, secure access, employee adoption, and value realization around defined client outcomes.

  • Use portfolio, pipeline, delivery, adoption, and capacity data to prioritize investments, manage tradeoffs, and improve practice health.

People Leadership Through Managers and Directors

  • Lead, coach, and develop the leaders responsible for Collaboration, Workplace Platform, and Change Management.

  • Set measurable expectations for customer experience, delivery quality, utilization, capability development, financial performance, adoption outcomes, and team health.

  • Build leadership depth through regular one-on-ones, development planning, succession planning, and clear career paths.

  • Own workforce planning across the organization, including hiring, onboarding, retention, skills development, and capacity alignment to backlog and pipeline.

  • Create a culture of shared accountability in which technical and change teams solve for the full customer outcome rather than optimize separate workstreams.

Technical Direction Across Workplace Technology, Change, and Security

  • Maintain a platform-aware perspective across Microsoft Teams, SharePoint, OneDrive, Exchange Online, Power Platform, Microsoft 365 Copilot, tenant migrations, identity modernization, Microsoft Intune, Windows 365, endpoint experience, and change enablement.

  • Guide the integration of Microsoft Entra, Conditional Access, Defender for Endpoint, Defender for Identity, and Defender for Office 365 into workplace solutions that protect users, devices, identities, messaging, and collaboration.

  • Ensure workplace solutions address user experience, accessibility, security, compliance, operational readiness, communications, training, adoption, and value realization from the beginning.

  • Sponsor reusable reference architectures, delivery frameworks, statements of work, work breakdown structures, migration patterns, adoption methods, templates, and accelerators.

  • Rely on practice leaders and principal architects for deep technical and change leadership while maintaining alignment across disciplines.

Delivery Excellence and Client Outcomes

  • Provide executive oversight for complex, multi-workstream engagements that span collaboration, tenant migrations, identity, endpoint, security, adoption, and change management.

  • Hold leaders accountable for scope quality, staffing readiness, delivery methodology, risk management, timelines, budgets, customer communication, and adoption outcomes.

  • Review project health, utilization, realization, margin, capacity, quality, adoption, and customer experience signals and act early when performance moves off plan.

  • Protect customer trust by ensuring teams make supportable commitments, manage business disruption, address security dependencies, and prepare customers to operate successfully after delivery.

  • Serve as an executive sponsor and trusted advisor for strategic clients, connecting workplace investments to employee productivity, business readiness, and measurable value.

Business Growth and Market Development

  • Grow Digital Workplace services revenue by improving solution relevance, supporting strategic pursuits, expanding enterprise client relationships, and developing repeatable offers.

  • Partner with Solution Architecture, Sales, Project Management, AI + Infrastructure, and Managed Services to shape opportunities and deliver connected customer outcomes.

  • Manage utilization, capacity, backlog, pipeline health, and delivery performance to improve profitability and support sustainable growth.

  • Build strong relationships with Microsoft field, engineering, and partner teams to align priorities, improve co-sell execution, and strengthen SHI's market credibility in Work IQ and Digital Workplace.

  • Capture customer evidence, references, adoption results, and measurable outcomes that support retention, expansion, and market recognition.

Executive and Cross-Functional Communication

  • Serve as an executive advisor to enterprise clients, connecting business priorities to Microsoft workplace, collaboration, identity, endpoint, Copilot, and change strategies.

  • Communicate practice priorities, portfolio health, performance, risks, and investment needs to senior leadership, including the Vice President, Microsoft Services.

  • Run a consistent operating cadence across leaders that covers pipeline, staffing, project health, financial performance, capability development, customer experience, and adoption outcomes.

  • Turn operating data and customer feedback into decisions and actions rather than reporting activity without accountability.

  • Escalate delivery, capacity, security, adoption, and customer risks early, with clear options and recommended actions.

Behaviors and Competencies

  • Strategic Thinking: Can analyze complex situations, drive organizational transformation, and adapt strategies to changing market conditions.

  • Leadership: Can lead strategic team initiatives, inspire others to take leadership roles, and foster a culture of shared responsibility and continuous improvement.

  • Communication: Can lead and model exceptional communication at all levels of the organization, develop and implement communication strategies, and coach others to improve their communication skills.

  • Collaboration: Can lead complex team projects, inspire others to collaborate effectively, and foster a culture of mutual respect and shared purpose.

  • Problem-Solving: Can lead strategic problem-solving initiatives, inspire others to improve their problem-solving skills, and foster a culture of proactive problem-solving.

  • Customer-Centric Mindset: Can lead strategic initiatives focused on improving the overall customer experience. Inspires and mentors others to adopt a customer-centric approach, fostering a culture of customer focus throughout the organization.

  • Results Orientation: Can inspire a culture of results-orientation across the organization, setting high standards and holding everyone accountable for achieving results.

  • Adaptability: Can drive strategic transformations, inspire others to embrace change, and foster a culture of continuous adaptation.

  • Strategic Implementation: Can lead the development and execution of comprehensive strategic plans, inspire and guide teams, and drive organizational change to achieve strategic objectives.

  • Continuous Improvement: Can lead others in identifying and implementing major improvements and proactively drive continuous improvement across the organization.

Skill Level Requirements

  • Bachelor's degree in a technical, business, organizational development, or related field, or equivalent practical experience.

  • 10 or more years of progressive leadership experience in technology services, consulting, digital workplace, organizational change, or related Microsoft practices.

  • 5 or more years leading managers, directors, senior technical leaders, or multi-discipline delivery organizations with accountability for people, delivery, and business performance.

  • Demonstrated success building or scaling professional services capabilities, repeatable offerings, and complex enterprise delivery motions.

  • Strong working knowledge of Microsoft 365, Teams, SharePoint, Exchange Online, OneDrive, Power Platform, Copilot, Entra, Intune, Windows 365, endpoint security, tenant migrations, and adoption and change management.

  • Experience managing utilization, capacity, staffing, delivery quality, portfolio health, adoption outcomes, and financial performance.

  • Ability to engage enterprise executives, translate business priorities into workplace technology and change roadmaps, and guide complex decisions.

  • Track record of partnering across sales, presales, project management, managed services, technology teams, and business stakeholders to grow customer relationships.

  • Relevant certifications may include Microsoft 365, Teams, Endpoint Administrator, Identity and Access Administrator, Microsoft 365 Copilot, Prosci, CCMP, or comparable workplace and change management credentials. Equivalent experience and demonstrated leadership may substitute for specific certifications.

  • Candidates should not self-select out if they do not meet all of these qualifications.

Your Success at SHI

People who are successful in this role tend to demonstrate:

  • Strong ownership of a multi-discipline services organization, connecting technical direction, employee experience, change leadership, and business performance.

  • The ability to connect collaboration, workplace platforms, secure access, and change management into practical solutions that clients can adopt and operate.

  • A talent development mindset that grows managers and practice leaders into confident, accountable leaders.

  • Comfort using portfolio, delivery, adoption, and customer data to guide staffing, coaching, investment, and escalation decisions.

  • Strong collaboration across Solution Architecture, Delivery, Project Management, AI + Infrastructure, Managed Services, Sales, and Microsoft.

  • A genuine commitment to customer experience, delivery quality, employee adoption, security, and the long-term growth of SHI's Microsoft Services practice.

Other Requirements

  • Ability to work independently while collaborating effectively with executives, managers, technical leaders, sales teams, and customer stakeholders.

  • Ability to travel to support client engagements, Microsoft alignment, leadership meetings, and internal enablement, up to 25%.

  • Commitment to continuous learning as Microsoft workplace, Copilot, identity, endpoint, security, and employee experience capabilities evolve.

  • Strong ethical standards with disciplined attention to privacy, governance, compliance, security, and responsible AI.

The estimated annual pay range for this position is $225,000 - $325,000 which includes a base salary and bonus. The compensation for this position is dependent on job-related knowledge, skills, experience, and market location and, therefore, will vary from individual to individual. jobs.description:
About Kinetic

At Kinetic, we’re redefining operational excellence in higher education, conferencing, and events. As the leading provider of software solutions for student accommodation, event management, catering, and residential services, we help institutions streamline operations, elevate customer experiences, and unlock their full potential.

With over 25 years of experience and trusted by more than 350 institutions worldwide, our software empowers universities and venues to run smarter, faster, and more collaboratively. From bustling campuses to dynamic corporate environments, our technology adapts to the rhythm of each organisation — helping them thrive in a fast-changing world.

But we’re more than just software. We’re a team of passionate problem-solvers, innovators, and collaborators who care deeply about our customers and each other. Our culture is built on empowerment, community, and continuous growth. We believe in giving people the tools, support, and freedom to do their best work — and have fun while doing it.

Joining Kinetic means being part of a purpose-driven business where your ideas matter, your development is supported, and your impact is real. If you’re ready to help shape the future of operational technology in education and events, we’d love to meet you.

The Role

This is a chance to be a genuine change-maker in US higher education — and one of the most compelling sales opportunities in the market right now.

Kinetic is the global market leader in enterprise software for student housing, residence life, conferencing, events, and campus operations. We've been doing this since 1998. More than 350 institutions across the world run on our platform. We are trusted, proven, and battle-tested at scale.

And yet, in the United States, most residence life and housing teams have never heard of us.

That's the opportunity.

There are only two vendors in the world capable of handling the deep, complex operational demands of large-scale student housing at the enterprise level. We are one of them. Until recently, US institutions haven't had a genuine choice. Many are running on legacy systems they've outgrown — systems that frustrate their teams and limit what they can deliver for students. Now there's a credible alternative, with a 27-year track record of transforming operations at institutions just like theirs.

This role is about closing. It takes a seasoned new logo hunter — someone who knows how to build conviction in an uninformed audience, navigate complex institutional sales cycles, and drive decisions in an environment where inertia is the enemy. You won't just be opening doors; you'll be walking through them, winning over stakeholders at every level, and bringing home contracts that mark the beginning of decades-long partnerships.

Once you close, you hand over to a dedicated customer delivery and success team who take ownership of the relationship — so you can stay focused on hunting. But make no mistake: the partnerships you create are permanent. Kinetic is part of Volaris Group and Constellation Software, a buy-and-hold acquirer — we will never be sold. The institutions that choose us are choosing a partner that will be there for the long haul, investing in their success year after year. What you win, we keep — and we build on — forever.

If you're a top-tier new logo closer who wants to do meaningful work — not just hit a number — this role was built for you.

Who We Are

Kinetic is part of Volaris Group, a division of Constellation Software Inc. — one of the largest software companies in the world. Constellation is a buy-and-hold acquirer. We are never sold. We grow, we invest, and we build for the long term alongside other global market leaders in education technology and beyond.

That backing matters. It means the resources, the stability, and the ambition to win in the US market — for good.

What You'll Be Doing

  • Own and drive new logo acquisition across the US higher education market, with a focus on housing, residence life, conferencing, events, and campus operations teams

  • Build pipeline from scratch through targeted outreach, relationship development, industry networking, and creative prospecting across multiple channels

  • Run discovery calls and product demonstrations — remote and on-site - that connect Kinetic's capabilities to each institution's specific operational challenges

  • Navigate complex, multi-stakeholder sales cycles involving procurement, IT, housing leadership, and executive sponsors

  • Lead RFP responses in a disciplined, organized way that keeps your pipeline moving

  • Represent Kinetic at trade shows and conferences — generating leads, building brand presence, and learning the market

  • Negotiate contracts and close agreements that create long-term value for both sides

  • Keep your CRM immaculate and your follow-up relentless

  • Stay close to industry trends in higher education and residence life — and use that knowledge to open more doors

What You’ll Bring

Sales Track Record

  • Proven success in SaaS new logo sales — you hit your number and you have the receipts

  • Experience selling into higher education, residence life, student services, or comparable institutional markets

  • A track record of displacing incumbent systems — you know how to build the case for change

  • Strong ability to prospect independently across outbound channels

How You Work

  • You are a hunter by nature — you create momentum where none exists

  • You are curious, commercially sharp, and skilled at uncovering pain in complex organizations

  • You communicate clearly and persuasively — in calls, in demos, and in writing

  • You are organized, disciplined, and relentless in your follow-through

  • You are resilient — you don't need the market to come to you

Why Kinetic

We are a high-performance business — and we mean that in the truest sense. Not pressure for its own sake, but a thriving environment where everyone is pushing forward together, challenging each other, and delivering for colleagues and customers alike. We span multiple countries. We don't do silos.

We operate on a simple belief: high challenge and high support go hand in hand. We will push you outside your comfort zone — regularly. We expect you to make mistakes. We want you to. Because in this business, mistakes mean you're moving, learning, and growing — and when our people grow, the business grows. We believe in accountability, not blame. There are no losers on a winning team, and no winners on a losing team.

Sales is the lifeblood of what we do. When we're winning new customers, everyone feels it — the energy, the momentum, the sense that something real is being built. This role is at the spearhead of that. Kinetic has been in the US market since 2006, and since bringing our student housing software stateside two years ago, the business has been in hyper growth — and the person in this seat is central to keeping that momentum going.

We have a people-first mindset — with our team and with our customers. We all have two ears and one mouth, and we try to use them in that proportion. We don't tell customers how to do their jobs. We ask, we listen, and we work to understand what's holding them back — and then we help remove their barriers. That's the culture we bring to every relationship, internal and external.

We also believe in having fun. Genuinely. A thriving business is an enjoyable one, and we work hard to make sure this is a place people love to be.

Our values are leadership, community, student success, and the KxFactor. The KxFactor is the hardest of those to define — and perhaps the most important. It's that quality you notice when you spend time with someone from Kinetic. An authenticity. An energy. A way of showing up that makes people want to work alongside you and stay in your orbit. You can't manufacture it. You'll know if you have it — and so will we.

Benefits & Perks

Why You’ll Love Working at Kinetic

  • Fully remote – work from anywhere in the US

  • Flexible working hours – we focus on outcomes, not clock-watching

  • Competitive package- Year 1 OTE $200,000

  • Annual performance bonus – share in the success you help create

  • Be authentically you – we value individuality and diverse perspectives

Health & Wellbeing

Practice Operations Management oversees the business and administrative operations of medical practices.

The revenue cycle shadows the entire patient care journey and begins with patient appointment scheduling and ends when the patient’s account balance is zero.

About Us

Simprints is a nonprofit tech company with a mission to radically increase transparency and effectiveness in global development. We build ethical, inclusive digital ID powered by biometrics to verify that health, aid, and services truly reach people. Simprints partners with organizations like Gavi to boost immunization rates in developing countries, Ministries of Health like Ghana on pandemic response, and NGOs like BRAC to deliver maternal healthcare. Studies have shown Simprints increases impact through real-time, precision data, for example increasing maternal health visits by 38% in Bangladesh or accurate HIV tracing by 62% in Malawi. Today we’ve worked in over 17 countries helping deliver health, aid, and finance to >3M people. Our goal is to transform the way the world fights poverty, ensuring that every vaccine, every dollar, and every public good reaches the people who need them most.

Department Overview

Primary Function: The Finance team at Simprints manages the company’s financial health, ensuring resources are allocated effectively to support the organisation’s mission. They provide strategic financial planning, budget management, and ensure compliance with financial regulations.

Key Goals:

  • Ensure effective financial planning and budget management to support organisational growth.
  • Maintain compliance with financial regulations and reporting standards.
  • Optimise resource allocation to maximise impact and operational efficiency.

Join Our Finance Talent Pool at Simprints

Are you a finance professional passionate about driving impact in the international development sector? At Simprints, we’re always looking for talented individuals to join our mission of transforming global development through cutting-edge technology. Whether you specialise in financial management, accounting, grants management, or strategic financial planning, we want to hear from you!

What We Do in Finance

Our Finance team plays a crucial role in ensuring Simprints’ financial health, sustainability, and compliance. We manage budgets, optimise financial processes, and provide strategic insights that enable our teams to scale operations and maximise impact. Working in Finance at Simprints means helping us build a strong financial foundation to support life-changing projects worldwide.

Who We’re Looking For

✔ Financial Planning & Analysis (FP&A)

✔ Accounting & Audit (including IFRS, GAAP, and donor compliance)

✔ Procurement & Risk Management

Experience in international development, social enterprises, or working with NGOs is a huge plus! If you're excited about using finance to support global impact, submit your CV today—we’d love to explore how you can be part of the Simprints journey. 🚀

  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Work with program, product, and operations teams to align financial planning with organisational goals.
  • International & Multi-Currency Accounting: Manage financial operations across multiple countries, ensuring compliance with international regulations.

Benefits

5 Reasons to Join Simprints

Life is short. We believe work should be inspirational, meaningful and fun. At Simprints, we’re taking on global development’s biggest challenges, powered by an amazing culture and incredible people. Work with us, and you will grow faster, learn more, and take on great responsibilities with the potential to make lasting change.

But don’t take our word for it—we’re an externally recognized Great Place to Work, part of the Flexa Top 100 Most Flexible Companies and a 2022 Best Workplace for Women.

Whether it's managing life's essentials like healthcare appointments or adapting work hours to match your peak productivity times, we've got you covered. In return, we count on your reciprocal flexibility when mission-critical moments arise, like stepping up for a crucial client discussion on a Friday or tackling unexpected technical glitches beyond regular hours.

    1. We offer a 4-day workweek, meaning everybody has the option to have Fridays off.

Our commitment to this model's success is solidified through semi-annual productivity assessments with our board, ensuring that our high standards of performance are consistently met.
