Job Description:

Own your opportunity to turn data into measurable outcomes for our customers’ most complex challenges. As a Data Architect Principal at GDIT, you’ll power innovation to drive mission impact and grow your expertise to power your career forward.

This role exists to design the infrastructure that turns new Partner data, as it lands in a multi-billion-record, multi-payer healthcare claims warehouse (the HFPP Trusted Third Party), into automated fraud, waste, and abuse (FWA) alerts.

You'll own the technical standards that infrastructure gets built and extended against, with real sign-off on the pipeline's architecture and technology choices, and you'll build the hardest parts of it yourself while working alongside a Data Engineer responsible for building and monitoring this pipeline.

Fraud-signal methodology stays with Data Science, and PII/PHI handling policy stays with a separate compliance function; your sign-off covers the pipeline architecture itself. You'll report through the analytic leadership and work alongside several technical and investigative teams.

HOW A DATA ARCHITECT PRINICPAL WILL MAKE AN IMPACT:

  • Design the architecture for the event-driven pipeline that carries new Partner data from the HFPP warehouse into deployed fraud signals and out to Partner alerts: the data flow, the integration points with the warehouse and the HFPP Portal's analytics extension, and the AWS and Snowflake choices that hold it together.

  • Own sign-off on that architecture and any material change to it. If a new signal's requirements would strain the design, that decision runs through you.

  • Set the standards the pipeline is built to; how it absorbs a spike in Partner data, what happens when a signal's scoring job fails partway through, how a new signal gets onboarded without destabilizing the ones already live.

  • Build the hardest pieces yourself. Proof-of-concept integrations, the trickiest parts of the event-driven design, anything you don't want to hand off until the pattern's actually proven. This isn't a paper-architecture role.

  • Design within the data-security and PII/PHI constraints a separate compliance function sets for this claims data.

  • Work with Data Science on how an approved fraud signal's logic gets represented in the pipeline, and track the government review and approval cadence closely enough that the architecture can absorb new signals on schedule.

WHAT YOU'LL NEED TO SUCCEED:

  • Bachelor's degree in computer science, engineering, or a related field, or equivalent hands-on experience.

  • 8+ years designing and owning production data architecture, including at least one event-driven or streaming pipeline you built and ran at real scale.

  • Deep hands-on experience with AWS and Snowflake, including designing event-driven ingestion patterns that reliably feed a warehouse-native scoring/analytics layer.

  • Strong Python and SQL, enough to build the pieces you design yourself rather than only diagram them.

  • Experience designing systems that operate under real data-security/compliance constraints (PII/PHI or comparable sensitive data), working with a separate security function rather than owning that policy.

  • A track record of setting or reviewing architecture standards other engineers are held to, including saying no to a design that misses the bar.

  • Comfortable working independently in a fully remote environment with sign-off authority and no direct reports.

DESIRED QUALIFICATIONS AND EXPERIENCE:

  • Experience with healthcare claims data or another highly regulated, high-scrutiny data domain.

  • Experience designing alerting/notification systems tied to a customer- or partner-facing portal.

  • Experience with fraud or anomaly-detection pipelines specifically, even outside healthcare.

  • Experience presenting architecture decisions to a government or compliance reviewer, such as a contracting officer's representative or an auditor.

jobs.description:
Overview

We are seeking a dynamic, strategic, and results driven Business Development Manager to join our team. The ideal candidate will drive growth and expand market presence for bioanalytical solutions across academic institutions, government research labs, core facilities, non‑profit research centres, CROs and Pharma Discovery Labs.

This role places strong emphasis on communicating the value of LC‑MS–based and flow cytometry bioanalytical endpoints to diverse scientific communities. You will collaborate closely with regional sales and marketing teams, develop targeted commercial plans for academic and research markets, and build trusted relationships with institutional stakeholders, PIs, core directors, and scientific staff.

This is a remote position, with flexibility to work from any location in the US ( with preference to west coast US)

Responsibilities

Lead Generation & Market Expansion

  • Identify and pursue new business opportunities across academic departments, shared resource facilities, government labs, and pharma research organizations.
  • Generate and qualify leads through scientific networking, campus visits, conferences, workshops, and digital outreach.

Sales Funnel Management

  • Develop and execute strategies to broaden adoption of bioanalytical technologies in research-intensive organisations.
  • Maintain an accurate sales pipeline and provide reliable forecasting for the target customer segment.

Sales Support

  • Collaborate with regional sales and marketing teams to convert academic and research opportunities into orders.
  • Support the sales process through technical presentations, workflow discussions, demonstrations, and proposal/quote negotiation.

Tactical Sales Planning

  • Develop and implement sales plans tailored to academic funding cycles, grant landscapes, and institutional priorities.
  • Set and monitor target performance to ensure goals aligned with the Annual Operating Plan (AOP) are achieved or exceeded.

Sales Enablement

  • Deliver remote and in person‑ training for sales and marketing teams focused on academic bioanalytical workflows, research applications, and adoption drivers.
  • Provide tools, content, and positioning strategies designed specifically for academic and government research environments.

Sales & Marketing Initiatives

  • Use virtual platforms, academic seminar programs, webinars, and outreach events to expand awareness and build the funnel in academic and pharmaceutical discovery markets
  • Create and execute promotional initiatives aligned with academic research trends and institutional needs.

Customer Relationship Management

  • Build and maintain strong, long term‑ relationships with principal investigators, lab managers, core directors, and research administration.
  • Collect and communicate customer insights, research challenges, and success stories to guide commercial strategy.
  • Ensure exceptional customer service to support recurring business and long‑term partnerships.

Sales Reporting & Analysis

  • Provide regular updates on performance, market dynamics, grant trends, and customer feedback to the Pharma Program Lead.
  • Use data-driven insights to adjust strategies and maximize success in the target customer segment.

Technical Expertise

  • Maintain a strong working knowledge of quantitative and qualitative LC‑MS, flow cytometry, and complementary analytical technologies.
  • Communicate technical and workflow advantages effectively to scientific audiences with varying levels of expertise.

Product Development Input

  • Capture feedback from researchers, core facility staff, and field sales teams to support ongoing refinement of bioanalytical solutions.

Cross‑Functional Collaboration

  • Partner with sales, marketing, product management, and the broader Waters Analytical Science business segment to deliver cohesive, research-focused solutions to customers.

Qualifications

Education

  • Bachelor’s degree in a lifescience related‑ field.
  • An MBA or a Master’s/PhD in a scientific discipline is highly advantageous.

Experience

  • Minimum 5 years of experience in sales or business development serving academic, government, or pharmaceutical scientific markets.
  • Demonstrated ability to assess research needs and translate them into effective commercial strategies.
  • Proficiency with Salesforce CRM and business analytics tools for managing pipelines, forecasting, and account planning, as well as Microsoft Office suite.

Skills and Abilities

Strategic Sales & Marketing

  • Ability to identify, target, and engage high value‑ research institutions and Pharmaceutical Discovery customers.
  • Skilled in developing marketing strategies tailored to academic research cycles and organizational structures.

Networking & Relationship Management

  • Proven ability to build long-term relationships across universities, core facilities, research institutes, and Pharmaceutical Discovery labs.
  • Excellent interpersonal communication skills that enable connection with researchers, Lab Directors and internal teams.

Analytical & Negotiation Skills

  • Strong analytical mindset to interpret scientific trends, grant funding patterns, and organisational priorities.
  • Effective negotiation skills for instrument sales, multi-group purchases, and service or workflow agreements.

Communication & Presentation

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills; able to clearly present complex scientific solutions.
  • Creative self-starter who can design and execute impactful customer engagement programs.
  • Ability to motivate and influence cross-functional teams.

Technical Expertise

  • Deep understanding of liquid chromatography, mass spectrometry, and flow cytometry as applied to academic, Pharmaceutical Discovery and translational research.
  • Ability to communicate research applications, workflow integration, and value propositions to diverse scientific audiences.

Travel Requirement

  • Willingness to travel up to 50% for campus visits, seminars, conferences, customer meetings, and team activities.

Reporting Line

  • Reports directly to the Pharma lead within the LCMS Business Segment in the Analytical Sciences Division

Company Description

Waters Corporation (NYSE:WAT) is a global leader in life sciences and diagnostics, dedicated to accelerating the benefits of pioneering science through analytical technologies, informatics, and service. With a focus on regulated, high-volume testing environments, our innovative portfolio harnesses deep scientific expertise across chemistry, physics, and biology. We collaborate with customers around the world to advance the release of effective, high-quality medicines, ensure the safety of food and water, and drive better patient outcomes by detecting diseases earlier, managing routine infections, and combating antibiotic resistance. Position Type: Full-Time, Remote

About the Role

At Pavago, one of our clients is hiring an experienced Senior Media Buyer to lead the strategy, execution, and optimization of paid social campaigns across multiple client accounts.

This is a senior, hands-on role where you’ll own the full lifecycle of Facebook and Instagram (Meta) advertising campaigns—from campaign planning and creative strategy to optimization and scaling. You’ll collaborate with clients and internal teams to improve campaign performance, lower acquisition costs, and maximize return on ad spend (ROAS).

If you’re passionate about performance marketing, enjoy testing new ideas, and thrive on delivering measurable business results, this role is a strong fit.

What You’ll Own

Campaign Strategy & Management

  • Build, launch, and manage Meta advertising campaigns from strategy through execution.
  • Manage multiple client accounts while ensuring each campaign achieves performance goals.
  • Optimize:
    • Campaign structures
    • Audiences
    • Placements
    • Bidding strategies
    • Budgets
  • Scale high-performing campaigns while maintaining profitability.

Performance Optimization

  • Monitor campaign performance daily.
  • Analyze key metrics including:
    • Cost Per Lead (CPL)
    • Cost Per Acquisition (CPA)
    • Return on Ad Spend (ROAS)
    • Click-Through Rate (CTR)
    • Cost Per Click (CPC)
    • Conversion Rate
  • Test:
    • New audiences
    • Offers
    • Ad creatives
    • Landing pages
    • Campaign strategies
  • Continuously optimize campaigns to improve lead quality and reduce acquisition costs.

Creative Strategy

  • Develop creative concepts, messaging, and campaign angles.
  • Write detailed creative briefs for designers and video editors.
  • Collaborate with creative teams to produce high-performing advertisements.
  • Analyze creative performance and recommend ongoing testing opportunities.

Client Communication & Reporting

  • Present campaign performance updates to clients and internal stakeholders.
  • Prepare performance reports with actionable recommendations.
  • Recommend strategies to scale successful campaigns and improve underperforming accounts.
  • Build strong client relationships through proactive communication and strategic guidance.

Growth & Innovation

  • Stay current with Meta platform updates and advertising best practices.
  • Identify opportunities to improve campaign efficiency and results.
  • Test new automation tools, optimization techniques, and advertising strategies.
  • Contribute ideas that improve agency performance and client outcomes.

What Success Looks Like

  • Campaigns consistently meet or exceed performance goals.
  • Advertising budgets scale profitably while maintaining strong ROAS.
  • Acquisition costs decrease through continuous optimization.
  • Clients receive strategic recommendations backed by data.
  • Creative testing drives measurable campaign improvements.
  • Client satisfaction and long-term retention remain high.

What Makes You a Strong Fit

  • You combine creativity with strong analytical thinking.
  • You enjoy testing, learning, and optimizing campaigns.
  • You can confidently manage multiple client accounts simultaneously.
  • You make decisions based on data rather than assumptions.
  • You communicate campaign performance clearly to clients and internal teams.
  • You thrive in a fast-paced, remote environment where ownership matters.

Required Experience & Skills

Experience

  • 3+ years of hands-on experience managing Meta (Facebook & Instagram) advertising campaigns.
  • Proven experience managing $10,000+ per month in advertising spend.
  • Experience managing five or more client accounts simultaneously.
  • Strong knowledge of:
    • Meta Ads Manager
    • Meta Business Manager
    • Meta Pixel
    • Conversion API (CAPI)
    • Event Tracking
  • Experience optimizing campaigns for:
    • Lead Generation
    • Customer Acquisition
  • Strong analytical skills with the ability to interpret campaign data and make optimization decisions.
  • Experience developing creative strategies and writing detailed creative briefs.
  • Excellent written and verbal English communication skills.
  • Ability to work independently in a fast-paced remote environment.

Nice to Have

  • Experience using:
    • GoHighLevel (GHL)
    • Close CRM
    • Similar CRM platforms
  • Experience working in a digital marketing agency.
  • Familiarity with:
    • Landing Page Optimization
    • Conversion Rate Optimization (CRO)
  • Experience using AI tools to improve campaign performance and creative workflows.
  • Experience working with U.S.-based clients.

Tech Stack

  • Meta Ads Manager
  • Meta Business Manager
  • Meta Pixel
  • Conversion API (CAPI)
  • GoHighLevel (GHL)
  • Close CRM
  • Google Analytics
  • Google Workspace
  • AI productivity tools (ChatGPT, Claude, Microsoft Copilot, or similar)

What a Typical Day Looks Like

  • Review campaign performance dashboards.
  • Monitor spend, ROAS, CPA, CPL, and conversion metrics.
  • Optimize audiences, creatives, placements, and bidding strategies.
  • Develop creative concepts and collaborate with designers.
  • Meet with clients to discuss campaign performance and recommendations.
  • Launch new campaigns and A/B tests.
  • Analyze results and implement optimization strategies.
  • Stay informed on Meta platform updates and emerging advertising trends.

In short: You’ll own the strategy, execution, optimization, and scaling of Meta advertising campaigns, helping clients achieve measurable business growth through data-driven paid social marketing.

Key Metrics for Success (KPIs)

  • Return on Ad Spend (ROAS).
  • Cost Per Acquisition (CPA).
  • Cost Per Lead (CPL).
  • Click-Through Rate (CTR).
  • Conversion Rate.
  • Client retention and satisfaction.
  • Campaign scalability and profitability.
  • Creative testing performance.

Why This Role Stands Out

  • Lead high-impact Meta advertising campaigns for multiple client accounts.
  • Collaborate with clients and creative teams to deliver measurable business results.
  • Manage significant advertising budgets while driving continuous optimization.
  • Work with modern advertising tools and emerging AI technologies.
  • Fully remote work environment aligned with U.S. business hours.
  • Career progression into:
    • Lead Media Buyer
    • Paid Media Manager
    • Performance Marketing Manager
    • Director of Paid Media

Interview Process

  1. Application Review
  2. Spark Hire Intro Video (3–5 minutes)
  3. Client Interview
  4. Offer & Onboarding

What Happens After You Apply

After submitting your application, you’ll receive an email invitation from Spark Hire to record a short 3–5 minute Intro Video. This is the first step in our hiring process and can be completed whenever it’s convenient for you.

Instead of repeating your experience across multiple screening calls, you’ll have one opportunity to introduce yourself and showcase your expertise in managing Meta advertising campaigns, optimizing performance, scaling ad spend, and improving ROAS across multiple client accounts. You’ll also be able to demonstrate your analytical approach, creative strategy experience, and how you’ve partnered with clients to deliver measurable marketing results.

Record your video as many times as you’d like before submitting it—only your final version will be reviewed.

Please keep an eye on both your inbox and spam folder for your Spark Hire invitation after applying.

Apply Now

If you’re passionate about paid social advertising, enjoy turning data into growth strategies, and thrive on scaling high-performing Meta campaigns, we’d love to hear from you. Apply today and help businesses achieve exceptional results through world-class performance marketing.

jobs.description:
Remote AI Automation Consultant (Contract/Freelance)

3rd Wave | Remote | Project-based

About the role

3rd Wave is a UK-based AI automation consultancy. We design and build AI agents and workflow automation for SMBs, connecting the systems they already use so information moves between them without manual effort.

We're building a pool of remote consultants to help deliver our pipeline of client projects. Work is project-based, so you'll pick up engagements that fit your skills and availability rather than committing to a single long-term role.

What you'll be doing

Every project is different, but the shape is consistent: you'll be integrating business systems (CRMs, job boards, document tools, spreadsheets, communication platforms) via APIs and browser automation, building orchestrated workflows, and layering in AI where it adds real value, always with a clear audit trail and a human able to stay in control.

Typical work includes:

  • Building automated workflows that connect two or more business systems end to end

  • Designing data pipelines that pull from external sources (APIs, scrapers, browser automation) and land clean, structured data somewhere useful

  • Building AI-assisted steps into a workflow (extraction, classification, drafting, summarisation) with human review built in

  • Producing clear handover documentation so non-technical clients can run and maintain what you've built

What we're looking for

We care more about how you think than which specific tools you've used. The common thread across our work is systems integration and automation, so you should be someone who genuinely enjoys wiring disparate tools together and making messy manual processes disappear.

You'll likely be a strong fit if you have:

  • Solid experience with a workflow automation platform (n8n, Make, Zapier, or similar) — n8n specifically is a big plus

  • Confidence working directly with REST APIs, webhooks, and authentication flows

  • Experience with no-code/low-code data platforms such as Airtable, Clay, or

  • A working understanding of how to bring AI into a workflow sensibly: prompting, extracting structured output, and knowing when a human needs to check the result

  • How to create one shot prompts for agent prompts

  • Comfort with browser automation tools (e.g. Apify, Airtop, or similar) for the sites and services that don't offer a clean API

  • Good diagnostic instincts — able to trace a broken pipeline back to its root cause rather than just patching symptoms

  • Clear written communication, since you'll often be producing documentation a non-technical client relies on

You don't need to tick every box above. We'd rather hear from someone with deep strength in a few of these than a shallow pass through all of them.

How we work

  • All projects are scoped in a detailed Statement of Work before work begins, so you'll always know the deliverables, timeline and assumptions upfront

  • Projects typically run 2 to 6 weeks, though some clients have longer multi-phase programmes

  • Remote and asynchronous by default, with discovery workshops and check-ins as needed

  • You'll usually be working directly with the client's team during discovery and testing phases, not just building in isolation

To apply

Tell us about a system integration or automation project you're proud of, what tools you used, and what made it hard.

What will your job entail?

Underwriting & Portfolio Management

  • Underwrite and manage a transportation-focused renewal portfolio, balancing profitability, retention, and service objectives.

  • Contribute to a positive, team-oriented culture by sharing knowledge, market insights, and best practices.

  • Support organizational growth initiatives and continuous improvement efforts.

  • Ensure compliance with underwriting guidelines, carrier requirements, regulatory standards, and company policies.

  • Maintain accurate underwriting documentation, account records, and file management.

  • Utilize underwriting systems and technology platforms to efficiently manage workflows and underwriting activity.

  • Assist with endorsement processing and policy maintenance activities as needed.

  • Monitor portfolio trends and renewal performance to support business planning and decision-making.

Required Qualifications

  • 5+ years of commercial insurance underwriting experience, including at least 3 years focused on transportation, trucking, or commercial auto risks.
  • Experience underwriting renewal business, evaluating transportation exposures, and managing broker relationships within wholesale distribution channels.
  • Knowledge of commercial transportation risks, including non-admitted commercial auto, fleet, trucking, hazmat, and other specialized transportation exposures.
  • Strong underwriting, risk assessment, analytical, and decision-making skills with the ability to balance profitability, retention, and growth objectives.
  • Excellent communication, relationship management, and negotiation skills with a proven ability to work effectively with brokers, carriers, and internal business partners.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience using Salesforce, Policy Decisions, or comparable underwriting and policy administration systems.

  • CPCU, ARM, AU, or other industry designations.

  • Existing relationships within the transportation insurance marketplace.

Training & Development

Freberg Environmental is committed to investing in the success of new team members. During onboarding, the selected candidate will travel to Denver for in-person training and mentorship with senior transportation underwriters. This hands-on experience is designed to accelerate product knowledge, underwriting expertise, and integration into the team.

Career Growth Opportunity

This role offers a defined path for advancement within the Transportation Practice. Successful candidates will have opportunities to expand underwriting authority, take on greater portfolio responsibility, and progress into Lead Underwriter and Senior Underwriter positions as they demonstrate strong underwriting performance, relationship management skills, and business impact.

Why Join Freberg Environmental?

  • Join a highly collaborative team of transportation underwriting professionals.

  • Manage a stable, renewal-focused book with strong broker relationships.

  • Gain exposure to specialized transportation and commercial auto risks.

  • Work alongside experienced leaders who are committed to mentorship and development.

  • Build a long-term career within a growing and successful transportation underwriting platform.

ヴェオリアグループ会社の人財マネージャー担当として、経営戦略をサポートするため,適切な教育や研修の提案、パフォーマンス管理、人員配置計画、後任管理、リーダーシップ開発等をお任せいたします。

【業務内容】

● 社内トレーニングの計画、実施

● エンゲージを向上させるためのアクション

  • セッション・イベントの主導
    ● 評価プロセスの実装
    ● 年次評価プロセスを主導/実施する

    【具体的にお任せしたい業務内容】
    ◾トレーニングプログラムの計画、実施
    -人材育成のニーズを理解し、シニアマネージャーの監督下で当社およびグループ会社でトレーニングセッションを作成して実行
    -トレーニング後のフィードバックを収集し、それらを最大限に活用して、プログラムの内容を改善
    -新卒者向けの新入社員研修プログラムの計画と実施
    -外部ベンダーと協力しての中途採用者向け研修の実施

    ◾エンゲージメント調査：
    -エンゲージメント調査の実施 (例: 質問の作成、システムの設定、結果のフィードバック等）
    -フォローアップ活動の策定と実施

    ◾特別セッション・イベント
    - 他部門との人材育成、ダイバーシティの充実などに向けたセッションの手配

    ◾その他：
    - TMシニアマネージャーの予算管理のサポート
    - タレントマネジメントの観点からグループ会社との連携をサポート

- グローバル HQ および AP HQ チームとの折衝　等

【必須要件（MUST）】

・事業会社で且つグローバル環境下での人財開発・組織開発・研修設計の経験 （新卒向けオリエンテーションを含む、タレントマネジメントの経験のある方）
・ビジネスレベル以上の英語スキル（業務において使用している、もしくは、TOEIC850点程度）

【歓迎要件（WANT）】

・エンゲージメント向上に関する施策のご経験のある方

As an inclusive company, Veolia is committed to diversity and gives equal consideration to all applications, without discrimination.

ヴェオリアグループは「エコロジカル・トランスフォーメーション（環境変革）」のベンチマーク企業となることを目指しています。5大陸で21万5,000人の従業員を擁する同グループは、水、廃棄物、エネルギーの管理において有用かつ実用的で革新的なソリューションを設計・展開し、現状を抜本的に転換する取り組みを行っています。また、相互補完的な関係にあるこれら三つの事業活動を通じて、ヴェオリアは資源の利用方法を開発し、利用可能な資源を保全、再生しています。

2024年には、ヴェオリアグループは1億1,100万人に水道サービス、9,800万人に下水道処理サービスを提供し、42THhのエネルギーを生産し、6,500万トンの廃棄物を処理しました。ヴェオリア・エンバイロメント（パリ・ユーロネクスト: VIE）は2024年に429億ユーロの連結売上高を達成しました。

日本においては、2002年に日本法人を設立し、約9,600人の従業員がグループ各社において全国各地で、それぞれの地域や業務分野で培ってきたノウハウと地域社会からの信頼を礎にサービスを提供しています。グローバルの知見・技術と融合し、日本市場においてもトータルサービスプロバイダーとしての強さを発揮しています。

We love to work with exciting clients that are making a big impact on the world around us, helping to tackle some of the world's greatest challenges.

We are seeking an experienced model audit professional that is passionate about financial modelling and driven by growth.

You will work with a team of modelling professionals to analyse and review complex financial models, ensuring they are robust and reliable

Functions and responsibilities

Gridlines’ commercial director for LATAM is responsible for setting and achieving the organisation's revenue and profit targets within the region. He/she leads and manages the sales, marketing, and business development teams, ensuring they have the resources, training, and support they need to perform effectively. He/she also develops and maintains relationships with customers, partners, and key stakeholders, and negotiates contracts and agreements. Furthermore, he/she monitors and analyses market trends, customer feedback, and competitor activities, providing information and recommendations to senior management and the board of directors.

Functions of the Commercial Director at the strategic level

At a strategic level, the commercial director makes decisions that directly impact the company's growth and positioning. These are their main responsibilities. functions :

  • Participation in the company's strategic decision-making.
  • Market analysis and identification of new business opportunities.
  • Development and implementation of long-term business strategies, creating annual action plans towards the defined objectives.

These strategic functions allow the commercial director to align the commercial area with the company's overall objectives.

Functions of the Commercial Director at the tactical level

At this level, the sales director translates strategies into concrete actions and ensures their proper execution. These are their responsibilities. Tactics further relevant :

These operational functions ensure the correct execution of business tasks and strengthen customer relationships.

A competitive base salary with flexible working arrangements, including a mixture of office-based, working from home, and working on client sites.

Access to cutting-edge financial modelling tools and resources.

Collaborative and supportive team culture

jobs.excerpt: Here at Youth4Youth, we have grown a strong, tight-knit community of individuals who are passionate about making a difference and improving the lives of young people across the UK.
jobs.description:
Here at Youth4Youth, we have grown a strong, tight-knit community of individuals who are passionate about making a difference and improving the lives of young people across the UK. Our growing team of volunteers all contribute, significantly, to the impact that we have as a charity on our direct beneficiaries, regardless of the department that they work in of the level of time that they are able to commit. Our servicesprimarily offer a peer-support network to young people right across the UK, allowing them to access a peer mentor who is of a similar age to them and somebody that they feel more comfortable speaking with.

If successful, you will be joining a growing team of diverse, but likeminded individuals, collaborating to increase the reach of the Charity and improve support provisions available to young people. All of our volunteers and employees are remote workers,but that doesn't stop us keeping in touch and maintaining a strong positive culture amongst our whole team.

About the role

We're looking for an ambitious, entrepreneurial Commercial Director to lead the growth of Y4Y Trading.

This is a unique opportunity to build a social enterprise from the ground up—developing commercial ventures that create genuine social impact while generating sustainable income for a growing charity.

You'll have the freedom to shape strategy, launch new initiatives, and turn innovative ideas into thriving businesses. Working closely with the Y4Y Trading Board and the Charity Executive Board, you'll play a pivotal role in creating long-term financial sustainability for Youth4Youth.

If you're someone who enjoys building businesses, spotting opportunities, driving growth, and creating lasting impact, we'd love to hear from you.

Responsibilities

As Commercial Director, you'll lead the development and growth of Y4Y Trading's commercial activities by:

  • Developing and launching ethical commercial ventures aligned with Youth4Youth's mission.

  • Driving revenue growth through e-commerce, digital sales, partnerships, and innovative business development.

  • Identifying new commercial opportunities and transforming ideas into sustainable income streams.

  • Overseeing product development, pricing, merchandising, customer experience, and online trading.

  • Monitoring commercial performance through budgeting, forecasting, reporting, and financial planning.

  • Building strong relationships with suppliers, partners, sponsors, and key stakeholders.

  • Implementing effective systems, processes, and operational improvements to support growth.

  • Supporting young people by creating opportunities for them to gain experience and develop commercial and employability skills.

  • Ensuring all commercial activities operate to high legal, financial, and ethical standards.

Skills

We're seeking someone who combines commercial thinking with a passion for making a difference.

You'll ideally have:

  • Experience launching, growing, or managing a commercial business or trading operation.

  • A strong background in e-commerce, online retail, digital sales, or commercial strategy.

  • Excellent commercial awareness with experience identifying and developing growth opportunities.

  • Strong leadership, communication, and relationship-building skills.

  • An entrepreneurial mindset with the confidence to work independently and take ownership.

  • A practical, hands-on approach to solving problems and delivering results.

  • Experience within a charity or social enterprise is welcomed but certainly not essential.

Our mission is to continue to grow towards becoming one of the best charities in the UK. Our aim is to do this by building a diverse team, rich with different backgrounds and perspectives. Therefore, even if you feel you only are a 75% match, we would still love to hear from you. Skills can be learned, but diversity cannot.

Benefits of volunteering with Youth4Youth

We recognise that you will be joining us and giving your time as an 'in-kind' donation, but there must be benefits for you too. When joining our team, you will be open to the following benefits:

  • Professional and personal development opportunities in a variety of skill areas through volunteering in real roles. This may be general development or tailored to your specific needs or ambitions

  • Becoming a member of a strong network of likeminded individuals, spread across the UK, who you can connect with and collaborate with both within and outside of the Charity

  • Access to bespoke discounts, specifically designed for non-profit workers and Youth4Youth volunteers

  • Opportunities to truly shape the future of the Charity, having a direct influence over the impact that Youth4Youth has on its direct beneficiaries

The hiring process

Our hiring process typically has two stages

  1. Video or Written Application (when applicable)

  2. Interview with the Volunteering Coordinator for that role

Some roles will have extra stages but we’ll let you know as early as possible if so.

Please let us know if you require any accommodations for the interview process, and we’ll do our best to assist.

jobs.title: Process Engineer (Greenfield Projects)
jobs.excerpt: The Process Engineer is responsible for the development and execution of process engineering activities related to water treatment systems within greenfield industrial projects.
jobs.description:
The Process Engineer is responsible for the development and execution of process engineering activities related to water treatment systems within greenfield industrial projects.

The role supports all project phases (FEL 1, FEL 2, FEED, and EPC), ensuring that water and wastewater systems are properly defined, designed, and integrated into the overall process.

The Process Engineer contributes to delivering technically robust and cost-effective solutions, focusing on water balance, treatment technologies, and compliance with environmental and process requirements. The role requires strong coordination with multidisciplinary teams and active participation in both design and execution phases.

Key Responsibilities

  • Support the development of process design for water and wastewater systems across all project phases (FEL, FEED, EPC).
  • Identify raw water requirements and characterize process effluents in coordination with process teams and clients.
  • Select and evaluate appropriate water treatment technologies to meet process and discharge requirements.
  • Develop and validate water balances, process schemes, and system configurations.
  • Perform process calculations and simulations to support equipment selection and system design.
  • Size key equipment such as storage tanks, treatment units, and utility systems.
  • Prepare and review process deliverables including PFDs, P&IDs, process design specifications (PDS), and technical reports.
  • Support the evaluation of water reuse and recycling strategies to optimize water consumption.
  • Ensure alignment between process design, environmental regulations, and project requirements.
  • Collaborate with internal disciplines (mechanical, electrical, civil, automation) and external partners.
  • Support procurement activities through preparation of technical specifications and review of vendor documentation.
  • Contribute to commissioning, start-up, and troubleshooting activities when required.

Typical Activities

  • Preparation of process documentation (BFD, PFD, P&ID, process notes).
  • Development of water balances and treatment concepts for industrial facilities.
  • Equipment sizing and process calculations.
  • Process simulation and performance validation.
  • Evaluation of treatment technologies (filtration, biological, chemical treatment, reuse systems).
  • Participation in technical meetings with clients, partners, and suppliers.
  • Support to tender preparation (technical scope definition, cost inputs, technical clarifications).
  • Contribution to design reviews and multidisciplinary coordination.
  • Occasional support to site activities, commissioning, and performance troubleshooting.

Qualifications & Experience

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Chemical Engineering, Process Engineering, or related discipline.
  • Proven experience in water treatment process engineering within industrial projects.
  • Experience in FEED and/or EPC project environments is highly desirable.
  • Strong understanding of water and wastewater treatment technologies.
  • Experience in preparation of process documentation (PFDs, P&IDs, technical reports).
  • Familiarity with process simulation tools and engineering calculations.
  • Experience working with international standards and environmental regulations is an advantage.
  • Exposure to project execution, commissioning, or site activities is a plus.

Core Competencies

  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills
  • Structured and detail-oriented approach
  • Ability to work in multidisciplinary and international teams
  • Good communication and coordination skills
  • Proactive mindset with focus on practical solutions and delivery

What is the value of the business opportunities/pipeline and any key clients he will support?

The Process Engineer will support a portfolio of strategic greenfield projects within Ecolab’s European pipeline, focused on complex industrial water treatment systems and process integration. The role will additionally support from time to time to GHT and TWM.

The Process Engineer plays a key role in ensuring that water systems are properly designed and integrated within complex industrial projects.

By contributing to the definition and execution of robust process solutions, the role supports:

  • Reliable and compliant water and wastewater treatment systems
  • Optimization of water consumption and reuse
  • Improved project delivery through strong technical foundations
  • Enhanced competitiveness of Ecolab’s engineering solutions

Position Overview:

The Georgian Video-Telephone- Interpreter is responsible for handling calls on demand, and renders the meaning of conversations between Georgian and English speakers. The interpreter breaks the communication barrier in a wide range of industries that LanguageLine Solutions serves: Healthcare, Government, Insurance, Financial, Utilities, Travel & Hospitality, General Business, Law Enforcement, Court, and 911.

The interpreter processes information quickly, concisely and recognizes sensitive cultural differences. The interpreter is professional and courteous at all times and uses appropriate terminology and understands common industry procedures and practices. The video and audio interpreting sessions may involve simple or complex, technical or non-technical subjects.

This position does not involve written translation however translators and other skilled linguists are encouraged to apply. The interpreters translate verbally.

**This is a remote position. The Interpreter works from his/her home-office. It is essential to ensure a quiet & secure environment**

Essential Job Functions:

  • Respond to video and audio interpreting sessions promptly and conduct interpretation in a friendly and professional manner.

  • Speak clearly in both languages using proper pronunciation, enunciation and polite expressions.

  • Maintain a professional demeanor throughout the video and audio interpreting sessions at all times.

  • Remain calm during video and audio interpreting sessions in the event that one of the primary speakers is incoherent or upset, especially in emergency situations such as 911 calls.

  • Maintain punctuality and availability during scheduled work hours.

  • Follow client instructions, in compliance with protocol to ensure client expectations are met with the Limited English-speaking Person (LEP), avoiding interaction with the LEP without client’s permission.

  • Understand protocol and terminology for various industries including, but not limited to, Medical, Insurance, Finance and Law.

  • Demonstrate commitment to cultural sensitivity and working in a diverse environment.

  • Architecture & Deployment: Collaborate with DevOps to improve CI/CD pipelines (GitLab) and architect solutions using AWS services (Lambda, ECS, etc.).

Position Type: Full-Time, Remote
Working Hours: U.S. Business Hours (EST)

About the Role

At Pavago, one of our clients is hiring a Sales Development Representative (SDR) to drive pipeline and revenue growth across accounting and financial services.

This is a high-ownership, full-cycle sales role that goes beyond traditional appointment setting. You’ll prospect for new business, execute multi-channel outreach, conduct discovery calls, present solutions, and close smaller deals independently.

The ideal candidate has experience selling accounting, bookkeeping, financial, or related professional services and understands how to communicate with SMB owners about their financial and operational challenges.

What You’ll Own

Prospecting & Lead Generation

  • Identify and research prospective customers across target verticals, including:
    • Churches
    • E-commerce
    • Construction
    • Home services
    • Trucking
    • Real estate
  • Build targeted prospect lists using LinkedIn, directories, and prospecting platforms
  • Identify decision-makers and relevant buying signals
  • Understand industry-specific pain points and tailor outreach accordingly
  • Maintain a consistent pipeline of new prospects

Multi-Channel Outreach

  • Execute outbound prospecting through:
    • Cold email
    • Cold calling
    • LinkedIn
    • Social platforms
  • Personalize messaging based on prospect needs and industry
  • Engage prospects and move qualified leads into discovery conversations
  • Maintain disciplined follow-up across multiple touchpoints
  • Support basic Facebook and Instagram campaigns to generate inbound opportunities

Discovery, Qualification & Closing

  • Conduct discovery calls using frameworks such as BANT or MEDDIC
  • Understand prospects’ accounting, bookkeeping, and financial-service needs
  • Qualify opportunities based on fit, needs, budget, and buying intent
  • Present relevant service solutions
  • Conduct demos and walkthroughs using tools such as Digits
  • Handle objections confidently and professionally
  • Prepare proposals and move opportunities toward close
  • Independently close smaller deals
  • Coordinate with the service delivery team for smooth client onboarding

Pipeline & CRM Management

  • Own opportunities from initial prospecting through close
  • Maintain consistent follow-up with active prospects
  • Track conversations, tasks, and deal stages accurately in the CRM
  • Keep pipeline data clean and current
  • Ensure opportunities do not stall due to missed follow-ups
  • Maintain clear visibility into next steps across every active deal

Reporting & Performance

  • Track:
    • Outreach activity
    • Response rates
    • Discovery calls
    • Qualified opportunities
    • Conversion rates
    • Deals closed
    • Revenue generated
    • Paid campaign performance
  • Maintain accurate CRM notes and reporting
  • Provide weekly performance insights and pipeline updates
  • Identify opportunities to improve messaging, targeting, and conversion

Must-Have Experience & Skills

  • Proven B2B sales experience, preferably selling:
    • Accounting services
    • Bookkeeping services
    • Financial services
    • Related professional services
  • Experience conducting discovery and qualification calls
  • Demonstrated ability to close deals independently
  • Experience managing opportunities across the full sales cycle
  • Strong outbound prospecting and lead-generation experience
  • Familiarity with tools such as:
    • Apollo
    • Salesloft
    • Outreach
    • LinkedIn Sales Navigator
  • Experience with HubSpot, Salesforce, or similar CRM platforms
  • Strong written and verbal English communication skills
  • Strong objection-handling and follow-up skills
  • Ability to work independently during U.S. EST business hours

Nice to Have

  • Experience selling to SMBs or service-based businesses
  • Understanding of accounting workflows and financial operations
  • Familiarity with GoHighLevel
  • Experience using Digits
  • Experience supporting or running Facebook and Instagram campaigns
  • Experience selling into industries such as construction, real estate, e-commerce, trucking, or home services

Tools & Tech

HubSpot | Salesforce | Apollo | Salesloft | Outreach | LinkedIn Sales Navigator | GoHighLevel | Digits | Meta Ads

What Makes You a Strong Fit

  • You’ve sold accounting, bookkeeping, financial, or professional services before
  • You can confidently move from cold outreach to discovery to close
  • You understand that success is measured by pipeline and revenue, not just activity
  • You can speak credibly with business owners about operational and financial pain points
  • You’re comfortable balancing outbound prospecting with inbound opportunities
  • You follow up consistently and maintain an organized pipeline
  • You take ownership of outcomes rather than waiting for direction

What a Typical Day Looks Like

You may start by researching target accounts and building prospect lists before moving into cold calls, emails, and LinkedIn outreach.

Throughout the day, you’ll conduct discovery calls, qualify prospects, demonstrate solutions, handle objections, prepare proposals, and move active opportunities toward close.

You’ll also maintain CRM records, follow up with prospects, review campaign performance, and coordinate successful new clients with the service delivery team.

In short: you own the sales process from prospecting through close and turn qualified opportunities into revenue.

Key Metrics for Success

  • Qualified opportunities generated
  • Deals closed
  • Revenue contribution
  • Lead → discovery call conversion
  • Discovery call → close conversion
  • Outreach response rates
  • Pipeline growth and velocity
  • Consistent follow-up execution
  • CRM accuracy and pipeline hygiene

Interview Process

  1. Initial Screening Call
  2. Spark Hire Video Interview
  3. Recruiter Interview
  4. Client Interview
  5. Offer & Onboarding

Apply Now

If you have experience selling accounting, bookkeeping, financial, or professional services and can confidently own the sales process from prospecting through discovery and close, we’d love to hear from you.

Apply now and help build a high-performing pipeline across growing SMB markets.

We believe that leaders should care deeply about the development of their employees at all levels, emphasizing emotional intelligence and accountability. Our leaders collaborate closely to ensure the success of their teams, and we work together to achieve shared goals, creating a challenging and rewarding workplace for everyone.

About the Role

As a DevOps Engineer at Bullhorn, you'll be building the tools and systems that facilitate large-scale software releases safely and effectively. This includes all pipelines for building, packaging, deploying, and validating software delivery. You will help the team take code changes safely and quickly from a developer's machine all the way to production. We're a release-engineering and platform team: we build and maintain the systems that enable engineering teams to deploy with confidence. We relentlessly automate manual toil from the software delivery lifecycle.

This is a hands-on building role. You'll write automations, own our deploy and CI/CD tooling, containerize and modernize our environments, and partner directly with engineering teams to remove the friction that slows them down.

A Typical Day Will Include...

  • Designing, building, and maintaining deploy and release pipelines, and the automation that reduces manual intervention during releases

  • Building and improving our internal release tooling — for example, automating script packaging and DBA approvals, code + script deploys, and release-finishing workflows

  • Advancing our CI/CD GitOps process: authoring reusable GitLab CI templates, Helm charts, and ArgoCD applications so teams can self-serve their own build and deploy pipelines

  • Containerizing and modernizing our QA and lower environments (Kubernetes, Helm, Ansible) to bring them closer to production parity

  • Modernizing build tools across the org to ensure we’re using the latest and greatest technology across all teams.

  • Attending daily team stand-ups and collaborating with a distributed, cross-functional team across US and UK time zones

  • Troubleshooting deployment and infrastructure issues, and partnering with engineering teams to resolve environment-specific problems

  • Leveraging AI tools (Claude Code, Claude Cowork, and similar) as a core part of how you work — writing unit tests and automation, accelerating investigation and refactoring, and finding new ways to eliminate toil

  • Writing clean, well-tested automation and scripts (Python, Bash) and following solid engineering practices for the tools we own

  • Contributing to documentation, runbooks, and developer enablement so knowledge is shared and not siloed

  • Mentoring teammates, driving conversations about priorities and process, and independently owning complex, cross-cutting initiatives

  • Working within a positive, energizing, collaborative team environment

This Role Is a Fit for You If...

  • You want to be an integral part of an innovative, high-performance engineering team

  • You thrive in a fast-paced, agile environment with frequent software releases

  • You're an automation-first thinker — if you do something more than twice, your instinct is to automate it

  • You can work through complex problems independently while knowing when to pull others in and help less experienced teammates do the same

  • You're comfortable scripting and building tooling in Python and Bash/shell

  • You have hands-on experience with CI/CD systems — GitLab CI/CD and/or Jenkins — including building and maintaining pipelines

  • You're experienced with containers and orchestration: Docker, Kubernetes, and Helm

  • You're comfortable building full-stack automation tooling — scripting and backend work in Python, and frontend/UI work in JavaScript (our internal tools have both a Python backend and a web frontend)

  • You've worked with GitOps and/or infrastructure-as-code and configuration management (ArgoCD, Ansible, or similar)

  • You're comfortable with Git-based workflows and modern versioning practices

  • You see AI tooling as a force multiplier and are eager to use it to raise your own and the team's output

  • You care about reliability, security, and developer experience, and you communicate clearly with the engineering teams you support

  • You're comfortable challenging and being challenged by your teammates

Bonus Points...

jobs.title: Jr. Salesforce Administrator / QA Tester
jobs.excerpt: Role Summary Prove Partners is consolidating two Salesforce orgs and migrating a legacy system of record into Salesforce.
jobs.description:
Role Summary
Prove Partners is consolidating two Salesforce orgs and migrating a legacy system of record into Salesforce. The program runs in continuous release cycles, and every cycle changes objects, page layouts, permission sets, flows, Apex, and integrations. Each of those changes has to be proven out end to end before it reaches production users.

We are looking for a junior Salesforce administrator (remote) who wants to spend the bulk of their time in structured, repeatable quality assurance. This person will execute full end-to-end test passes in our sandboxes, over and over, across each release: building and maintaining the test scripts, running them, logging what breaks, retesting fixes, and confirming regressions have not been introduced elsewhere.

Repetition is the job, not a side effect of it. The right candidate is someone who is genuinely comfortable running the same 200-step regression pass every sprint and catching the one step that changed — and who is methodical enough to keep the documentation accurate while doing it.

Engagement at a Glance

Working titleJunior Salesforce Administrator / QA TesterReports toDirector of Program Management & CRMLocationOffshore / nearshore, fully remoteTime zone requirementMinimum 6 hours of daily overlap with 9:00 a.m.–5:00 p.m. US EasternCommitmentFull-time, 40 hours per weekDuration6–12 months, with option to extendEngagement typeOpen — vendor staff augmentation, individual contractor, or employer-of-recordSeniorityJunior (1–3 years); this is a hands-on execution role, not a lead role
Time zone is a hard requirement. Testing is iterative and conversational — the tester needs to be able to ask an administrator or developer a question and get an answer inside the same working session. Candidates should be located where the standard working day overlaps with US Eastern.

Key Responsibilities

End-to-end and regression testing (primary, ~60% of time)

  • Execute full end-to-end test passes across core business processes in the sandbox environments, following documented scripts, for every release cycle.
  • Run regression suites after each configuration or code change to confirm that existing functionality still behaves as expected.
  • Test across the full record lifecycle — record creation, field updates, stage and status transitions, automation firing, downstream record effects, and reporting output.
  • Retest and close out defects after fixes are deployed, and confirm the fix has not broken adjacent functionality.
  • Validate behavior after sandbox refreshes and deployments, including smoke testing of critical paths.

Test design and documentation (~20% of time)

  • Write and maintain test cases and test scripts from user stories, acceptance criteria, and process documentation.
  • Keep the test case library current as requirements change; retire cases that no longer apply and add coverage for new functionality.
  • Log defects with clear, reproducible steps, expected vs. actual results, affected records, screenshots, and severity.
  • Maintain test execution records so that release readiness can be assessed at a glance.

Test data and environment support (~10% of time)

  • Prepare and refresh test data sets, including bulk loads via Data Loader or Data Import Wizard.
  • Write basic SOQL queries to verify data state and confirm expected record changes.
  • Test across multiple user profiles and permission sets to confirm record visibility, field-level security, and sharing behave correctly for each role.

Light administrative configuration (~10% of time)

  • Perform straightforward declarative configuration under supervision — custom fields, page layouts, list views, validation rules, simple reports and dashboards.
  • Assist with user setup, permission set assignment, and access troubleshooting.
  • Support user acceptance testing cycles: prepare UAT scripts, walk business testers through them, and consolidate their feedback.

Required Qualifications

  • 1–3 years of hands-on experience in a Salesforce environment as an administrator, QA tester, business analyst, or support analyst.
  • Working knowledge of the Salesforce platform: standard and custom objects, record types, page layouts, profiles and permission sets, validation rules, and Flow.
  • Demonstrated experience executing manual test cases and logging defects in a tracked system (Jira, Azure DevOps, or similar).
  • Ability to read a user story or acceptance criteria and translate it into concrete test steps.
  • Comfort with repetitive, detail-intensive work and a track record of sustained accuracy in it.
  • Basic SOQL and comfort with Data Loader or a comparable data tool.
  • Clear written and spoken English — defect reports and test notes are read by developers and business stakeholders, so writing quality matters.
  • Availability for the required daily overlap with US Eastern business hours.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Salesforce Certified Administrator (ADM-201) — preferred, not required. Hands-on experience carries more weight than the credential, and we will consider candidates who are working toward it.
  • Experience testing during a data migration or multi-org consolidation.
  • Exposure to integration testing between Salesforce and external systems, including basic API concepts.
  • Familiarity with Jira, Confluence, or comparable tracking and documentation tools.
  • Any experience with test automation (Selenium, Provar, Playwright) or reading Apex test results — useful, but this role is manual-first.
  • Background in healthcare, insurance, legal services, or another regulated environment where access control and audit trails matter.

What Success Looks Like

  • By 15 days: has run a full end-to-end pass on at least one core process independently, using existing scripts, and is logging usable defects without rework.
  • By 30 days: is authoring new test cases from user stories with minimal correction, and owns the regression suite for at least one functional area.
  • By 60 days: is the reliable go-to for release readiness on their areas — the team trusts that if this person has signed off, the release is safe to deploy.

jobs.title: Jr. Salesforce Administrator / QA Tester
jobs.excerpt: Role Summary Prove Partners is consolidating two Salesforce orgs and migrating a legacy system of record into Salesforce.
jobs.description:
Role Summary
Prove Partners is consolidating two Salesforce orgs and migrating a legacy system of record into Salesforce. The program runs in continuous release cycles, and every cycle changes objects, page layouts, permission sets, flows, Apex, and integrations. Each of those changes has to be proven out end to end before it reaches production users.

We are looking for a junior Salesforce administrator (remote) who wants to spend the bulk of their time in structured, repeatable quality assurance. This person will execute full end-to-end test passes in our sandboxes, over and over, across each release: building and maintaining the test scripts, running them, logging what breaks, retesting fixes, and confirming regressions have not been introduced elsewhere.

Repetition is the job, not a side effect of it. The right candidate is someone who is genuinely comfortable running the same 200-step regression pass every sprint and catching the one step that changed — and who is methodical enough to keep the documentation accurate while doing it.

Engagement at a Glance

Working titleJunior Salesforce Administrator / QA TesterReports toDirector of Program Management & CRMLocationOffshore / nearshore, fully remoteTime zone requirementMinimum 6 hours of daily overlap with 9:00 a.m.–5:00 p.m. US EasternCommitmentFull-time, 40 hours per weekDuration6–12 months, with option to extendEngagement typeOpen — vendor staff augmentation, individual contractor, or employer-of-recordSeniorityJunior (1–3 years); this is a hands-on execution role, not a lead role
Time zone is a hard requirement. Testing is iterative and conversational — the tester needs to be able to ask an administrator or developer a question and get an answer inside the same working session. Candidates should be located where the standard working day overlaps with US Eastern.

Key Responsibilities

End-to-end and regression testing (primary, ~60% of time)

  • Execute full end-to-end test passes across core business processes in the sandbox environments, following documented scripts, for every release cycle.
  • Run regression suites after each configuration or code change to confirm that existing functionality still behaves as expected.
  • Test across the full record lifecycle — record creation, field updates, stage and status transitions, automation firing, downstream record effects, and reporting output.
  • Retest and close out defects after fixes are deployed, and confirm the fix has not broken adjacent functionality.
  • Validate behavior after sandbox refreshes and deployments, including smoke testing of critical paths.

Test design and documentation (~20% of time)

  • Write and maintain test cases and test scripts from user stories, acceptance criteria, and process documentation.
  • Keep the test case library current as requirements change; retire cases that no longer apply and add coverage for new functionality.
  • Log defects with clear, reproducible steps, expected vs. actual results, affected records, screenshots, and severity.
  • Maintain test execution records so that release readiness can be assessed at a glance.

Test data and environment support (~10% of time)

  • Prepare and refresh test data sets, including bulk loads via Data Loader or Data Import Wizard.
  • Write basic SOQL queries to verify data state and confirm expected record changes.
  • Test across multiple user profiles and permission sets to confirm record visibility, field-level security, and sharing behave correctly for each role.

Light administrative configuration (~10% of time)

  • Perform straightforward declarative configuration under supervision — custom fields, page layouts, list views, validation rules, simple reports and dashboards.
  • Assist with user setup, permission set assignment, and access troubleshooting.
  • Support user acceptance testing cycles: prepare UAT scripts, walk business testers through them, and consolidate their feedback.

Required Qualifications

  • 1–3 years of hands-on experience in a Salesforce environment as an administrator, QA tester, business analyst, or support analyst.
  • Working knowledge of the Salesforce platform: standard and custom objects, record types, page layouts, profiles and permission sets, validation rules, and Flow.
  • Demonstrated experience executing manual test cases and logging defects in a tracked system (Jira, Azure DevOps, or similar).
  • Ability to read a user story or acceptance criteria and translate it into concrete test steps.
  • Comfort with repetitive, detail-intensive work and a track record of sustained accuracy in it.
  • Basic SOQL and comfort with Data Loader or a comparable data tool.
  • Clear written and spoken English — defect reports and test notes are read by developers and business stakeholders, so writing quality matters.
  • Availability for the required daily overlap with US Eastern business hours.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Salesforce Certified Administrator (ADM-201) — preferred, not required. Hands-on experience carries more weight than the credential, and we will consider candidates who are working toward it.
  • Experience testing during a data migration or multi-org consolidation.
  • Exposure to integration testing between Salesforce and external systems, including basic API concepts.
  • Familiarity with Jira, Confluence, or comparable tracking and documentation tools.
  • Any experience with test automation (Selenium, Provar, Playwright) or reading Apex test results — useful, but this role is manual-first.
  • Background in healthcare, insurance, legal services, or another regulated environment where access control and audit trails matter.

What Success Looks Like

  • By 15 days: has run a full end-to-end pass on at least one core process independently, using existing scripts, and is logging usable defects without rework.
  • By 30 days: is authoring new test cases from user stories with minimal correction, and owns the regression suite for at least one functional area.
  • By 60 days: is the reliable go-to for release readiness on their areas — the team trusts that if this person has signed off, the release is safe to deploy.

Who We Are:

Alpaca is a US-headquartered, global leader in agent-first brokerage infrastructure for stocks, ETFs, options, crypto, fixed income, 24/5 trading, and more.

We're a dynamic team of 400+ globally distributed members who thrive working from our favorite places around the world, with teammates spanning the USA, Canada, Japan, Hungary, Nigeria, Brazil, the UK, and beyond!

Your Role:

We are looking for a Head of Data Platform to lead Alpaca’s growing Platform Engineering team. You will own the data strategy, the team’s execution, and the department’s roadmap.

The Data department serves every function at Alpaca: it powers partner invoicing and revenue attribution, provides the analytical foundation for sales, product, and compliance, and operates the data platform that processes hundreds of millions of events daily. You will manage three team leads, balancing operational delivery (invoicing, embedded analytics, regulatory reporting) with strategic bets (self-service warehouse, AI-powered analytics, enterprise search).

This is a player-coach role. You will set direction for the team while staying close enough to the technical details to make architecture decisions, unblock your leads, and represent data’s capabilities to the executive team.

Things You Get To Do:

  • Lead and develop Platform Engineering & ETL
  • Manage leads, set priorities, and ensure delivery.
  • Own the Data Lakehouse architecture: Trino, Iceberg/GCS, Airflow, Airbyte, Redpanda CDC, dbt.
  • Make build-vs-buy decisions on tooling.

  • Accelerate self-service: move the organization toward self-serve analytics via semantic layers, data catalogues, and conversational BI so the data team can shift from ad-hoc queries to strategic projects.
  • Guide AI/ML enablement: oversee enterprise AI search, agent-based workflow automation, and LLM-powered analytics. Help balance vendor solutions with in-house development.
  • Collaborate with Finance, Sales, Product, Compliance, and Customer Success to translate business needs into data products.
  • Manage infrastructure costs: keep data + cloud cost ratio under target as AUC grows.
  • Operate production systems: own on-call processes, incident response, and SLOs for data freshness, accuracy, and availability.

Who You Are (Must-Haves):

  • 8+ years in data engineering, including 3+ years managing data teams (leads + ICs).
  • Deep experience with modern data stack: dbt, Trino/Presto or equivalent query engines, Apache Iceberg or similar table formats, cloud object storage.
  • Hands-on experience with ETL/ELT patterns at scale: CDC (Debezium/Kafka), batch (Airflow/dbt), streaming, and reverse ETL.
  • Track record of building self-service analytics capabilities for non-technical stakeholders.
  • Experience with financial data: trading, invoicing, revenue attribution, or regulatory reporting in fintech or financial services.
  • Proficiency in Python and SQL. Comfortable reading code, reviewing PRs, and making architecture decisions.
  • Experience managing distributed/remote teams across multiple time zones.

  • Experience with GCP (GKE, GCS, BigQuery migration), Kubernetes, Helm, Terraform.

Who You Might Be (Nice-to-Haves):

  • Experience with brokerage or broker-dealer operations (clearing, settlement, market making, reconciliation).
  • Familiarity with LLM/AI tooling: MCP, vector databases, enterprise search, conversational BI (WrenAI, Cube).
  • Background in compliance analytics (AML/Actimize, KYC, margin calls).
  • Exposure to open-source data catalogues (OpenMetadata, Collate) and data quality frameworks.

jobs.description:
Sr. Manager, Provider Operations Strategy & Programs

Remote | Full-Time, Salary, Exempt | Includes Benefits, PTO, Flexible Schedule, Equity

About the Role

Provider Operations keeps Steno’s nationwide network of court reporters running — coverage, quality, retention, and growth. This role exists to ensure we are staying coordinated across our team and with cross functional partners. You will own cross-functional program management, operational excellence, and strategic planning for the Provider Operations organization. You’ll identify and drive 3–5 high-impact initiatives per quarter, codify processes so they scale without scaling headcount, and ensure all pillar leaders (Quality of Service, Staffing, Experience, Growth, Analytics, Strategy & Programs) move in concert. This is a newly created role to help promote a clear line of sight for clients, and to find efficiencies in our cross-functional processes and workflows, but without impacting our clients' experience.

Reporting to the Sr. Director of Provider Operations, you’ll manage a small team of project managers and act as a strategic partner to pillar leaders.

Who We’re Looking For

Someone with deep operational and program management experience who can operate effectively without positional authority. You’re comfortable with ambiguity, naturally connect cross-functional work, and know how to balance documentation with flexibility. You move fast, you’re data-informed, and you ship. Equally important: you understand the operational reality well enough that your plans are grounded and executable, not theoretical. You’re trusted with ambiguous, high-stakes problems and expect to exercise business judgment on trade-offs that affect fill rate, cost, and team capability.

On a Regular Basis, You Will

  • Partner with the Sr. Director to define and prioritize quarterly initiatives that span multiple pillars or require cross-functional coordination, developing comprehensive program briefs with scope, stakeholders, timeline, resource needs, success metrics, and dependencies
  • Drive programs from initiation to close-out, tracking progress against milestones, escalating blockers early, and measuring outcomes—both quantitative (fill rate impact, cost savings, cycle time) and qualitative (process improvement, team alignment)
  • Work with pillar leaders to document how core functions actually operate and design systems and tooling that scale processes without scaling headcount — playbooks, checklists, SLAs, decision trees that a new team member can execute on day one
  • Audit for gaps, redundancies, and hand-off friction; recommend changes and track implementation
  • Act as the connective lens across Quality of Service, Staffing, Experience, Growth, Analytics, Strategy & Programs — collecting signals from each pillar and flagging conflicts or opportunities early
  • Manage relationships between Provider Ops and cross-functional partners (Sales, Product, Support), proactively communicating constraints and capacity
  • Run quarterly planning sessions with pillar leaders to align on roadmap and surface risks and dependencies
  • Maintain a forward-looking view of what’s coming in the next 8 weeks that could surprise the business, including market shifts and product changes that affect provider strategy
  • Manage project managers, developing their scope and mentoring them into more complex projects
  • Evaluate automation and AI tools with pillar leaders, knowing where technology truly changes the economics versus where it adds unnecessary complexity

You’ll Thrive in This Role If

  • You’ve successfully managed 3+ concurrent programs across multiple teams without formal authority over those teams; you’re comfortable with ambiguity and track dependencies naturally
  • You’ve built or substantially improved a repeatable process that scaled with the business; you understand how to balance documentation with flexibility and standardization with local adaptation
  • You operate effectively without positional authority and can present trade-offs to senior leadership, influencing decisions even when stakeholders disagree
  • You’re data fluent with the ability to self-serve data to identify problems, track progress, and make trade-off calls
  • You ship — you set realistic plans, track against them, course-correct when needed, and avoid both paralysis by analysis and skipping necessary planning
  • You have experience at a high-growth company, especially in supply-side, logistics, or marketplace operations where you’ve seen how ops scales
  • You’ve managed one or more direct reports and developed them into independent operators
  • You communicate clearly and present ideas to senior leadership without jargon; clear communication signals you actually understand something
  • You’re comfortable with ambiguity and have made progress in environments where the mandate was clear but the path wasn’t

Qualifications

  • 6+ years of experience in operations, business operations, or program management—or equivalent leadership impact in a relevant domain
  • Demonstrated track record of managing cross-functional work without positional authority
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills
  • Comfort with ambiguity and high-stakes decision-making with incomplete information

Nice to Have

  • Supply-side ops, provider/marketplace operations, or recruiting/staffing supply chain experience
  • Work in regulated industries or organizations with complex external stakeholder management (e.g., gig economy, healthcare staffing, field services)
  • Hands-on experience evaluating and implementing new tools or automation technologies
  • Facilitation or workshop design skills — you’ve led strategic planning sessions or cross-team retrospectives

Compensation & Benefits

  • Salary: $135,000-$165,000
  • Health, Vision, & Dental Benefits — generous company-sponsored health plans for both employees and dependents, including comprehensive vision & dental
  • Wellness/Mental Health — shared benefits to be used among employees and families
  • Flexible Paid Time Off — allowing employees to find balance in their lives
  • Options of Equity — we know our success is nothing without our team
  • Access to a company-provided 401(k) account
  • A home office setup and a monthly stipend to offset internet and phone costs

Application Information

  • Steno is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate based on any characteristics that are protected under the law. All employment decisions are based on qualifications, merit, and business needs.
  • Applicants needing special assistance or accommodations for interviews or website access should contact us at .

  • Information provided to Steno, such as professional credentials and skills, educational and work history, the results of technical skills assessments or working exercises, and other information that may be included on a resume or application, is collected and stored in our system. Still, we never disclose or sell your personal information.
