jobs.title: Jr. Salesforce Administrator / QA Tester
jobs.excerpt: Role Summary Prove Partners is consolidating two Salesforce orgs and migrating a legacy system of record into Salesforce.
jobs.description:
Role Summary
Prove Partners is consolidating two Salesforce orgs and migrating a legacy system of record into Salesforce. The program runs in continuous release cycles, and every cycle changes objects, page layouts, permission sets, flows, Apex, and integrations. Each of those changes has to be proven out end to end before it reaches production users.

We are looking for a junior Salesforce administrator (remote) who wants to spend the bulk of their time in structured, repeatable quality assurance. This person will execute full end-to-end test passes in our sandboxes, over and over, across each release: building and maintaining the test scripts, running them, logging what breaks, retesting fixes, and confirming regressions have not been introduced elsewhere.

Repetition is the job, not a side effect of it. The right candidate is someone who is genuinely comfortable running the same 200-step regression pass every sprint and catching the one step that changed — and who is methodical enough to keep the documentation accurate while doing it.

Engagement at a Glance

Working titleJunior Salesforce Administrator / QA TesterReports toDirector of Program Management & CRMLocationOffshore / nearshore, fully remoteTime zone requirementMinimum 6 hours of daily overlap with 9:00 a.m.–5:00 p.m. US EasternCommitmentFull-time, 40 hours per weekDuration6–12 months, with option to extendEngagement typeOpen — vendor staff augmentation, individual contractor, or employer-of-recordSeniorityJunior (1–3 years); this is a hands-on execution role, not a lead role
Time zone is a hard requirement. Testing is iterative and conversational — the tester needs to be able to ask an administrator or developer a question and get an answer inside the same working session. Candidates should be located where the standard working day overlaps with US Eastern.

Key Responsibilities

End-to-end and regression testing (primary, ~60% of time)

  • Execute full end-to-end test passes across core business processes in the sandbox environments, following documented scripts, for every release cycle.
  • Run regression suites after each configuration or code change to confirm that existing functionality still behaves as expected.
  • Test across the full record lifecycle — record creation, field updates, stage and status transitions, automation firing, downstream record effects, and reporting output.
  • Retest and close out defects after fixes are deployed, and confirm the fix has not broken adjacent functionality.
  • Validate behavior after sandbox refreshes and deployments, including smoke testing of critical paths.

Test design and documentation (~20% of time)

  • Write and maintain test cases and test scripts from user stories, acceptance criteria, and process documentation.
  • Keep the test case library current as requirements change; retire cases that no longer apply and add coverage for new functionality.
  • Log defects with clear, reproducible steps, expected vs. actual results, affected records, screenshots, and severity.
  • Maintain test execution records so that release readiness can be assessed at a glance.

Test data and environment support (~10% of time)

  • Prepare and refresh test data sets, including bulk loads via Data Loader or Data Import Wizard.
  • Write basic SOQL queries to verify data state and confirm expected record changes.
  • Test across multiple user profiles and permission sets to confirm record visibility, field-level security, and sharing behave correctly for each role.

Light administrative configuration (~10% of time)

  • Perform straightforward declarative configuration under supervision — custom fields, page layouts, list views, validation rules, simple reports and dashboards.
  • Assist with user setup, permission set assignment, and access troubleshooting.
  • Support user acceptance testing cycles: prepare UAT scripts, walk business testers through them, and consolidate their feedback.

Required Qualifications

  • 1–3 years of hands-on experience in a Salesforce environment as an administrator, QA tester, business analyst, or support analyst.
  • Working knowledge of the Salesforce platform: standard and custom objects, record types, page layouts, profiles and permission sets, validation rules, and Flow.
  • Demonstrated experience executing manual test cases and logging defects in a tracked system (Jira, Azure DevOps, or similar).
  • Ability to read a user story or acceptance criteria and translate it into concrete test steps.
  • Comfort with repetitive, detail-intensive work and a track record of sustained accuracy in it.
  • Basic SOQL and comfort with Data Loader or a comparable data tool.
  • Clear written and spoken English — defect reports and test notes are read by developers and business stakeholders, so writing quality matters.
  • Availability for the required daily overlap with US Eastern business hours.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Salesforce Certified Administrator (ADM-201) — preferred, not required. Hands-on experience carries more weight than the credential, and we will consider candidates who are working toward it.
  • Experience testing during a data migration or multi-org consolidation.
  • Exposure to integration testing between Salesforce and external systems, including basic API concepts.
  • Familiarity with Jira, Confluence, or comparable tracking and documentation tools.
  • Any experience with test automation (Selenium, Provar, Playwright) or reading Apex test results — useful, but this role is manual-first.
  • Background in healthcare, insurance, legal services, or another regulated environment where access control and audit trails matter.

What Success Looks Like

  • By 15 days: has run a full end-to-end pass on at least one core process independently, using existing scripts, and is logging usable defects without rework.
  • By 30 days: is authoring new test cases from user stories with minimal correction, and owns the regression suite for at least one functional area.
  • By 60 days: is the reliable go-to for release readiness on their areas — the team trusts that if this person has signed off, the release is safe to deploy.

jobs.description:
Position Title

Credit Risk Quantitative Model Analyst Sr

Location

Nationwide, MI 48098

Job Summary

The Senior Credit Risk Quantitative Model Analyst supports the Credit Risk Administration Team with the development, testing, implementation, monitoring, documentation, and maintenance of all credit risk rating models. Responsibilities include sourcing, cleaning, and transforming data; researching applicable methods; training and testing a variety of specifications; documenting all facets of the development process; implementation of models and related logic in production systems; assessing outputs across different levels of inputs (sensitivity analysis and scenario analysis); back-testing and ongoing performance monitoring; and, communicating aspects of the model and its application to non-technical stakeholders.

Job Responsibilities:

JOB RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Develop and apply mathematical or statistical theory and methods to collect, organize, interpret, and summarize numerical data sets from multiple sources to develop credit risk rating models or other credit risk-related initiatives.
  • Derive model assumptions that are well reasoned and supportable.
  • Monitor the performance and calibration of existing models.
  • Implement models in code in a transparent and easily maintainable way within loan origination applications.
  • Comprehensively and clearly document all modeling or analysis work that meets internal, GAAP, and regulatory requirements; translate model theory and related results for non-quantitative audiences.
  • Develop and support strong controls for the model implementation framework and maintain related documentation.
  • Support independent model validation process, internal and external audits, and regulatory reviews.
  • Interact with model users, validators, and regulators to address model issues and remediation actions.
  • Interact with key stakeholder groups such as Accounting, Treasury, Credit, Lines of Business, Model Risk Management, and Enterprise Technology in the design, development, and ongoing usage of models.

ADDITIONAL ACCOUNTABILITIES

  • Performs special projects, and additional duties and responsibilities as required.
  • Consistently adheres to regulatory and compliance policies and standards linked to the job as listed and complete required compliance trainings. Accountable to maintain compliance with applicable federal, state and local laws and regulations.

JOB REQUIREMENTS

Required Qualifications:

  • Education level required: Undergraduate Degree (4 years or equivalent) A Bachelor’s degree in a quantitative field with additional certifications or experience.
  • Minimum experience required: 6+ Years of model development, model performance monitoring or validation experience, particularly in credit risk.
  • Experience with at least one of the following software packages: R, SAS, SQL, Python.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Education level preferred: Master's Degree (or Postgraduate equivalent) Master’s degree in Statistics, Econometrics, Mathematics or related quantitative field.
  • Experience with commercial dual risk rating frameworks, especially in PD/LGD/EAD modeling approaches
  • Experience developing credit risk models and programing user interfaces.
  • Experience with nCino implementation of risk rating models and financial spreading process.
  • Working knowledge of Generally Accepted Accounting Principles (GAAP), Basel III, Dodd-Frank Act Stress Testing, CCAR, and bank accounting/regulatory reporting requirements.
  • Ability to use advanced statistical and mathematical software to perform descriptive, predictive, and prescriptive analysis leveraging a variety of statistical techniques (such as segmentation, logistic regression, sensitivity analysis, and machine learning).

Job Competencies:

  • Strong analytical and critical thinking skills with high attention to detail and accuracy.
  • Excellent verbal, written, and interpersonal communication skills
  • Ability to clearly articulate, in writing or orally, ideas, analytic insights, and recommendations to both technical and non-technical audiences, including an executive audience.
  • An ability to identify key problems, conduct in-depth research, and articulate well-reasoned solutions.
  • Demonstrates a strong ability to build and maintain effective relationships with stakeholders by communicating clearly, engaging in proactive collaboration, and leveraging cross functional insights. Aligns relationship building efforts with enterprise goals to accelerate performance and drive strategic results.
  • Builds trusted client relationships, whether internal or external, by identifying needs and delivering tailored solutions to enhance the overall client experience.
  • Fosters or supports a positive work culture and productive work environment, displaying importance of effective relationships with customers and stakeholders.
  • Travel is not required for this role.
  • Physical demands (ADA): No unusual physical exertion is involved.

Working at Abbott

At Abbott, you can do work that matters, grow, and learn, care for yourself and your family, be your true self, and live a full life. You’ll also have access to:

  • Career development with an international company where you can grow the career you dream of.

Position Overview

The Principal Clinical Molecular Geneticist reviews clinical DNA test data and test reports. This position maintains a Portfolio of clinical DNA sequencing tests and cultivates expertise in a subspecialty of genetic disease. The Principal Clinical Molecular Geneticist serves as a thought leader among the geneticist team, guiding process improvements and consulting on challenging cases.

Essential Duties

Include, but are not limited to, the following:

  • Review genetic testing data, conduct troubleshooting when necessary, review the scientific literature, interpret genetic variants, write/edit genetic test reports, and sign out laboratory test results for tests performed.

  • Curate gene panels to include comprehensive gene lists supported by scientific literature.

  • Coordinate and lead process improvement projects to drive cost savings, efficiencies, and productivity.

  • Troubleshoot technical problems, with the aid of technical staff, and ensure remedial action is taken whenever test systems deviate from the laboratory’s performance standards.

  • Serve as an exception handler and expert resource for colleagues regarding complex cases.

  • Participate in the selection of test methodology and take initiative to improve systems, processes, and procedures to drive quality in daily production.

  • Demonstrate the ability to develop and coach others.

  • Provide leadership by promoting communication and collaboration, proactively supporting employee development initiatives, promoting cross-functional collaboration and teamwork, and aiding in conflict resolution.

  • Ability to manage confidential information.

  • Effectively communicate cross-functionally to all levels within the company. Ability to establish and maintain effective working relationships by using appropriate interpersonal skills.

  • Ability to frequently and accurately communicate with employees, customers, health care providers, and vendors, including representing the company at conferences.

  • Thrive in a fast-paced, ever-changing environment and in project team situations.

  • Comply with company Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), practices, and applicable professional, Federal, State, and local regulations and assure that the laboratory is in compliance.

  • Uphold company mission and values through accountability, innovation, integrity, quality, and teamwork.

  • Support and comply with the company’s Quality Management System policies and procedures.

  • Maintain regular and reliable attendance.

  • Ability to act with an inclusion mindset and model these behaviors for the organization.

  • Ability to work designated schedule.

  • Ability to work nights and/or weekends, as needed.

  • Ability to work on a mobile device, tablet, or in front of a computer screen and/or perform typing for approximately 90% of a typical working day.

  • Ability to travel up to 10% of working time, which may include overnight/weekend travel.

Minimum Qualifications

  • Must meet one of the following groups of criteria:

    • Doctoral Degree in a Chemical, Biological, or Clinical Laboratory science from an accredited institution; and

      • Certification by one of the following entities at the time of hire and maintained throughout employment; and:

      • American Board of Bioanalytics (ABB) as a High-Complexity Clinical Laboratory Director (HCLD); or

      • American Board of Medical Genetics and Genomics (ABMGG) in Laboratory Genetics and Genomics (LGG), Molecular Genetics, or Cytogenetics; or

      • Canadian College of Medical Geneticists (CCMG).

With a career at The Home Depot, you can be yourself and also be part of something bigger.

The Product Manager (PM) position is responsible for delivering business value to drive sales, improve efficiency, and improve customer satisfaction through the production of quality products. Within their designated enterprise product line, PMs focus on delivering incremental value by driving product changes and working closely with a team of developers, designers, and business partners. They support in-depth business reviews, communicate and present across all levels of the organization, and support cross-functional product teams.

Key Responsibilities:

  • 40% Strategy & Planning:
  • Gains a thorough understanding of customer and associate needs, both existing and potential, and uses that knowledge to help deliver enterprise products that provide Home Depot customers and associates with an unparalleled shopping experience
  • Translates business goals and end user needs into product strategy; communicates direction and product priorities to the development team, other matrixed teams, and third-party partners
  • Identifies goals, metrics, and analytics to determine product value; continually making recommendations and refinements to the product backlog based on learnings
  • Conduct end user research to help identify user stories and help determine Minimum Viable Product (MVP)
  • Partners with Finance to understand financial needs and assists in the creation of business plans for new opportunities
  • Monitors research as well as the competitive landscape to recommend the best solutions and ensure that products remain or become best in class
  • Evaluates research and market analysis on industry innovations and technology platforms to recommend the best possible solution

  • Ensure product is aligned with company, stakeholder and end-user priorities to drive sales, improve efficiency, and improve customer satisfaction
  • Documents, reviews and ensures that all quality and change control standards are met
  • Formulates, tests and refines assumptions and hypotheses through user research and testing
  • Creates, prioritizes and accepts user stories; incorporate them into release planning
  • Makes product decisions that drive value on a daily basis
  • Identifies pros, cons, issues, obstacles, dependencies and value associated with features and enhancements

  • 30% People:

Custom Ink is so much more than a t-shirt company. We’re a team of creative individuals who empower our customers to create the perfect custom apparel for their groups through an innovative and easy-to-use website and at multiple store locations throughout the country. We are also committed to community, empathy, diversity, and equity. Our end goal is for all Inkers to feel a deep sense of belonging.

We are always looking for great people to join our team, and with locations and stores opening across the country, there are new opportunities all the time. Headquartered in Fairfax, Virginia with offices in Dallas, Texas; and Prague, Czech Republic, with 500+ team members across the world. We have both location-focused and work-from-home jobs.

Overview:

  • Workstyle:This is a remote position; however, to be eligible for hire, candidates must reside in a state where Custom Ink is registered to do business as an employer. Eligible states currently include:

    • AL, AZ, CA, CO, CT, DC, DE, FL, GA, ID, IL, IN, KY, LA, MA, ME, MD, MI, MN, MO, MS, NC, NH, NJ, NM, NV, NY, OH, OR, PA, RI, SC, TN, TX, UT, VA, VT, WA, WI, WV.

  • Physical Requirements/Demands: This is a primarily sedentary, home-based role that requires the ability to remain in a stationary position for extended periods while working at a computer. The role involves regular use of standard office equipment, such as a computer, keyboard, mouse, and telephone. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions of the position.

  • Application Period Disclosure: We are accepting applications for this role for the next 48 hours. We encourage interested candidates to apply as soon as possible for full consideration.

What we’re looking for:

In this role, you will build and lead a verticalized SMB and Education sales motion, translating company growth strategy into repeatable pipeline generation, sales execution, and team development.

  • 8–12+ years of progressive sales experience, with at least 4–5 years in a leadership role managing closing (AE) and/or pipeline generation (SDR) teams in fast-paced, high-volume growth environments.

  • Go-to-Market Architect: Design and execute a robust GTM strategy across a diverse set of SMB (small and medium-sized business) industry verticals, including technology, finance, healthcare, industrial services, and municipalities.

  • Education Sector Expander: Strong commercial exposure to the education market, with highly valued experience navigating higher education procurement, collegiate licensing frameworks, or K–12 district organizational purchasing.

  • Sales Excellence: Exceptional pipeline discipline and analytical rigor, possessing strong command of forecasting methodologies, CRM platforms (Salesforce preferred), and consultative, value-based sales frameworks (e.g., MEDDIC, Challenger, SPIN).

  • People & Partnership Leadership: An empathetic coach and team multiplier who prioritizes skill development, career progression, and psychological safety, while effectively aligning cross-functional goals with Marketing, Product, and Finance.

Who this role isn't for:

  • The High Altitude Overseer: This role is not for a leader who prefers to manage a senior team from a high altitude. This is a greenfield workspace that requires an active mentor who enjoys joining live client strategy calls, unblocking hurdles, and modeling excellence while working alongside an early-to-mid career team.

  • The Funnel-Dependent Manager: If you thrive best when managing established inbound demand, this role will not align. We are looking for a builder who is energized by building proactive prospecting rigor and active outbound discovery motions.

  • The Status-Quo Maintainer: This is a newly created vertical role. If you are most comfortable operating within deeply established systems, tried and true playbooks, or highly defined protocols, the agile, creation-oriented nature of this assignment will not be a great match. We’re seeking a leader who enjoys building structure, testing new approaches, and creating clarity as the work evolves.

What you’ll do:

  • Formulate and Launch the SMB & EDU GTM Strategy: Design and execute the core vertical Go to Market strategies across high-potential SMB industry segments (Technology, Financial Services, Healthcare & Life Sciences, Industrial Services & Trades, Municipal & Government Organizations, and Professional Services) and the educational ecosystem (Collegiate & K–12).

  • Cultivate and Multiply Talent: Recruit, onboard, and develop an inclusive, high performing team of AEs and SDRs, investing deeply in continuous coaching, structured onboarding curricula, and growing skills portfolios.

  • Maximize Premier Market Position: Capitalize on Custom Ink's extensive ~90% collegiate licensing footprint to build structured, repeatable institutional sales frameworks with Athletic Departments, Student Organizations, and purchasing teams.

  • Drive Revenue Precision and Hygiene: Own and accurately manage the vertical revenue forecast for senior leadership, introducing sustainable CRM data discipline, consistent opportunity validation, and pipeline stability across the team.

  • Collaborate Across the Organization: Partner closely with Marketing on cobranded demand generation, align with Sales Enablement to publish vertical playbooks, and serve as the voice of the SMB & EDU customer to help steer product development.

  • Champion Team Well Being and Core Values: Embody our Play to Win behaviors to cultivate a vibrant, collaborative workspace where high standards and team care coexist.

How you’ll be measured:

  • Revenue & Pipeline Health: Consistently meeting quarterly and annual revenue targets while maintaining a well qualified, healthy 3x pipeline coverage ratio, increasing month over month new logo acquisition across target verticals, and managing reliable forecasting variances within a ±10% target threshold.

  • Program Build Benchmarks: Launching a documented collegiate sales blueprint and finalizing a core vertical playbook library (SMB + EDU) that drives pace to impact.

  • Operational & Team Success: Optimizing onboarding time to productivity milestones for new hires, driving equitable quota attainment benchmarks, and driving team engagement and retention rates.

How you’ll make a difference:

At Custom Ink, we believe in bringing people together and building a deep sense of community through high-quality products and digital solutions. As the Senior Manager of Sales for SMB & EDU, your leadership sits at the heart of our next phase of growth, taking incredible market assets and transforming them into predictable, sustainable business lines. Reporting to the VP of Vertical Sales & Partnerships, you act as the critical connection between top-tier corporate strategy and active tactical success in the field. By engineering clear sales toolkits and fostering an inclusive, high-ownership team culture, you enable our sales engine to excel while helping countless groups, schools, and businesses feel connected and celebrated.

Compensation:

Custom Ink is committed to pay transparency and providing fair, equitable compensation in line with market standards and role expectations.

  • For this salaried, exempt position, the pay range is$115k-140k,plus a quarterly performance bonus targeted at 20% of base salary, tied to individual/company performance and continued retention. Placement within the range is determined by a variety of factors, including but not limited to: knowledge, skills, years & depth of experience, and equity with internal team members.

  • In this role, you will be eligible for equity compensation, aligning your contributions with the company's long-term success.

The perks!

  • Generous Paid Time Off: Recharge with flexible paid time off policies and major paid holidays.

  • Comprehensive Health Coverage: Complete Medical, Dental, and Vision coverage at a low cost through a PPO or HDHP plan to support your and your family’s well-being.

  • Employee Wellness: Access to virtual medical consultations through MDLIVE, and mental health services through some of our preferred partners.

  • Family-Friendly Benefits: Up to 14 weeks of fully paid parental leave for birthing parents (6 weeks STD + 8 weeks of parental leave) and 8 weeks of fully paid parental leave for non-birthing parents, adoption assistance, pet insurance, caregiver leave, and fertility benefits.

  • Financial Wellness: Build for the future with our 401(k) plan featuring company matching, employer HSA contributions for eligible plans, Life & AD&D insurance, flexible spending account options, and resources to help you manage life’s financial moments. Professional Development: Grow your career with access to training programs, certifications, and tuition assistance.

jobs.description:
Full-Stack Developer

Position Type: Full-Time, Remote
Working Hours: U.S. Business Hours

About the Role

We are looking for a Full-Stack Developer with strong experience in TypeScript, React, Next.js, and Postgres to build and ship features across a modern client portal.

You’ll own features from design through production, working across the frontend, backend, database, and integrations as needed. This is a hands-on role where you’ll be expected to think beyond the happy path, build reliable features, and improve the codebase as you go.

You’ll work closely with a small engineering and product team, receiving fast feedback and having significant ownership over what you build.

What You’ll Own

End-to-End Feature Development

  • Take features from design prototype through production
  • Build frontend interfaces using TypeScript, React, and Next.js
  • Handle route handlers, database migrations, emails, and UI as part of a complete feature
  • Work across candidate profiles, roles and candidates pages, interview flows, billing, and other portal features
  • Ensure features are production-ready rather than focused only on the happy path

Data & UI Resilience

  • Build features that handle real-world data and edge cases
  • Account for empty states, error states, long names, lengthy CVs, and multiple applications
  • Ensure UI states are clear, intentional, and user-friendly
  • Identify potential edge cases before they become production issues
  • Improve existing features when you identify reliability or usability gaps

Testing & Code Quality

  • Write automated tests for areas that currently lack coverage
  • Add regression coverage for new features and important workflows
  • Keep the codebase stable and maintainable
  • Identify and resolve issues discovered through testing or code review
  • Leave each area of the codebase better than you found it

Database & Backend

  • Write and review Postgres migrations
  • Work confidently with SQL, joins, and database relationships
  • Read and reason about row-level security policies
  • Maintain predictable Supabase Auth and Realtime behavior
  • Understand how frontend, backend, and database changes work together

Third-Party Integrations

  • Work with integrations such as Stripe, Resend, Workable, and SparkHire
  • Connect third-party services to product features when required
  • Troubleshoot integration-related issues
  • Read and understand the existing Python FastAPI service when features interact with AI or data functionality

Code Review & Collaboration

  • Write clear and well-documented pull requests
  • Provide enough context for reviewers to understand and approve changes efficiently
  • Participate in code reviews and incorporate feedback
  • Progress toward reviewing API and database migration pull requests independently
  • Collaborate directly with engineering and product team members in a fast feedback environment

Requirements

  • 2–4 years of experience shipping production TypeScript and React applications
  • Strong experience with Next.js, ideally including App Router, Server Components, and Route Handlers
  • Solid understanding of SQL and relational databases
  • Ability to write joins, read migrations, and understand database relationships
  • Understanding of Postgres and row-level security concepts
  • Experience building production-ready UIs with thoughtful empty, loading, and error states
  • Experience working in a monorepo or codebase where features span frontend, backend, and database layers
  • Experience writing and maintaining automated tests
  • Familiarity with pull requests and modern code-review workflows
  • Strong problem-solving and debugging skills
  • Ability to own features independently from requirements through deployment
  • Strong written communication and attention to detail

Nice to Have

  • Hands-on experience with Supabase
  • Experience with Stripe or Resend
  • Experience working with Workable or SparkHire integrations
  • Familiarity with Python and FastAPI
  • Experience with unit or integration testing
  • Experience working with AI or data-focused backend services
  • Experience using tools such as CodeRabbit or similar AI-assisted code review tools
  • Previous experience working in a small, fast-moving product team

What Makes You a Strong Fit

You’ll thrive in this role if you:

  • Can take a feature from a brief to production without needing every task broken down
  • Think about migrations, edge cases, testing, and integrations alongside the UI
  • Care about how features behave with real-world data
  • Communicate proactively when you encounter blockers
  • Welcome feedback and use it to improve your work
  • Are comfortable working across both frontend and backend systems
  • Prefer shipping small, reliable improvements consistently
  • Take pride in leaving the codebase cleaner and more stable than you found it

What Success Looks Like

  • Features move efficiently from design to production
  • New functionality works reliably across real-world data scenarios
  • Strong automated test coverage across key areas of the portal
  • Database migrations and security policies remain reliable and well-structured
  • Pull requests are clear, focused, and easy to review
  • Third-party integrations work consistently across product workflows
  • Bugs and edge cases are identified and addressed proactively
  • The codebase becomes more stable and maintainable over time

Typical Day

Your day may start with a design prototype, feature request, or product comment. You’ll work across the stack to turn that requirement into a production-ready feature—writing the database migration, building the UI, implementing the route handler, connecting required integrations, and adding tests.

Other days may involve fixing an edge case that surfaced in production, such as a candidate with multiple applications causing an unexpected issue in a list view. You’ll investigate the problem, implement the fix, test it, and deploy the improvement.

The team operates with a tight feedback loop, so expect short standups, direct collaboration, and most decisions to happen through comments and pull requests rather than lengthy meetings.

Interview Process

  1. Initial Application Review
  2. AI Rating & Recruiter Screening
  3. Technical/Client Interview
  4. Final Selection & Onboarding

jobs.description:
HKA is a global leader in risk mitigation, dispute resolution, and expert witness services. We tackle complex challenges with our multi-disciplinary expertise.

As trusted consultants and advisors, we deliver solutions in uncertain and disputed situations, ensuring the best outcomes for clients worldwide. Our experts have testified globally on major cases spanning across a wide range of industries and sectors.

As part of the HKA team you can expect:

  • A strong collaborative culture with a mutual pursuit of your success alongside the success of our teams.

  • The opportunity to solve problems creatively, contribute to our innovative direction, and be valued as an individual

  • The ability to leverage HKA’s strong network and presence in various industries and reputation for exceptional expert witnesses to accelerate career development and connections.

The Opportunity:

HKA is seeking a Forensic Highway / Bridge Engineer to support claims and litigation involving highway and bridge infrastructure across the United States. This role centers on forensic evaluation of transportation assets where safety, durability, and compliance with standards of care are actively challenged.

You will apply design, inspection, and rehabilitation experience to develop independent expert opinions and deliver testimony in high profile disputes. This position is well suited for an experienced engineer who wants to focus on forensic analysis, expert reporting, and client-facing consulting work.

Responsibilities:

Forensic & Litigation Consulting

  • Lead forensic investigations involving bridge and highway assets, including superstructure/substructure components, bearings/joints, decks, approach slabs, retaining walls, roadway geometry, drainage interfaces, and related civil works.

  • Conduct site inspections and evidence collection following failures, load events, deterioration concerns, construction deficiencies, inspection disputes, or incident-related claims.

  • Determine cause, origin, extent, and contributing factors, including evaluation of design intent, construction practices, inspection/maintenance history, load rating practices, and lifecycle performance.

  • Prepare independent, litigation-ready expert reports (and supporting exhibits) for arbitration, mediation, and court proceedings, addressing causation, standard of care, and responsibility.

  • Provide expert witness testimony in depositions, arbitration, and/or court, including testimony under cross-examination.

  • Collaborate with attorneys, insurers, owners, contractors, and other technical experts to develop coordinated expert opinions and respond to opposing expert positions.

  • Advise clients on remediation/repair options, risk mitigation, and dispute resolution strategy, including evaluation of constructability and safety considerations.

Technical Bridge / Highway Engineering Expertise

  • Review and analyze drawings, specifications, calculations, inspection reports, load ratings, as-builts, maintenance records, and construction documentation.

  • Evaluate deterioration mechanisms and performance drivers (e.g., corrosion, fatigue, cracking, scour/hydraulic impacts, joint/bearing performance, concrete distress) and link findings to standard-of-care expectations.

jobs.title: Beehive Project Developer
jobs.excerpt: THE OPPORTUNITYThe Beehive Project Developer is an independent contractor who will build and scale the Beehive Microgrid™️ line of business — identifying a sustainable growth model, opening and growing revenue streams, owning the overall revenue performance of the Beehive social enterprise, and developing regional fleets that make renewable disaster response possible at scale.
jobs.description:
THE OPPORTUNITY

The Beehive Project Developer is an independent contractor who will build and scale the Beehive Microgrid™️ line of business — identifying a sustainable growth model, opening and growing revenue streams, owning the overall revenue performance of the Beehive social enterprise, and developing regional fleets that make renewable disaster response possible at scale.

This is a commercial and growth-focused role at its core, paired with hands-on project development. You will define how Beehive Microgrids grow into a self-sustaining business — leasing mobile energy assets, cultivating investors and partners, and standing up repeatable regional fleets — much like a solar project developer, but with ownership of the business model as well as the build.

You will work directly with our CEO on partnerships and growth strategy, and closely with our HQ Technology Team and regional program teams to turn strategy into deployed, revenue-generating fleets. This is a development and business-building role; active disaster deployments are handled by regional field teams.

ABOUT US

Footprint Project is a 501(c)(3) nonprofit disaster service organization headquartered in New Orleans, Louisiana. We develop and deploy sustainable response technologies to empower community resilience. Footprint Project works across the disaster management cycle to expand frontline access to mobile microgrids and reduce fossil fuel use. Visit to learn more.

The Beehive Microgrid™ is our flagship resilience model: a dynamic network of rapidly deployable mobile energy assets built around a semi-permanent, centralized “Hive” and a fleet of mobile energy “Bees” (power, cooling, and water units). In blue-sky mode, a Hive serves as office, storage, and maintenance base while Bees power everyday community operations; in grey-sky mode, Bees deploy to deliver electricity, refrigeration, and clean water, and the Hive becomes a community hub and charging station.

We are ready to scale. Our goal is to grow Beehive Microgrids into a sustainable, revenue-generating line of business that lets Footprint rapidly expand deployment nationwide — and we are looking for the person to build that engine.

JOB DETAILS

  • Engagement: Independent contractor (1099), ongoing and open-ended, approximately full-time. As a contractor, you determine how and when you work to deliver the agreed outcomes, use your own equipment, and are free to serve other clients.
  • Location: New Orleans, LA or Asheville, NC metro areas preferred; open to fully remote for the right candidate.
  • Travel: Occasional travel to regions/sites (pre-approved travel expenses reimbursed)
  • Compensation: Flat monthly retainer, with potential for additional deliverables-based compensation. Our contract rates are benchmarked against local market standards for independent consultants. The final rate offered will be based on the contractor’s primary location, level of experience, specialized expertise, and complexity of the deliverables.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

Growth Model & Revenue Ownership

  • Identify and build a sustainable growth model for the Beehive line of work, enabling Footprint to rapidly scale deployment nationwide.
  • Own and grow the overall revenue generated by the Beehive line of business, with P&L-style accountability for its performance.
  • Integrate mobile batteries into Commercial & Industrial (C&I) projects.
  • Sell the Beehive Microgrid model to developers.
  • Rent Bees for events.
  • Identify and develop additional Beehive revenue opportunities as the business grows.

Fleet Development & Project Management

  • Lead end-to-end development of regional Beehive Microgrid™ fleets, from concept and scoping through procurement, build-out, and deployment-readiness.
  • Manage project timelines, interdependencies, and delivery across multiple regions.
  • Coordinate with regional program teams on siting, site assessment, and deployment-readiness for Hives and Bees.

RFPs & Procurement

  • Develop and run RFPs for equipment, vendors, and EPC/build partners supporting regional fleets.
  • Manage procurement of Hive and Bee assets and related equipment, evaluating bids and making sourcing recommendations.
  • Coordinate with Footprint staff on funder and grant procurement requirements (e.g., Buy America, prevailing wage, and applicable procurement standards).

Vendor & Partner Management

  • Manage relationships with vendors, suppliers, and EPC/build partners, holding them to scope, schedule, quality, and cost.
  • Support the CEO in cultivating sponsors and partners, providing development-side inputs and project scoping to advance opportunities.

Regional Expansion & Repeatability

  • Help identify and stand up new and expansion regions in addition to established regions.
  • Develop repeatable playbooks, templates, and processes that make launching a fleet in a new region faster and more consistent.

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

  • Direct experience in solar / clean-energy project development, including running RFPs, managing procurement, and managing vendors and EPCs.
  • A business development mindset with a track record of building revenue — selling, renting, or otherwise monetizing energy assets, products, or services.
  • Proven ability to manage complex, multi-stakeholder projects end to end, on schedule and on budget.
  • Experience developing standardized, repeatable processes across multiple projects or sites.
  • Ability to work independently as a contractor — setting your own methods and schedule to deliver defined outcomes.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

  • Experience with mobile, modular, or distributed energy assets (rather than only fixed rooftop or utility-scale).
  • Experience selling into Commercial & Industrial (C&I) markets or to project developers.
  • Familiarity with grant- or publicly funded procurement environments and their requirements.
  • Experience in disaster response, resilience, or mission-driven / nonprofit settings.

No specific certifications or credentials (e.g., PMP, NABCEP, PE) are required.

APPLICATION PROCESS

Please send (via BambooHR) a cover letter and your resume. For selected candidates, our hiring process consists of an initial screening, at least one interview, and professional reference/employment history review.

Applications without both a cover letter and resume will not be considered.

No one candidate will fit all the requirements, so everyone who fits at least some of the skills and has a willingness to learn is encouraged to apply.

Footprint Project is an equal opportunity employer that is committed to diversity and inclusion in the workplace. We prohibit discrimination and harassment of any kind based on race, color, sex, religion, sexual orientation, national origin, disability, genetic information, pregnancy, or any other protected characteristic as outlined by federal, state, or local laws.

This policy applies to all employment practices within our organization, including hiring, recruiting, promotion, termination, layoff, recall, leave of absence, compensation, benefits, training, and apprenticeship. Footprint Project makes hiring decisions based solely on qualifications, merit, and business needs at the time. We expect all Footprint Project employees uphold and demonstrate these same values, wherever we go and with whomever we work.

The successful candidate will be responsible for defining and administering data privacy, classification, retention, and data-sharing policies across the CMM data platform, ensuring that sensitive and court-related data is protected, properly classified, and shared only under appropriate agreements and controls.

The Privacy & Data Sharing Specialist will execute the following responsibilities:

This is a part-time, remote, freelance role with the flexibility to decide your business hours. Candidate does not have to based in any specific location as the role is remote. This role is a great opportunity to supplement your current job or private practice.

You will be a practitioner on our telehealth platform 'Intellect', where your role is to support our clients' mental health and personal growth based on the individual needs and goals.

There are 4 roles that focus on different types of 1-on-1 sessions:

1. Network Psychiatrist

Network Psychiatrist will assist Intellect in providing psychiatric consultations (online and/or in person) wherein we will refer clients over to the network partner. As a member of our psychiatry network, the network psychiatrist will conduct appropriate clinical care within local regulations as well as necessary reporting and documentation.

We will refer clients who require clinical care over to our network psychiatrist. The psychiatrist will then schedule an initial consultation within 2 weeks of the referral and share with Intellect the expected treatment plan going forward. Network psychiatrist will thereafter be responsible for the continued treatment of the client, and will be required to provide periodic updates on the progress of the client thereafter. Our network psychiatrists are required to have the following credentials:

  • Master Degree in Medicine (M. Med(Psychiatry) or equivalent qualification required to practice psychiatry
  • Licensed/ Board certified to practice, prescribe and/or dispense medication in their respective countries based on the in-country requirements and regulations
  • Minimum 3 years of experience in residency
  • Possesses good record in clinical excellence and commitment to medical education
  • Ability to perform age-appropriate assessments on clients
  • Able to interact effectively with clients of diverse educational, socioeconomic and ethnic backgrounds, skill levels and value systems
  • Excellent written and verbal communications, listening, and social skills
  • Compassionate about helping clients and using clinically proven protocols

2. Crisis Helpline Responder

Crisis Helpline Responders focus on providing immediate client intervention that are in need of immediate support through a hotline. Our responders are required to have the following background:

  • 2 - 3 years of experience in helplines, either in a paid or voluntary capacity
  • Can effectively communicate in their native language
  • Completed training in Crisis Intervention or Suicide Prevention
  • Experience working with high risk clinical situations (at risk of or affected by suicide or crisis cases) and
  • Has the appropriate insurances required by your country
  • Ability to maintain emotional composure in high stress situations, ability to bounce back from stressful interactions and high-risk cases

3. Behavioral Health Coach

As a behavioral health coach you will focus on conducting 1-on-1 30 minute virtual coaching sessions that focus on subclinical cases (lack of motivation, stress, procrastination, etc). Our coaches are required to have the following credentials:

  • Has a Master / Postgraduate Diploma training in Counselling / Clinical Psychology or ICF accreditation
  • Skilled in Cognitive Behavioural Therapy or other evidence-based approaches (e.g. Motivational Interviewing, DBT, SFBT, etc.)
  • Candidate must have accumulated at least 300 hours worth of sessions
  • Candidate must be proficient in other languages other than English
  • Candidates with prior experience in EAP, counselling working adults or coaching managerial roles is a plus

4. Clinical Provider

Clinical providers on the other hand focus on clients that are in need of higher touch care. They provide 60 minute clinical online sessions and assist potential clients with cases such as MDD, Phobia, Trauma, etc. Our clinical providers are required to have the following credentials:

  • Has a Master / Postgraduate Diploma training in Clinical Psychology or Counselling
  • Skilled in Cognitive Behavioural Therapy or other evidence-based approaches (e.g. DBT, SFBT, etc.)
  • Candidate must have accumulated at least 300 clinical hours
  • Candidate must be proficient in other languages other than English
  • Candidates with prior experience in EAP, counselling working adults or coaching managerial roles is a plus

  • Netzwerkgrundlagen: Grundverständnis von TCP/IP, Subnetting und gängigen Protokollen.

  • Scripting: Grundkenntnisse in Python, Bash oder PowerShell.
  • Vulnerability Assessment: Umgang mit Tools wie Nmap, Nessus oder OpenVAS.
  • Incident Response: Basiswissen zur Erkennung und Reaktion auf Sicherheitsvorfälle.
  • Security Frameworks: Erste Einblicke in Frameworks wie MITRE ATT&CK oder NIST.

Beratungskompetenz

Kenmerken van deze vraagstukken zijn de aanwezigheid van een maatschappelijke component, de complexe politiek bestuurlijke omgeving en het lokale of regionale schaalniveau. Wij zijn de adviesgroep Ruimte, Wonen en Economie van TwynstraGudde.

Wij maken impact op morgen én op overmorgen. Creatief zijn we, soms grensverleggend en tegelijkertijd pragmatisch. Opdrachtgevers kunnen op ons rekenen: onze kracht is om van strategie tot realisatie te komen. Wij werken aan inbreidingslocaties voor woningbouw, spoorzones, transformatie van brownfields, herontwikkeling van zorgterreinen en reconstructies van verrommeld buitengebied. Help jij hen, samen met ons, vooruit?

Jouw rol

Als Adviseur financiën gebiedsontwikkeling (planeconoom) werk je aan grote én kleine opgaven.

Je kunt producten als grondexploitaties, exploitatieplannen, residuele grondprijsberekeningen en businesscases ontwerpen, doorrekenen, beoordelen én deze financiële informatie vertalen zodat besluitvorming op verschillende niveaus (ambtelijk en bestuurlijk) kan plaatsvinden. Samen met andere financieel experts, projectleiders en/ of bestuurders kun je een ontwikkelstrategie uitdenken en uitvoeren. Het gaat hierbij ook vaak om samenwerkingsopgaven tussen partijen, waarbij je moet laveren tussen belangen. Je kijkt hierbij over de grenzen van het project en je eigen vakgebied heen. Samen met collega’s sta je klaar voor verschillende opdrachtgevers. Je rol varieert sterk per project en omgeving. Hierin kun jij zelf je koers bepalen.

Jouw werkzaamheden

  • Adviseren: doordat je inhoudelijk sterk bent, kun je opdrachtgevers van gedegen en diepgaand advies voorzien.

  • Beslissingen nemen: je hakt knopen door als Adviseur financiën gebiedsontwikkeling (planeconoom).

  • Verbinden: je zorgt er samen met collega’s voor dat er draagvlak ontstaat, bouwt aan coalities en verbindt partijen, in- en extern.

  • Onderhandelen: je bent in staat om onderhandelingen te voeren met (markt)partijen, bijvoorbeeld als het gaat om het sluiten van anterieure overeenkomsten.

  • Managen: je overziet de te nemen stappen, zorg je voor integrale aansturing van het project en ben je gesprekspartner van bestuurders.

  • Ontwikkelen: je denkt bewust na over je eigen leer- en ontwikkelpad en leert graag bij.

Je werkt aan meerdere kortlopende opdrachten naast elkaar of voor langere tijd aan één opdracht. Daarbij werk je zelfstandig of in teamverband en maak je natuurlijk ook deel uit van onze adviesgroep Ruimte, Wonen en Economie, en van bredere samenwerkingsverbanden binnen het bureau als geheel.

Requirements

Jouw profiel

Je staat bekend als iemand die ruime kennis en ervaring heeft met de financiële kant van gebiedsontwikkelingen. Doordat je analytisch vaardig bent, kun je problemen snel identificeren en met je communicatieve kwaliteiten kun je tot de kern van vraagstukken komen. Je hebt gedegen kennis in huis van business cases, grondexploitaties en het inzetten van andere financiële instrumenten bij gebiedsontwikkelingen. Daarnaast zorgt jouw creativiteit voor haalbare oplossingen. Ook ben je in staat om processen te organiseren en draagvlak te creëren, en ben je creatief om tot haalbare oplossingen te kunnen komen. Daarnaast lever je gedegen werk af en controleer je bij de opdrachtgever of jouw werkzaamheden aan de verwachtingen voldoen. Je trekt snel werk naar je toe, omdat je ziet wat mensen of organisaties nodig hebben. Tenslotte sta je open voor reflectie, leren en ontwikkeling.

Wat we van je vragen

  • Afgeronde HBO of WO opleiding en academisch werk- en denkniveau.

  • Minimaal 2 jaar relevante werkervaring in het ruimtelijke domein.

  • Aantoonbare kennis van het opstellen van grondexploitaties/businesscases, exploitatieplannen, residuele grondprijsberekeningen.

  • Affiniteit met het vervullen van de rol van adviseur.

  • Sterke analytische vaardigheden, resultaatgericht en met financieel inzicht.

Bij TwynstraGudde stimuleren we een inclusieve werkplek waar iedereen zichzelf kan zijn. Meer weten? Lees dan ons diversiteit en inclusie statement.

Over ons

Het werk dat we doen raakt ons. Iedere dag. Het heeft impact op onze maatschappij. Op de leefomgeving. Op morgen én op overmorgen. Wie doet mee en wie blijft achter? Wat vernieuw je? Wat behoud je?
Wij zijn de adviesgroep Ruimte Wonen en Economie. Wij helpen onze opdrachtgevers omdat wij vinden dat het beter moet, net als jij. Niet alleen vandaag of morgen, maar ook over 50 jaar. Wij gaan niet voor het snelle scoren, maar voor de lange termijn. Wij brengen complexe, ruimtelijke en duurzaamheidsvraagstukken tot de essentie terug. We helpen onze klanten om in control te blijven. Om los te laten. Scherp en samenwerkend. Soms regelen we, soms ontregelen we. Maar we helpen, altijd.

Aspecten die wij belangrijk vinden

  • Kwaliteit van de leefomgeving

  • Duurzaamheid

  • Realistische strategieën

We worden enthousiast van praktische en werkende oplossingen. We hanteren een hoge kwaliteitsstandaard, zijn ambitieus én collegiaal. We streven actief naar meer diversiteit en inclusiviteit en nodigen nadrukkelijk kandidaten van alle achtergronden uit om te reageren.

Wat we bieden

Bij TwynstraGudde werk je aan maatschappelijk relevante projecten voor toonaangevende opdrachtgevers. Dat doen we al 55 jaar. Daarbij vinden we het belangrijk dat jij je kunt ontwikkelen op een manier die bij je past, zodat we samen tot optimale resultaten komen.

Wat je van ons kunt verwachten

  • Een afwisselende baan met een salaris dat recht doet aan je rol en ervaring, inclusief flexibele beloning.

  • Goede secundaire arbeidsvoorwaarden: zoals een telefoon, laptop en uitgebreide pensioen- en mobiliteitsregelingen.

  • Een inspirerende werkomgeving met gedreven collega’s.

  • Ruime mogelijkheden om je werk en ontwikkeling op jouw manier vorm te geven.

Wat je verder van ons kunt verwachten

  • Een can do mentaliteit, met ruimte voor initiatief en ondernemerschap.

  • Een team met veel gezelligheid en humor.

  • Veel ruimte om te leren en ontwikkelen in thema’s die jou pakken.

Kennismaken

Werk jij met ons mee aan de mooiste projecten die Nederland te bieden heeft? Solliciteer direct! In je motivatiebrief zien we, naast jouw geschiktheid en waarom je interesse hebt, graag terug wat jij meeneemt naar TwynstraGudde en waar jij bijzonder in bent. Wil je meer informatie? Neem dan contact op met Erwin Uil via telefoonnummer 033-467 7231.

We nemen na ontvangst van je sollicitatie zo snel mogelijk contact met je op.

jobs.title: Site Activation Partner I - FSP (Fixed-Term 7 months)
jobs.excerpt: When our values align, there's no limit to what we can achieve.
jobs.description:
When our values align, there's no limit to what we can achieve.

At Parexel, we all share the same goal - to improve the world's health. From clinical trials to regulatory, consulting, and market access, every clinical development solution we provide is underpinned by something special - a deep conviction in what we do.

Each of us, no matter what we do at Parexel, contributes to the development of a therapy that ultimately will benefit a patient. We take our work personally, we do it with empathy and we're committed to making a difference.

Parexel FSP is hiring Site Activation Partners in Mexico, Argentina or Brazil! Candidates must have at least 2 years of experience in start-up working with US/Canada. This is a 7-month temporary assignment with the potential to transition into a full-time role.

The Site Activation Partner(SAP) is responsible for leading or supporting operational activities from start- up to close-out, for assigned studies and investigator sites to ensure compliance with study timelines and in accordance with prevailing laws, Good Clinical Practices, and Client standards. Responsibility within a country and may span over more than 1 country depending on the geographical region and business needs.

Organizational Relationships:

Reports to Parexel-assigned Line Management with day-to-day direction from Client; refer to Organizational Chart for details regarding assigned role and associated reporting structure.

Primary Responsibilities:

Clinical Trial Site Activation

  • Initiate and coordinate activities and essential documents management during start-up towards the compilation of a high-quality Investigator Initiation Package (IIP) leading to approval for site initiation

  • Register investigator sites and Client stakeholders in Client registries and systems as required. Update and regularly maintain the registry with accuracy and have it inspection ready

  • Work directly and interact with investigator sites to confirm readiness for site start-up by reviewing study site profile ready in Shared Investigator Platform (SIP) or reviewing/completing critical information Sheet inclusive of but not limited to Investigator Initiation Packages (IIP) essential documents components, Site contracts contacts, clinical supply shipment information, payment information, IRB submission and status

  • Take the lead to resolve issues or concerns and timely escalation of Site issues where applicable

  • Prepare, validate and submit regulatory documents such as completed IIP, IRB approval forms, FDA 1572/Attestation Form, for internal regulatory approval within required timelines

  • Manage and coordinate with other supporting roles to ensure timely site activation and operational activities

  • Support the compilation of the Central Investigator Review Board (IRB) package and submissions to approval of the study (where applicable) and other committees as per country requirements

  • Coordinate the timely communication, documentation and responses between Client and Central Ethics committee to bring clinical study to approval (country dependent)

  • Support investigators sites with local IRB workflow from preparation, submission through approval.

  • Assist with preparation, handling and distribution of non-Clinical Trial Supplies and maintenance of tracking information as needed.

  • Collaborate with the Study Team on the development and readiness of sites electronic Investigator Site File (eISF) when utilized and act as primary point of contact for the sites and manage the Site Operations/CRO monitor access to eISF prior to Site Initiation Visit (SIV).

  • Assist with the preparation, handling, distribution, filing, and archiving of clinical documentation and reports according to the scope of work and standard operating procedures.

  • Support & implement activities in SIP to align with Client strategy as it relates to the role.

  • Coordinate translation of documents that are within scope with the preferred translation vendors.

Clinical Trials Conduct

  • Post site activation, initiate and coordinate activities and essential documents management with the investigator’s sites towards the compilation of a high-quality documents and updates through the life cycle of a study such as the documents management for protocol amendments, FDA 1572/Attestation revisions, Ethics Committee annual approvals and other activities required during study conduct

  • Ensure maintenance of IRB/Ethics and other committees’ activities as applicable

  • Responsible for timely filing of documents to Trial Master File and assisting with periodic quality review of study files for accuracy and completeness

  • Accurately update and maintain clinical trial systems that track site compliance and performance within project timelines

  • Supports investigator sites, and study teams in preparation for and providing responses to site audits / inspections

Internal & External Communication

  • Maintain ongoing contact and communication with the study team and respond promptly to study team and investigator site requests

  • Attend study Start-up meeting and provide functional updates on a country and site level

  • Establish tools for efficient updates to study team as needed regarding site status, issues, delays, approvals

  • Disseminate Central or Local Ethics Approval to study team and Investigator Sites where applicable

  • Communicate Local sites approvals to study team members and stakeholders

Clinical Trial Site Support

  • As needed, perform, awareness session with site personnel on Client requirements and to ensure ongoing compliance with study documentation in accordance with prevailing laws, Good Clinical Practices, and Client standards

  • Identify and resolve investigator site issues within required timeframes; align with study team and local country colleagues on corrective and preventative actions to close open issues and to prevent recurrence / persistence of issues

General

  • Completes training assigned by Client and/or EP, as necessary, including general training requirements, SOPs, system and process related training

  • Adhere to EP and Client SOPs and processes

  • A good understanding of the Site Activation requirements and processes within the country/region and be able to learn and potentially implement in more than one (1) country

Additional Responsibilities

  • May be assigned as Site Activation Partner Point of Contact (PoC) on a study conducted in multi- country

  • May be assigned as a Subject Matter Expert (SME) on a system and/or process, and represent the SAP function as applicable

  • May represent the SAP role on global initiatives

  • Able to act as an SME on projects and initiatives, as requested

  • Support the mentoring of new hires on processes/ systems

  • Ability to use and learn systems, and to use independently

  • Microsoft Suite

  • Clinical Trial Management Systems (CTMS)

  • Electronic Trial Master File

  • Electronic Investigator Site File (e.g. Florence)

  • Document exchange portals

  • Shared Investigator Platform

  • Ethics, National Networks and Governing Bodies Portals and platforms (as needed)

Education and Certification:

  • School diploma/certificate with equivalent combination of education, training and experience; Bachelor of Science, Bachelor of Arts or Bachelor’s in Life Sciences preferred

Skills and Experience:

  • Minimum 3 years’ relevant experience in clinical site management, working with US/Canada.

  • Experience working in the pharmaceutical industry/or CRO in study site activation is preferred

  • Knowledge of clinical trial methodologies, ICH/GCP, FDA and Global and local country regulations

  • Effective verbal and written communication skills in relating to colleagues and associates both inside and outside of the organization

  • Good technical skills and ability to learn and use multiple systems

  • Demonstrated knowledge of clinical research and development processes, Key operational elements of a clinical trial, and ability to gain command of process details

  • Understand the quality expectations and emphasis on right first time. Demonstrate compliance with all applicable company, regulatory and country requirements. Attention to detail evident in a disciplined approach

  • Ability to work independently and also as a team member

  • Ability to organize tasks, time and priorities, ability to multi-task

  • Understand basic medical terminology, GCP requirements and proficient in computer operations

Language Skills:

  • Must be fluent in Local language and in English. Multilanguage capability is preferred

You will assess the reasonableness of key valuation inputs, including cap rates, discount rates, and other assumptions, while helping support consistent and well-informed valuation decisions across a significant real estate portfolio. You will work with appraisal information across approximately 50 real estate funds and collaborate with internal and external stakeholders to support high-quality valuation reviews.

This is a US-based role open across 48 states, with a preference for candidates in the Eastern or Central time zones to support collaboration with the India team.

What’s in it for you

Review complex institutional-grade real estate valuations. You will work with sophisticated commercial real estate appraisal reports and evaluate the assumptions, methodologies, and analysis that support major institutional investment decisions.

Bring your expertise to a specialized team. You will join a team supporting TIAA-Nuveen’s real estate valuation needs, with exposure to a broad portfolio of funds and property types within an institutional investment environment.

Use your judgment to influence valuation quality. Your review of cap rates, discount rates, market assumptions, and other valuation inputs will help identify issues, strengthen analysis, and support well-founded valuation conclusions.

Continue developing your appraisal career. You will have the opportunity to apply your appraisal experience in a review-focused role while continuing to build toward the MAI designation and deepen your knowledge of institutional real estate valuation.

Collaborate across teams and locations. You will work with Senior Managers, the Senior Director, and colleagues in India to share insights, discuss valuation considerations, and support consistent review practices.

As our new Senior Consultant, you will:

  • Review institutional appraisals.You will review appraisal reports for institutional-grade commercial real estate, assessing whether the valuation theory, methodology, assumptions, and supporting analysis are accurate and reasonable. You will examine key inputs such as cap rates, discount rates, and other factors that influence valuation conclusions.

  • Assess valuation assumptions.You will use your commercial real estate appraisal expertise to identify questions, inconsistencies, or areas requiring further support. You will apply sound judgment when evaluating the reasonableness of valuation conclusions and the assumptions behind them.

  • Support portfolio valuation oversight.You will contribute to the review of appraisals across approximately 50 real estate funds supporting TIAA-Nuveen. You will help maintain consistency and quality across valuation reviews within an institutional investment environment.

  • Collaborate with appraisal professionals. You will work with Senior Managers, the Senior Director, and other internal stakeholders to discuss appraisal findings, clarify valuation considerations, and support review priorities. You will also collaborate with the India team across time zones.

  • Communicate review findings. You will clearly document and communicate questions, observations, and conclusions arising from your appraisal reviews. You will help ensure valuation considerations are understood and appropriately addressed.

  • Contribute to continuous improvement.The Managed Services team, along with the broader Altus Group organization, strategically integrates artificial intelligence (AI) into its processes and workflows. You will support the integration of AI and process improvements to enhance efficiency, consistency, and decision-making. You will help develop and refine valuation review practices and procedures that promote consistency, and sound valuation judgment.

You bring:

  • The appraisal review experience. You bring 3–5 or more years of experience reviewing appraisals for institutional-grade commercial real estate. You understand how to assess appraisal methodology, valuation theory, market assumptions, and the reasonableness of valuation conclusions.

  • The professional designation and licensing.You hold a state Certified General Appraiser license and are on track to achieve the MAI designation through the Appraisal Institute.

  • The technical proficiency.You have daily or weekly experience using Argus Enterprise and can demonstrate practical fluency with the platform. Experience with Rockport Val or a comparable valuation platform may also be considered.

  • The real estate knowledge.You have a strong understanding of commercial real estate valuation, including cap rates, discount rates, market conditions, and the assumptions that support institutional-grade appraisal reports.

  • The analytical judgment.You can evaluate complex information, identify issues that require further investigation, and form well-supported conclusions. You are comfortable questioning assumptions respectfully and using evidence to support your perspective.

  • The communication and collaboration skills.You communicate clearly and work effectively with colleagues, senior leaders, and external stakeholders. You are engaged, open-minded, and collaborative, with an approach that supports constructive discussion and shared problem-solving.

  • The educational background.An undergraduate or graduate degree in real estate, finance, economics, accounting, or a related field would be an asset. Equivalent knowledge gained through education, training, and practical experience is also valuable.

Apply now

If you're excited about this role but your experience aligns differently with every requirement, we encourage you to apply. While specific qualifications may be strictly required, others can be based on various experiences, backgrounds, and knowledge. We can't promise an interview, but we will consider your whole application.

What you can expect from our interview process:

  • A virtual interview with a Talent Advisor to discuss your interest in the role, your experience, and what you are looking for in your next career opportunity. The conversation will be recorded using BrightHire, an AI-powered video interview tool. More details will be shared when you are invited to interview.

  • A virtual interview with Senior Managers focused on your commercial real estate appraisal review experience, technical knowledge, collaboration style, and cultural alignment with the team. This interview is expected to be approximately 30 minutes.

  • A technical assessment or Argus case study focused on your practical proficiency with Argus Enterprise and your approach to reviewing valuation assumptions and appraisal analysis.

  • A final interview with the Senior Director, Managed Services, focused on your technical depth, institutional appraisal review experience, valuation judgment, and approach to working with internal and external stakeholders. This interview is expected to be approximately 45–60 minutes.

Unlock your Altus Experience!
